name: FM Mangal
address: 54 Camberwell Church St, London SE5 8QZ, UK

reviews.text: Had to use a picture from the last time I was here because the food was so good i didn’t even remember about anything else. I have been coming here for years where before they refurbished and 2 things have never changed; The service and the quality of the food . Fm manual is a sure value and the portions are very consistent. This time I had the Fm mangal special with grilled lamb and aubergine and it was out of this world! Cocktails are great too

A truly exceptional restaurant with great service. It is clear that the owners truly care about the experience of diners with attentive staff and delicious food. You must try the Turkish bread, hummus and tabouli. We added the chicken kebab which was very plentiful and filling. The young owner even gave us some Turkish Delight and liqueurs to finish our meal off. This by far was our best meal whilst in London. Go and see for yourself, you won’t regret it.

This is by far the best Turkish restaurant we tried! We thought that this place is a normal take away shop but it was a proper sit down restaurant:. We  ordered their mixed kebab, portion is good for 1 person but for us it was more than enough for 2 people.

All the meat taste so good & well seasoned. I am not a fan of salad yet i managed to eat a lot of their salad!! The sauces were spot on… and the bread —- . I asked for another serving!!! We ate beyond satisfied… excellent in all aspects from food, to the service as well as  cleanliness!!!! We will definitely be back

The staff were absolutely amazing and the service was impeccable. The attention to detail was truly mind blowing, and the food was nothing short of excellent. Turkish cuisine is one of my absolute favourites, and FM Mangal does it best! Their signature complimentary bread and red/onion dip was to die for. I will definitely be coming back again!!! :)

Amazing food and great value. The service is great as well with friendly waitress
The complementary bread and baklava complete the fantastic experience. It was out second time and not our last.

We had all this food and drinks and we’re in an out in an hour. Can’t recommend this place enough. Every single item was beyond delicious, but personal fav has to be the mushroom bao. Very reasonable pricing: we ordered slightly more than recommended and both had a cocktail and dessert and we paid £40 each including service. Easy on public transport. Lovely lovely staff, and they popped a candle on my dessert for my bday. Already planning my next trip back

The fact that this is our GO TO place for every special family occasion says a lot . The ambiance is very Peckham cool, the service is always friendly and the food is most delicious. The umami flavours are epic. And the Specials. And the cocktails..And the fluffiness of the bao buns…And you need to book to avoid disappointment…And I could go on forever.

Wonderful place, I came here for an anniversary for the first time, and was not disappointed. Delicious food, lovely atmosphere and fantastic service. Our waitress was Jess, who I have to give a special shoutout to for her incredibly warm and friendly service which made our night even more special. (Her colleagues were also lovely). Everything was top-notch, what else could you want?

Went to Mr Bao with a large group for a birthday and the whole experience was perfect from start to finish. The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, especially considering how big our table was. Everything ran smoothly and we never felt rushed.

The pork belly and brisket baos were absolutely next level, but special shoutout to the sticky BBQ corn ribs and the handmade dumplings which were unreal. The flavoured sake is also a must. So good.

Will definitely be going back. Highly recommend.

Always a delight! The prawn and tamarind bao specials are incredible. I also had the special cocktail, the Szchuan Spritz - one of the best cocktails I've had in a while! Ask for a taster of the cocktails to help you decide which one to get!

Overall a very nice experience and was the first time here. The service was grand, the staff were super friendly, quick service and the food tasted delicious.

There were also specials to also choose from, not too much on the menu which I think is always a good thing, plenty of wine choices to complement the food.

Got there early evening on a thursday and then the restaurant was full, shows popularity and you could feel the place has been there a while and was a lovely evening.

Would go again and recommend it to anyone who enjoys Italian food.

Solid A*****

LDT x

Authentic little Italian which transports you straight to the Italian countryside!

Beautiful food, simple, honest and excellent cookery. 3 courses x 3 people and not one was flawed. Fantastic wine and lovely service by warm and professional staff.

Such a pleasure coming here..already booking for another trip for my birthday!

Gorgeous little gem of a restaurant! Classic family style Italian. Reasonably priced, tucked away in a corner of good old Peckham. Food is so fresh and tasty. Cosy atmosphere, great menu options. Excellent service from the lovely Alice.

The desserts were really good! As main dishes we had pasta, which was also tasty.
The Atmosphere has a cute Italian vibe and the service was friendly and attentive.

We had a lovely dinner at Il Giardino. My sis and I went at opening time to avoid the crowds. The waiter was friendly and the upstairs seating area was lovely. All of the courses were tasty and beautifully presented. We will definitely go back when possible.

name: Silk Road
address: 47 Camberwell Church St, London SE5 8TR, UK

reviews.text: The food here is quite good but depending on which dish you order - we love the hand pulled noodles delicious but one of the dish we ordered , shish lamb noodle dish doesn’t have much flavour apart form cumin - I would not recommend this dish. Having said that the other dishes were really good. I would definitely recommend this place but choose your dish wisely.

We were big fans of this place in its rustic former incarnation, so worried about the refurbishment, but fears were unfounded. It’s been done really tastefully and the food is better than we remembered it. Somehow the prices don’t seem to have been bumped up for the renovation either. The pork with black fungus, as well as the aubergine were particularly memorable.

The food smelled great and the restaurant was surprisingly nice and modern. They seemed to have a lot of lamb on the menu but when we got the dish it was definitely beef being sold as lamb with hardly much meat in general. As a chef myself I can tell the difference. Also ordered what was supposed to be chive and shrimp dumplings but again lacking the protein and seemed to be mainly just chives. To end, the waiters could be friendlier.

Don't get the hype. Food is quite oily and service is average. Good for those who love the szechuan peppers flavour and looking for a quick feed. Portion sizes, especially the noodles are large and prices are decent but unsure if this worth travelling out of the way for. Would have liked more protein in the noodles and more flavour in the cucumber salad

Seriously impressed! Food was fresh, hot and delicious. We particularly enjoyed the hand pulled noodles with chicken dish. Was so so good!

The service was superb, friendly and efficient. My wife and I enjoyed everything ordered with our two sons who have just moved to Camberwell. I think Silk Road will become a firm favoured return spot for them! Loved it!

name: Enish Old Kent Road
address: 610 Old Kent Rd, London SE15 1JB, UK

reviews.text:
We held a group get together here for my husbands memorial celebration.
The service was fab.  The lady who served us was very patient and delightful.
We had a guest arrive in a wheelchair, which i forgot to tell the restaurant, however they dealt with it no fuss.  Thank you. Very much appreciated.
The food was served so quickly.
The only negative was the cost.  A small serving of moin-moin in a plastic tub, not even a leaf was £10.  Same price as takeaway too.

Every Saturday from 6pm they offer a buffet of a variety of delicious Nigerian dishes for £35. The staff are attentive and helpful, special acknowledgement for Sam who was always attentive to the guests and exceptionally helpful to us and ensured my aunt had a lovely birthday dinner at the restaurant. He’s an asset to the establishment and went over and beyond.
I had a great time here, good food and amazing decor. Will be back!!!

Came here with a friend to try out African cuisine, our very first experience. Our waiter was very helpful in explaining what some dishes were and told us what other customers were having to give us an idea of what the food looked like. He also boiled  hot water for me since they don’t serve hot drinks. I needed it as it was very cold that day.  I ordered the grilled croaker that came with plantain and coleslaw accompanied by a fish sauce. It had a good spicy kick, obviously. Very tasty, did find the fish very dry, maybe that’s how it should be. Loved the fish sauce, plantain was a bit hard, but a good portion. The menu stated salad with the fish but it was coleslaw, l didn’t like it. I think it’s best placed with a simple salad as the fish was already flavourful. My friend had the lamb suya with yam soup which was delicious, very tasty and flavoursome. Our waiter then packed my fish to take away since l couldn’t finish it. I hope he enjoys the large tip we personally handed him.
The ladies toilet is downstairs, it’s clean and big, so could ideally fit another cubicle.
Overall, a lovely meal. We hope to be back soon!

Best Nigerian Buffet I have had in a long time. I had always looked down on Nigerian buffets after my first and second time at Nigerian buffets left me with nothing but regrets, but this was done superbly. I can't fault it. Fair price and great options. Drinks are good and food is restocked in a timely manner. Very accommodating staff

Artusi is a charming and authentic yet trendy Italian restaurant in London that beautifully balances tradition and modern flair. The menu stays true to classic Italian roots, offering a thoughtful selection of dishes made with clear passion and top-quality ingredients. Each plate is presented with care, showcasing both simplicity and elegance. The restaurant itself has a warm, cozy atmosphere, and the friendly staff bring a genuine Italian vibe that makes you feel instantly welcome. While I found the portions a little on the smaller side, every bite was flavorful and satisfying, leaving me appreciating the quality over quantity. Overall, Artusi is a delightful spot for anyone seeking an authentic Italian dining experience with a touch of contemporary style.

Fab lunch at Artusi. On Sundays it is a set menu, which makes it more manageable for the staff and is also easier if you have a member in your party that finds making dish selections tricky... ;) The dishes were imaginative, very tasty and of decent portions. Large selection of Negronis. Attentive service. I wish there wasn't a time limit on our stay to make it a proper Italian meal experience... Will definitely be back.

A truly excellent food experience. Dishes are lovingly and expertly prepared. There's a home cooked feel to the dishes yet there's also sophistication. Me is change frequently, The ingredients were seasonal. Definitely worth coming back many times over
Good place for the chef’s menu. Cozy and cute but it was really stuffy inside and too warm.

A nice restaurant, vibe and idea in theory. The drinks were lovely and bread and butter were lovely. Some of our party liked the fennel salad a lot but it wasn’t for me. I was the only vegetarian and it did feel like my dish was an afterthought…it was quite bland and all the dishes were quite small so I did leave quite hungry. Didn’t get very welcoming vibes from staff unfortunately!

name: Hanar
address: Arch 163 Peckham Rye, London SE15 4ST, UK

reviews.text:
Amazing the place! The food is simply moist watering! 🤤
My partner and I had Kubbe, the Pistachio Dip and Za'ar Fries as starters. All of them were incredible: your could simply taste the high quality of the ingredients. All dishes were very delicately flavoured and the accompanying house wine was a perfect match. The provided quality is amazing considering the reasonable prices!
And the place is is sweetly decorated, truly authentic!
We sat on comfy cushions and the waiter was attentive without being intrusive. I can only recommend!!!

Came here on my own yesterday to have some dinner before meeting friends, got the chicken shawarma with the za’atar fries and the house cocktail. It was very nice, friendly and quick service and very comfortable place to sit and chill for a while. It had just opened for the evening so was empty mostly, but started filling up a bit just before I left around 7:30 ish… Really liked the decor too, it gives the place a very cosy feel. I can imagine it being a great place to come in spring/summer to sit outside…

Came here last Saturday for my 21st and was honestly the best service, food and environment I have ever received. We were given complimentaries aswell as an extended period on our table due to us overstaying and they were so lovely about it. I would 100000% recommend this place and honestly is such a hidden gem.

Amazing hidden spot off rye lane! The food was delicious - we came to try the pistachio dip but fell in love with all the dips and the platters are excellent portions to share. Service was so friendly - thanks Raman for giving the best recommendations. To top it all off, the vibe is elite with the music and decor. We'll be back!
Amazing Kurdish food with a lovely atmosphere. We ordered the veg sharing platter for two - highly recommend!

name: Francesco's
address: 53 Camberwell Church St, London SE5 8TR, UK

reviews.text: Decided to try something new after a gym session and this was the spot!! Good customer service! The place was tidy and the tables were clean!! Even got outside seating!! I was baffled at first as i thought the wrap was gonna be like a kebab wrap, but it was a pizza rolled up forming a wrap. I ordered a Chicken and Mushroom pizza, never tried this before but it was very nice!! A lot a carbs lol but it was extremely filling!!! Definitely sticking to pizza next time as some parts of the wrap was very doughy!!!! Definitely worth an encore!!!!!!!

Unfortunately we can’t leave a proper review as the food never arrived. We were told it was JustEat but looking back, we never actually got any tracking information and only relied on what the restaurant said each time we called. Every time we rang they said it’s JustEat’s problem but to be honest it could easily just be the restaurant not preparing or delivering anything and we wouldn’t know. The guy on the phone just says it’s not their problem and hangs up. Don’t be fooled by offers or cheap prices and just order from somewhere else, at least you’ll get the food you paid your hard earned money for. :)

You can’t beat these £5 pizzas! This is my local and I go here as often as I can. The pizzas are great, there’s not always a huge amount of protein on them but for a fiver you can’t complain. I’ve been getting into the “carbonara” recently which comes with a hash brown on top! Sometimes the dough is still a little soft in areas and when it’s busy there are long queues but worth it for a cheap tasty and filling dinner.

My brother and i ordered on Uber Eats. He got the Carbonara with Pancetta with “extra cheese” and i got the Gnocchi alla Sorrentina. All for £24.
As you can see on the picture, we ate a bit it. But, can we be honest, where is the ““extra cheese””? We’ve searched everywhere but all we could find was an extra dried block of cheese, salt and pepper. We really tried to eat, but it is so salty and peppery that it makes it impossible. We’ve seen plenty of bad reviews but still decided to give it a try, looks like we should have listened to those bad reviews.

Love this place! Been thinking to come here for a year… and finally we did!

Lovely fresh pizzas with loads of of toppings I highly recommend coming here if you haven’t already!

name: Esq Resto Lounge
address: 817 Old Kent Rd, London SE15 1NX, UK

reviews.text: The service was excellent. I enjoyed the food, my wife and I thought it tasted very good and I think we are picky as it relates to good food. The drinks were very good. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone hoping to have a good time. It was my 20th wedding anniversary and it was a blast.

We had a bad experience overall in the restaurant. We arrived around 00:30 and they took the order after 15 min. People kept invading our personal space. NOT GOOD AT ALL!!!!!!!!
I get the place is busy but you can’t neglect your guests, especially with a small place like that. To make it WORSE, we waited for more than AN HOUR FOR THE FOOD TO ARRIVE. I’m so disappointed. Never experienced such thing. At the end, they had the audacity to charge us the full price after the HORRIBLE SERVICE. Avoid at all….

I loved it here I would say we came and it was busier than usual so it took a little time to get drinks to the table but they did compensate with better service and double drinks. I was sad they didn't ask about how I wanted my steak but its okay next time I will say it, I did clean my plate though! Overall I had a good time great vibes GBM is a good host and our server was great too I didn't catch her name.

Eniola was our server and provided our group with good customer service.  Our drinks were refreshed without having to wait or flag her down.

The food was lovely and delicious- the lamb chop and beef short ribs alongside the plantain (which was a lot) was cooked very well.  The wings and salad/broccoli/corn was also well done.

The food portion may look small but after all the drinks you have is FILLING.

The atmosphere and music was chef’s kiss- such a vibe!

I would recommend and come again.

had such an amazing time at ESQ Restaurant & Bar! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was electric the music was on point all night, creating the perfect vibe for dinner and dancing.
The food was absolutely delicious  full of flavor, beautifully presented, and served hot and fresh. Every dish we tried was a hit, and the cocktails were just as good!
The staff were friendly and kept the energy high, making sure everyone was having a great time. The whole experience felt like the perfect mix of great dining and a lively night out.
If you’re looking for a place in London with amazing food, great music, and a fun crowd, ESQ is definitely the spot. I’ll 100% be coming back soon!

Tiger prawns for starters in a spicy sauce. This was delicious with that promised kick from the chillies. For the main, I decided to try the steak which came with chips and salad. I had a lovely cut and the chips were chunky and seasoned. I tasted the pizza with meat and cheese too.  It was very flavoursome and filling. We took food home in a box. The tirimasu was just as you expect the classic dessert to taste. It was fairly quiet on the early Friday evening that I visited and that felt good, just to sit by the window watching the world go by with the soft music playing in the background. The waitress was very welcoming and she added to the positive experience. Happy to return one day.

Just had the most delicious fresh frutti di mare pasta at Dai Due Fratelli 🍝🦐🐚 The dessert was divine and the service absolutely exceptional. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for authentic Italian done right! 🇮🇹✨ Grazie Mille Grecia!
reviews.author_name: Gaby Leon Skin and Laser - Dulwich

reviews.text: Authentic tasty food run by an Italian family.  Their food was delicious and the service was fantastic, the pasta was cooked to perfection and was not the typical pasta you find in the supermarket and their tasty pizzas was done in a wood fired oven, was a nice touch that they peeled the prawn shell for ease however could of done with a bit more garlic.  We had starters main and dessert and we all left with a happy belly.  One negative was they had no changing bed for babies and my nephew had to get changed on the seat which would not be pleasant for other diners and we mentioned we had a bday celebrant and would of been a nice touch to have put a candle or inscription on one of the desserts we ordered, anyhoo this place is a real gem. Definitely will come back

The exterior of the restaurant doesn't quite reflect the charm inside. The venue itself is cosy and inviting, with a wonderful atmosphere. The food was flavorful, and overall, a real treat. While the calamari was a bit tough, the rest of the dishes were absolutely delicious 😋. As for the bathroom, it could use a little attention, but that's a minor detail in an otherwise great experience.

Amazing food- all pastas,as well as pizza , were cooked wonderfully and were really tasty. Staff very friendly and kind. Since everything was cooked fresh, food was adjusted to all the allergy requirements( garlic ,onion).
We will be coming back!

A MUST TRY.
We had the chefs taster menu with the wine pairing. As well as this we were sat at the kitchen table. My partner and I had the most amazing time. The food was on point, drinks were on point and the team were super attentive and were such a great sport. Not a single bad word and we will most certainly be back in the future. We love to spent money on food and the experience that comes with it, and this was worth every penny.

Came here last night for the tasting menu. Absolutely divine food. Shout out to the chefs. The potato broth was beautiful. Also great staff, thanks to Jessica and the man with beautiful gold locks. We had a great night. A must try in Peckham!

We went for lunch and the service was fantastic, waitress was attentive and clearly knew her way around the wine menu.
The food was delicious, the tomato started was our favourite and we ate the fish and the sides way too soon to take a photo!
Little gem worth a visit in Pekham.

Had really high expectations for Levan - not sure if they were met but still a nice meal. We had the taster set menu and then a few additional items like the potatoes. The scallop noodle dish was delicious and I really enjoyed the sourdough bread! But some of the other dishes were a bit odd to be honest - turns out peaches and beans don’t go together! Quite a spenny experience but no regrets overall as it was interesting - glad I tried.

One of my favourite restaurant in the area and London. Bold flavours, hearty and refined. Friendly staff, just right for this type of dining. If you are an educated foodie I wouldn’t recommend enough this restaurant.
And now looking forward to trying their new wine bar next door.

name: Love Dulwich Turkish BBQ & Meze Restaurant

reviews.text:
🔥 Experience the True Taste of Turkish BBQ in London! 🔥

Looking for a place where flavor, quality, and atmosphere come together? Visit Love Dulwich Turkish BBQ & Meze Restaurant and enjoy one of the best Turkish dining experiences in London!

From perfectly grilled BBQ to delicious traditional Meze, every bite is full of authentic Turkish flavor. The food presentation is beautiful, the atmosphere is cozy, and the taste is simply unforgettable.

⭐ Rated 4.9 by hundreds of happy customers
🍽 Authentic Turkish BBQ & Meze
👨‍👩‍👧 Perfect place for friends & family
📍 Lordship Lane, London

Once you try it, you’ll definitely want to come back again!

Tag your foodie friends and plan your next dinner here!

#TurkishFood #LondonRestaurants #BBQLovers #FoodieLondon #FoodExperience #LoveDulwich #LondonEats #FoodVibes #MustTry

We were looking for a place to have a late lunch and kitchens along lordship lane were closed, so really it was unplanned to end up at Love - and goodness me what a discovery!

'Love' is a little Mediterranean cuisine gem on the lane. The food was delicious, the service impeccable and the atmosphere was beautifully cosy - the choice of ambience music was great and just at the right volume (this makes a difference!).
We will be returning, they have earned a new family as customers!

Very nice experience dining at LOVE Dulwich. We were greeted and seated immediately, and served water soon after. The menu and choices of meals all sounded divine! Food arrived hot, flavourful and very well presented. We shall be back!

Very nice and friendly environment! The food came out very quickly did not have to wait long but the smoothie was 10/10 so fresh and delicious! Also very clean inside you can tell a lot of effort has gone into it!

Love the place! We went to celebrate our wedding anniversary and it was amazing choice. Food was delicious and full of flavour. Atmosphere romantic, welcoming, comfortable and cozy. Service was amazing! We will return

name: Tigella
address: 119 Peckham High St, London SE15 5SE, UK

reviews.text: A really great little restaurant. No over ambitious menu, but what is served is excellent. The Tigelle are little circular flat breads, lovely and soft inside but crispy on the outside. We had starters of the Tigelles with mushrooms and separately with tomatoes and oil, a take on brushetta. For mains we had steak and chips (generous and prepared well), spinach and ricotta tortellini and a platter of cheeses, including whole burratta, with rocket, plumbs and cherry tomatoes, with a basket if tigelle. Wine was very good and the staff were very helpful, friendly and professional. Had a great night as a family in this lovely little restaurant. Definitely recommend.
Brilliant place. Delicious food. Fantastic value for money. It was our 1st time, but we will go back k again and again.
So glad to have found this gem. Hands down the best tagliatelle I have ever had in London (we tried the one with mixed mushrooms). The tigelle board was great too. Will definitely come back.

Best restaurant in the area, by far!!!
Food is amazing. The Tigella bread is heaven-sent! Honestly, all the food is fresh and amazing.
Also, prices are affordable and definitely worth it for the quality of food and service.
Friendly and helpful staff.
Will definitely return and grab this place to everyone I know. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

The steaks here are absolutely amazing. I’ve been a couple of times now and don’t understand how more people aren’t aware how amazing the food is! Must try in Peckham!! Service very friendly and food is so well priced. Please gooo!!!!

name: Serybi's Grill
address: 24 Peckham Park Rd, London SE15 6TW, UK

reviews.text:
This is a hidden gem right next to the Old Kent Road Mc Donalds.

The food here is amazing and I highly recommend trying the sea bass, chicken and lamb. I love the flavours and it was all very well seasoned.

The service was super friendly. Fabrice is a great host

The cocktails were tasty too. Can't go wrong with a rum Chapman

Best Ivorian restaurant I’ve tasted ever, it’s worth every single pound. The restaurant was very beautifully set up, the staff were very professional and very friendly, we came just on time and the service was so fast for an African restaurant.

Food was made fresh and tasted amazing
🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 10/10!!! Hands down, I’ll definitely be there again

Parking right in front of the restaurant and it’s free onsite, there’s parking also at Asda but it’s only for 2hrs which isn’t enough time unless your just quickly getting a takeaway.

Prices were very reasonable, there isn’t any lift so make sure to leave your pushchair in the car, also it’s not wheelchair accessible as to reach the restaurant it’s stairs but the have a lovely outside seating area which would be nice when the weather is hot.

Overall, I’ll definitely come again and book a dinner party here.
Truly cannot fault this place. The food was flavoursome, the portion sizes were very generous, the service was good, the cocktails were delicious and very strong! Definitely recommend!

To be frank, I was very disappointed with the £25 container. I ordered prawns with vegetables and Attieke, which I've never tried before; it tasted like a bland gari couscous with a sour aftertaste. Although I enjoyed the pepper sauce, the portion seemed small, especially considering it was labelled as containing vegetables, but only had a few bell peppers and onions. The location, situated beside a lounge on the main Old Kent Road near Asda, had an awkward entrance and wasn't wheelchair accessible. Be prepared for a 20-30 minute wait for takeaway.

Furthermore, the food easily fit into a medium-sized plastic container. It would be more honest of them to serve it in that, as it's a more realistic portion. The hype surrounding it didn't live up to my expectations, which is disappointing as I was really looking forward to enjoying it.

I've attached a photo for reference, showing what I ordered compared to what I actually received.
Food was absolutely delicious! I enjoyed every meal I had. The service was also excellent! One of the yummiest food I have had and packed with flavour.

I dined here for my birthday with my husband last night.

The place is warm and intimate. The staff were friendly and attentive.

We had the Tavern Gully land of wood & water "run a boat" Inna Peckham Rye, crispy curry lamb nuggets with 24Kt yellow gold curry dust, cucumber, scallion& curry gravy dip. It was delicious and piping hot.

For my main I had Chargrilled suya spiced/ 30 day aged 8 oz sirloin steak/ smoked aubergine puree nested crispy garden egg/ okra twigs/ palm wine glaze. The presentation was outstanding and the steak was mouth watering.

My husband had Chargrilled butterflied sea bass, stir fried pak choi with shredded carrots, sea lettuce, ginger, garlic, chard green lime, scallion/ red red sauce. It was so soft and delicious.

As sides we had both the jollof rice & the plantain; both were sensational.

We had a margarita and a glass of orange wine which were both great and lasted our entire meal.

Would definitely recommend to try something a little different.

The food was absolutely amazing! Will definitely recommend the lamb nuggets!!
The sirloin steak was cooked to perfection, no need to send it back….
Oh the atmosphere! The music you play indoors but never hear outside!
The ambiance and food second to none!
A hidden Gem!

Had dinner her with my friends and it was lovely. The food and drinks were delicious. We had the prawns, steak, plantain, and rice. Everything was cooked and seasoned perfectly.

The service was also great. Everyone was welcoming and the staff gave great recommendations.

Highly recommend this cozy restuarant!

Absolutely loved my meal here! The food was fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with care. Every bite was satisfying, and the presentation was beautiful too. The service made the experience even better. I’ll definitely be coming back and recommending this place to others.

Curry lamb balls for starters with the gravy was delicious! Still thinking about them.  We had the prawns and steak for mains and both were perfectly cooked and gorgeous smoky flavours. The rum punch was sweet and well balanced. Will come back with friends and family definitely x

A wonderful experience on our first night in the Camberwell area. It was a Sunday night and we were the only people in the place, but the warmth of the host made it special experience. Food was amazing with large portions, freshly cooked and delicious. Our host chatted with us until other patrons arrived and served us complimentary liqueurs. What a lovely place. Would love to return.

Came here for a dinner date. The atmosphere and staff were incredible, I really enjoyed my time there even though it was a quiet Sunday evening.

I had the moussaka and my partner had the pastitsio. To be honest we both thought the food to be good not great HOWEVER we also ordered items that tend not to be made to order, and therefore it isn’t fair to judge the menu based on that. We will 100% be back to try some of the grilled meats and other offerings.
The tzatziki and warm bread was a delicious starter.

I’d recommend this restaurant to anyone who likes classic Greek food and ambiance. It’s perfect for larger groups too!

Nice atmosphere with seating inside and outside and windows that open fully to the outside seating area. It’s a nice vibe and the food was alright with prices not too bad. Some of the grilled meats we had were a little dry and the fries not seasoned. Service was good and staff friendly. I think there was new staff on the day we went there and that person was a little slow and lost but in general it was fine.
Really good food and friendly staff and nice relaxed atmosphere.  I will be going again and highly recommend others to try it out.

Just had a delicious meal here today with a friend. We got the sharing vegetarian meze, absolutely delicious and a great variety of dishes that were of superb quality. The second course of vegetarian moussaka was equally as good. For dessert the baklava was really fantastic.
Great service with very friendly attentive staff. I highly recommend a visit!

name: Persepolis
address: 28-30 Peckham High St, London SE15 5DT, UK

reviews.text:
Got the festive 6 course menu including dessert and drink for £30, great value, was extremely extremely full (even though we didn't have lunch).

Not every dish was amazing, I found the green sauce at the end a bit bitter for example (though the rice it came with was very good). However I still give it 5 stars purely because I cannot stop thinking about the fried halloumi, it's just so so so good. And the hummus, falafel, and Cheetos? was so good!

They explained every dish as well, service was good, atmosphere on the rooftop terrace was good.
Warm atmosphere and quirky place. The ash and the cheesecake were highlights, unfortunately just a bit disappointed by the rice and bread !! Would be 5 stars otherwise as it was lovely.
Came here for a Birthday today, such a fantastic experience. The feasting menu option is so joyful and generous. Team incredibly welcoming. Thank you so much !
Had the tasting menu with my partner and it was absolutely incredible. Great value, we could barely finish it. Service was also amazing. It's obvious they're proud of their food and they should be 😊
Such a lovely place to chill out, chat and have yummy treats! There was 10 of us and we had some very impressive looking desert tasting platters and sat on the roof terrace which was so nice.
Loves the atmosphere and food with my daughter, the food was excellent and we took away gorgeous spicy chicken 🍗 drumsticks to enjoy later. We'll be back! ♥️

If you’re ever in the area and fancy a burger and chips, then this is the place to go. The burgers are big, the portions sizes are great and there is a wide variety of choices to pick from.

I had the dirty chicken burger and was not expecting the chicken breast to be 3x the size of the bun (regardless was very nice), their hash browns with Parmesan on top were very tasty and the chips were great too. All round 10/10.

I would highly recommend.

The atmosphere is delightful , and the staff are really welcoming, friendly and helpful. Without a doubt, Meatliquor East Dulwich has got a fantastic team.

Hello, I discovered this interesting restaurant on Sunday. I found the atmosphere very pleasant, the music good, and the comfort, a true haven for a moment with friends. The food is beautifully presented, the portions are balanced /generous, and the culinary expertise is evident. The flavor is excellent. The value for money is very advantageous for the customer. They have a wide variety of products for all tastes. I highly recommend this place for an afternoon. Incredible!

I visited MEATliquor Dulwich East on 4th March and it was the worst dining experience I’ve ever had. We ordered mozzarella dippers, a Dead Hippie burger, a buffalo chicken burger, garlic fries and two Coke Zeros, and waited an hour for our food. Our starter never arrived, and when the mains finally came the chips were cold and the burgers were lukewarm, tiny, and served in seeded buns nothing like what we’ve had before. A waiter later told us the kitchen “couldn’t cook” the mozzarella dippers because they kept falling apart in the fryer, which raises the question of why they’re even on the menu. We sent the chips back and a second portion only arrived after we’d finished eating, and they were oily, tough and inedible. We were offered mac and cheese bites as an apology, but after waiting another half hour they never arrived, and when we asked, the waiter said he’d told the chef and that “someone else was doing it.” Throughout the visit we were ignored while online orders were prioritised. I also witnessed serious hygiene issues: two waiters repeatedly entering the kitchen without hair nets or gloves, moving between dirty plates, food prep and drinks with unwashed hands. I am currently wheelchair‑bound after surgery and had my leg elevated; despite raising concerns about the long wait because I was in pain, I was ignored. When we finally asked for the bill, the mozzarella dippers were still included despite never arriving, and we had to request the removal of the discretionary service charge. The entire experience - from poor food quality to unacceptable delays, lack of communication, hygiene breaches and disregard for accessibility - was deeply disappointing, and after years of loyalty we won’t be returning.

Edit after response from owner: I have not received an email response from the owner as noted by them below to date
Great staff - shout out to Nicki, Ava and Sofia. Dealt with 14 of us with zero issues and were so good natured. Food is consistently good.

A total gem of a restaurant. First time having Malaysian food and it was incredible - beautifully presented and full of flavour. The mocktails were also delicious. The staff here are so friendly and attentive and they give to charity - if you buy the Invisible Rice they give the price to a local charity- Pecan. We will definitely be back.

What a lovely evening at Janda, myself and 3 guests really enjoyed the 5 star experience, our host for the evening was Lanny,  who made us feel very welcome.
We had starters to share which where delicious.
2 of our guests had the beef Rendang and said it was the best they had ever tasted. I had the steak and my wife had the sea bass both very generous portions and cooked to perfection.
Our night was lovely,  so, many thanks to everyone at Janda. We will be back very soon.

After hearing the buzz about Janda Diner, we just had to go and we weren't disappointed, it definitely lived up its reputation.  We were there on Boxing Day evening for their set menu, everything was so tasty and fresh, and so beautifully presented  -  the beef was incredible, I had to take photos (I'm someone who doesnt take photos of food!!  ha ha).  The restaurant itself is small, but cozy and very welcoming, the waiting staff were so friendly and went above and beyond.  If you haven't been you are really missing out.  Big thanks Janda Diner, we shall definitely be back!

Absolutely fabulous food and non-alcoholic cocktails! I had the amazing fish head curry (sea bream) – it was full of flavour, beautifully presented and just delicious. The staff are very welcoming and very attentive too. A great place for any occasion.

As a Malaysian living in Europe. I enjoyed every bite that I had dining at Janda Diner. I had Jackfruit salad, beef harimau menangis , Ayam masak merah and pannacotta as dessert. The quality of meat and protein were super tender. The flavor was very tasty and and very well seasoned.  The level of spiciness and tanginess just right a harmony combination  for taste pallet.  The presention were gorgeous .

Highly recommended for adventurous foodie and alao for those who are looking for something new and NOT just a standard regular meals with a nice company.

Would come and dine in again soon. Keep up the good work and creativity.

name: Kartuli - Georgian Restaurant in East Dulwich, London
address: Kartuli, 65 Lordship Ln, London SE22 8EP, UK

reviews.text: This was my first time eating Georgian food and I wasn't disappointed. I didn't know they had so many vegan dishes. The food is so delicious, hearty and full of flavour. There are many dishes with nuts and beans so it's perfect for vegans. I had the rolled aubergines with walnuts, bread filled with beans (to share), beans stew and the blood orange sorbet. Also, the decor is super cute and cosy, and the staff is lovely.

Had my first Georgian food experience for birthday celebration and it made my day. We had Western Georgian salad, lamb shank, mushroom khinkali and pelamushi and they all taste good. Great service, quiet for chatting. Give it a go if you want to try Georgian cuisine.

This is not our first time dinning at Kartuli and as always it was an absolutely phenomenal experience from start to finish. This is, without a doubt, the best Georgian restaurant in London.
​The food is truly spectacular. Their Khachapuri is perfection,gooey, cheesy, and baked to golden-brown excellence. The moment it arrives at the table, you know you’re in for a treat. Similarly, the Khinkali (Georgian dumplings) are plump, juicy, and expertly folded. They are a must-try for any first-timer!
​The wine selection is equally impressive. We drink a bottle between two everytime we go ☺️ - I highly recommend trying one of their Georgian Red Wines, particularly the Saperavi or, for a fantastic naturally semi-sweet option, the famous Kindzmarauli. It’s the perfect, rich accompaniment to the hearty dishes and really completes the authentic Georgian feast.🍷
​What truly sets this restaurant apart, however, is the atmosphere and service. The staff is incredibly friendly, welcoming, and attentive, making you feel like a guest in a Georgian home rather than just a customer. The warmth and genuine hospitality create a wonderfully convivial, friendly atmosphere that makes every visit special. The service is prompt and always delivered with a smile.
​If you are looking for authentic Georgian cuisine, exceptional wine, and an evening defined by a genuine, friendly atmosphere and fantastic service, look no further. This place is a real gem!✨🇬🇪🤍

First time trying Georgian food! We came for a Saturday night date night and had a great time. The restaurant is in a former greengrocers and has a lot of the original features which gives it a fun and cozy atmosphere. The khachapuri was a particular highlight but definitely try the honey cake for dessert as well!

Absolutely amazing place! 🤍
The atmosphere is so cozy and authentic, with beautiful interior details that make you feel like you’re in Georgia.
The food was delicious khinkali, khachapuri, and salads were all perfect!
The service was friendly and fast. Definitely one of the best Georgian restaurants in London 🇬🇪✨
Highly recommend!

I had a fantastic experience here! The place is spotless and feels very cozy thanks to the lighting and design. The service was admirable—the waitresses were incredibly kind and attentive. The food was delicious and beautifully presented, offering excellent value for money. Definitely a hidden gem that you don't want to miss!

So glad to see Nandine open again on Vestry Road - best Kurdish food in town! Everything was absolutely delicious.
We had: PAQLA
Pan-seared tava beans in pomegranate
molasses with chilli butter, paprika and mint

SHEPHERDS SALAD
Cucumber, tomato, parsley, red onion, pomegaranate and molasses

AUBERGINE PLATTER
Three way aubergine; Aubergine strip salad. Smoked baba ganoush
Aubergine, chickpea, tomato qawarma. Served with za'atar flatbread

LAMB SHANK QOZI
Seared Lamb shank and the slow-cooked for 4 hours, with tomato, onion garlic, green pepper and potato. topped with fried rosemary,

Only comment is that the small text for V, GF and prices on the menu is almost invisible! Might be my age.

Great food. Loved the lamb burger and the mezze platter, so many fantastic colours and spices, very well presented. The chips with the pomegranate and mint were amazing. The customer service was on point. The waiter was very knowledgeable about the food and the menu. Will definitely come back again.

What a hidden gem. My favourite place of 2023 so far! We ordered -
✨Shifta Burger with fries- Burger comes with 2 shifta patties which are full of flavours so you could have a juicy bite of beef in every bite.  Loved the Beharat fries as well. They were seasoned with some mild spice mix & a sauce which was sooo good.

✨Mezze Dips- It comes with a selection of dips and a Za’atar bread. Their Red pepper dip is to die for. So yumm! The dips are good enough for 2 breads.

Veggie Mezze- Kubba dumplings were so tasty that I might order a separate plate of kubba dumplings when I visit next.

7 spice chicken and rice- The chicken was so tender yet juicy and flavourful.  So so good!

All the dishes were amazing but my fav was the shifta burger with fries.  Highly recommend this place for good Kurdish food.

Would highly recommend for breakkie or lunch. The breakfast platter was delicious and we shared baklava for a sweet treat. The boreks also looked amazing which I would get if passing! Only downfall was my oat milk latte which was possibly the strongest coffee I’ve ever had… almost undrinkably so!

name: Dinner for One Hundred (D4100 TELE HILL)
address: The Hill Station, Kitto Rd, London SE14 5TW, UK

reviews.text: The BEST pizza I’ve had in London. Truly the tastiest crispiest base, with fresh ingredients, a stunning sauce. The pizza selection was sensational! The staff were friendly and there was a lovely area for seating. I got the Kevin and I would never think to put leek in a pizza but it was genuinely sensational, the perfect soft sweetness blended perfectly with the meat. And the Nduja dip was the perfect creamy smokey sauce that complimented everything so well. If you’re in the area, it would be a shame to not come here!

Extremely cosy atmosphere and friendly staff. The pizza was so delicious, the best pizza I’ve eaten in a while. The breakfast snacks were also very tasty (we’ve eaten some spinach rolls and banana cake). A must-see for both tourists and locals!
We regularly get their pizzas and honestly can’t find anything better in South! They are so good!! Got a take away from them today and it arrived piping hot and the delivery driver was lovely. 10/10

Dinner For 100’s founders Jake and Jacob came to my place of work-a charity stables in Brixton-to do some media for a promo they were doing in relation to the luna new year 2026-year of the horse.
J and J were awesome and so complimentary of the work we do with the young people in the Brixton area. They were so kind to not only the humans but the horses that live with us.
They genuinely wanted to learn about the horses and the work we do to change lives for our young people we support and are keen supporters of local charities- ahead of their Brixton store opening.
This is so lovely to see in a small business and we look forwards to seeing them again in the future.
Thanks guys!
Fluffy dough, thin slices, toppings that use the best quality ingredients, delicious dipping sauces, artisanal taste and feel. Simply the best pizzas I’ve had in London.

name: El Señorio Criollo
address: 12 Peckham Park Rd, London SE15 6TW, UK

reviews.text:
After all these years living in London, I’ve finally found a place that truly represents real Peruvian food. Everything is cooked with love and authenticity, generous portions, fair prices, and excellent service. Edwin (who looked after us) was amazing, and the whole team is from Peru. You can really taste the tradition in every dish. My friends ordered pollo a la brasa and I ordered duo Marino which is ceviche and pescado frito.
It’s a bit hidden and not right in the centre, but that’s what makes it such a gem. If you’re looking for authentic Peruvian food in London, this is the place.
Amazing authentic Peruvian food. Loved the Ceviche Mixto and Cassava Fries. Totally worth it and the owners are super friendly with a family atmosphere to the place.

Cannot express how much I loved this restaurant.
The moment you arrive you're greeted as if you're family. The food was incredible and the atmosphere was very joyful.
Three of us went for lunch and all three dishes were packed full of incredible flavour.
We can't wait to come back!

My friend had been here multiple times, said it was decent, and so me and another friend went there for dinner with him one Saturday evening.
The place was fairly busy, but we managed to get a table.
I skipped the starters and went straight for the main course and chose the seco de cordero (£18).
A lamb based dish served with rice, beans, small salad, and yuca potato.
A lovely dish indeed and all the elements went well together...the rice wasn't overcooked and the beans in the suace were flavoursome.
The meat itself was a big chunk, tasty, but a bit dry if being honest....but very filling and hearty.
For dessert, I went for the Tres Leches cake (£5) as my friend had recommended it, so I gave it a go.
It's wasn't too sweet, which was good, and the layers of cream and milk kept it lovely and moist...the sweet cinnamon flavour also made it the perfect dessert to end the meal with.
So, in the area and fancy some Peruvian food! This place is definitely worth a go.
Friendly and relaxed staff. :)

I really enjoyed the food here — everything was fresh, well-prepared, and full of flavor. The staff was friendly and the service was smooth. The atmosphere was welcoming, making it a great spot for a casual meal or dinner out. Definitely recommend!

name: Lit Lounge Uk
address: 136 New Cross Rd, London SE14 5BA, UK

reviews.text:
OVERVIEW
Table consensus: A very good African restaurant with great food!

PLUS
+ The ‘Suya Jumbo Prawns’ were unanimously rated 5* by the table — everyone ordered them after sampling. However, non-African palates may find its heat overpowering 🔥.
+ Most side dishes were generous in portion sizes (i.e. ‘Plantain Sticks’ and ‘Yam’).
+ ‘Mac & Cheese’ was flavourful but very cheesy.
+ Quick and accurate streamlined system that allowed everyone to pay their share separately.
+ The waitress was professional, patient and attentive.
+ A modern, chic restaurant and the music played complemented the cuisine served.

MINUS
- Over an hour’s wait for mains at a table of four!
- They did not accommodate simple meal alteration requests, such as a swap of side sauces.
- The ‘Succulent Jerk Chicken’ was neither fiery nor succulent — more guava-glazed than Jerk. The portion was small and the chicken dry.

TABLE ORDERS
Starters:
* SUYA JUMBO PRAWNS
* SALT & PEPPER KING PRAWNS
Mains:
* SUCCULENT JERK CHICKEN
* CARAMALIZED BBQ LAMB CHOPS
Sides:
* PLANTAIN STICKS
* YAM
* JOLLOF RICE
* MAC & CHEESE

There's nothing Lit about this tiny lounge.
I would not recommend Lit Lounge based on my experience.
We arrived on a Friday night just after 10pm. The venue was almost empty. There were only two of us initially, waiting for two more guests to arrive. We were seated in the shisha lounge, where several other tables also did not have shisha.
Service was slow from the start. Menus took a long time to arrive, and ordering took even longer. We ordered asun with fries and drinks while waiting for the rest of our group.
The first issue arose when staff told us we had to move to a table for two, despite the fact that our group was clearly four and the venue was largely empty. The staff were rude and argumentative. I explained multiple times that we were waiting for two more guests. It eventually took another customer intervening before the staff stopped insisting.
Shortly after that, a different man, who appeared to be the chef, told us we had to leave the shisha lounge because we had not ordered shisha. I asked if they could wait, again explaining that we were waiting for the rest of our group. He said he “didn’t have to wait,” even though the venue was empty and people were actively leaving. This made no sense, especially as there were plenty of other tables available.
Meanwhile, no food or drinks had arrived. We were then told there was no asun available. I asked what was available and agreed to beef suya instead. Still, nothing arrived.
The same man then became rude and aggressive. I calmly said that if they wanted us to leave, they should just say so. He responded that we could go, so we did.
As we were leaving, he continued being rude and even followed us outside, which was completely unacceptable.
This was my first night out in over a year after having a baby. Leaving my crying baby was already stressful, and being harassed in an empty venue made the experience unnecessarily upsetting.
No vibe, no service, and no professionalism, just rude (i see other reviews saying this), aggressive staff in an empty restaurant. The website clearly states that reservations are not required, yet we were treated like an inconvenience.
I would not return.

Went to lit to celebrate a friends birthday the day we arrived really late but we were accommodated so amazing by the staff and owners. Kitchen was closed so they made what could be and we had an amazing time the Jollof: beautiful beyond belief,  the Beef Suya: spicy but so hard to stop eating. Over all lesson learnt to arrive earlier to enjoy the full experience. 10/10 would recommend

Nice venue. Very hospital. Food was delicious and drinks were on point. The only feedback I would give is definitely extra staff to assit when it is a busy period. I think the cutlery should be on the table ready before the food is brought out. I would came here again and I would also recommend to others. I have done a Tik tok video :-)

Visited with a friend for a catch-up. We were both surprised and somewhat disappointed by the smaller and less vibrant reality compared to the website and social media. The 2-for-1 cocktails were decent, but the food was mediocre. The mac and cheese lacked seasoning, and it seemed the flour wasn't cooked out enough in the sauce. The plantain sticks were too hard; given an extra day or two to ripen, they could have been better. My hot BBQ glazed chicken wings were okay, and my friend mentioned the lamb chops needed more seasoning.

Additionally, we experienced a wait of approximately 15-20 minutes for our drinks and an additional 20 minutes for our food.

Come with a right expectation and focus on the food which is delicious!  Good portion, lamb is tenderly cooked. Reasonable price! It's in Peckham not Mayfair, if you expect service and michillen, then you may be disappointed.
Beautiful food. I love Middle Eastern food and this restaurant is particularly unique in the UK Middle Eastern food scene! Second time at Yada's, I hope I'll be back!

I'm really upset with the service. I should be having a special diner right now but instead i was refused to be served, even that on google it says that it would be opened until 22h.
I went to cinema with my husband which is located 5m walk away from this restaurant. Did a booking this afternoon to book a table for 20h30 ( even mentioned i was going to the cinema) Film delayed a bit and i arrived to the,restaurant at 20h50 ( 20m ago) just to be told that the kitchen was closed - 1h30m before restaurant closing? - when i inquired about how come i wasn't informed on the phone that my booking was just on the cut out of the kitchen closing, specially when i even mentioned i was going to cinema and was told that there wouldnt   be a problem- the two people in the restaurant told me that on sundays normally closes earlier and they normally wait 15m ( so 20h45, 5 minutes before i arrived. The kitchen is opened and i could see everything seemed to be packed for way more then 5 minutes. Very unprofessional.
I Used to recommend this restaurant highly because the food is great but definitly won't be coming back. Absolutely outrageous, specialy when i did a booking and was planning to have a special diner.

*  just to add that 30m after this i passed by and was already solid shut. According with google should still be opened another 10m..
Maybe just change your timings online so you don't spoil your client's evening.

Located in Peckham  is  this lovely restaurant, even from down the road I could smell the food. My friends and I really liked the decor of the restaurant and the service and atmosphere was good . To share we had the pistachio hummus and baba ghanoushs , both were great but we collectively agreed that the pistachio hummus was our favourite. The Hajari bread used to dip was absolutely amazing as well, very light and fluffy and just overall a great bread. For mains my friends had the falafel mezze plate and chicken finjan, whereas I had lamb sharwarma. All of us thoroughly enjoyed our mains , lots of flavour and the rice was great but I would say that I could’ve done with a bigger portion of the lamb itself but I still enjoyed it.

Yada’s has to be one of the most authentic Middle Eastern restaurants in London. All the food is delicious but the mezze platter and lamb shawarma are highly recommended as you can try lots of authentic options in small quantities. Our favourites included the pistachio hummus and ghormeh sabzi. The lamb was divine and accompanied by the gorgeous fluffy saffron rice. Can’t wait to go back!

My first time visiting Jerk Sheperd/ Goso the food is amazing. I came around 9pm.The jerk lamb is succulent and has a savoury and sweet spice flavour. Cheesy beef patty was nice and authentic. The dumpling was soft and seasoned slightly reminded me of flatbread aswell. Slaw and plantain were fresh. I don’t mind waiting if the end result is that I get great food and fresh veg.

This place 🤩 the food was delicious!! I left no crumbs! I had a reggae dumplin with jerk chicken amazing!! Everything was fresh the dumplin alone i could have eaten it by itself the jerk chicken was jerking!! The plantin was ripe and sweet and the coleslaw was juicy and overall had a great experience. Customers services was 10/10 will definitely be back to try out the rest of the menu. Ps i think i found my new favourite restaurant in peckham. Keep up the great work ❤️

My self must and My husband Traveled all the way from north West London To the shop just to buy and taste There I believe it’s called reggae stuffed dumpling with either You can have jerk chicken or Boneless curry mutton or Ackee And salt fish but we had curry mutton, stuffed dumpling with planting salad and coleslaw. Let me tell you something the dumpling was so sweet and soft and fluffy the mutton. Everything was just amazing. Go and check it out. It’s in Peckham. It’s called jerk Shepherd. Trust me, It was worth the drive

Large portions
Jerk chicken with sauce
Curry Goat and rice n peas
Plantain
All for £18, (I drop a £20 on the man for being so helpful and polite)
I never go in this place as thought it was ran by an Indian man who usually works the jerk pan and thought they misappropriating Caribbean food and tierfing the culture as usual to line their own pockets

NOT THE CASE

The original owner is still there....

Yard man

Recommended :)

I stopped by Jerk Sheperd/Goso around 9pm for the first time, and the food really impressed me. The jerk lamb was tender and packed with flavour a beautiful balance of savoury and sweet spice that lingered in the best way. The cheesy beef patty had that authentic, homemade feel, and the dumpling was soft, lightly seasoned, and reminded me a bit of flatbread comforting and satisfying.

The slaw and plantain were fresh and bright, adding a nice contrast to the richness of the meal. Honestly, I don’t mind waiting a little if the food’s this good  fresh veg, bold flavours, and care in the cooking make it worth it.

A lovely first visit, and definitely not the last, special thank you to Omario, for making us feel so welcome.

My favourite meal of the year so far. Peckham Bazaar delivers an incredible tour of the Balkans in one sitting, with grilled dishes and mezze that are full of flavour and beautifully balanced. We shared fluffy pitta with a dip, followed by chickpea croquettes, beetroot with whipped mizithra, grilled tiger prawns with Greek orzo, pumpkin and Parmesan manti, and a standout stuffed globe courgette. Every dish was spot on and clearly cooked with care. The atmosphere was warm and buzzy even on a Monday night, and seeing the chef grilling in the open kitchen adds to the experience. A true neighbourhood gem and a must visit in Peckham.

I booked Peckham bazaar for my 26th birthday lunch for 15 people and it was FLAWLESS. The food was incredible and so nice for sharing - no dish missed the spot (although the chicken souvlaki, flat breads and dips, courgette fritters were stand out!). Beyond this, the staff made the experience the most hospitable and lovely I could have ever dreamed of (special shout out to Tim who made my day so so special!). Honestly I rarely leave reviews but this was the best experience and I’m so grateful. Thank you!! Highly recommend to anyone looking for a birthday lunch spot with friends!

Peckham Bazaar is, without question, our favourite restaurant in London.

Tucked away just off Bellenden Road, it feels like one of those rare places that never tries too hard and yet gets everything exactly right. The food is exceptional, thoughtful, seasonal and quietly confident, with Balkan and Eastern Mediterranean influences that feel both comforting and exciting. Every dish is beautifully balanced, generous without being heavy, and clearly cooked with care and skill.

I absolutely love Peckham Bazaar - I have been a few times over the years and went yesterday for lunch with friends. The food was all excellent, great sized portions and the flavours made me feel like I was on holiday in Greece! Gorgeous restaurant ambience and great service. It was my first time sitting inside and it is quite small so definitely book in advance - there’s spill over onto the heated terrace but it was special sitting inside. They made space for our pram and they also allow dogs! 10/10 will be returning again and again

Food here was very nice, good quality and well cooked. Some very nice star dishes. I enjoyed visiting here, book in advance as availability isn't great on the day when I wanted to go. Had to get an earlier meal but that was a Friday night.

The most amazing branch me and my family have been to! The staff were so friendly and nice, they really took good care of us. We went for my brother’s bday and we really enjoyed the food, very good and big portions. We got the buffalo chicken, smash burger and honest burger with buffalo and bbq wings.

Honest burgers are always good and reliable. You won’t have a culinary experience but you know you’ll have good-priced burgers with reasonable quality. Each branch makes things a bit different. In this one, the fries were too salty. Also, the background music was too loud, which some may like, while others may find annoying as it makes it close to impossible to have a conversation. Overall, if you’re in the area and hungry and want a burger, honest is an option that never fails.

Ordered from here on uber eats and was excited as I normally love honest burgers. This is the worst meal I’ve ever received. I ordered my burger medium well and received two raw cold beef patties, the onion rings were also soggy and drowning oil. The slaw was only filled to a quarter of the container and I’d say was two spoons full. This is not my first time ordering from honest burgers but this branch is actually criminal. I was starving but could barely eat anything because everything but the fries was inedible. Beware for food poisoning from this place, I’m so upset because I’ve wasted my money, I’m still hungry and  I feel sick from the bite I took of the burger 🤢

I got the double smash burger with halloumi, and its probably the best burger i’ve had in the UK, and i have had a LOT of burgers here. I also got the homemade mint lemonade because lemonade is my favorite drink, and its suuuuuper good!

Ordered a delivery through uber eats. I live approximately 5 mins away on a bike etc, the food was picked up and took over 30 mins for the delivery driver to arrive at my house. Watching the delivery persons route it looked like he drove off somewhere and stopped for 20 mins before deciding to bring us our food. By this point the food was ice cold/frozen.

Realistically this is more of an uber eats issue, I brought it up with them and they said it was delivered in time and don’t care if the food was frozen. I only am leaving this review because I brought it up to honest burgers and was ignored so just generally terrible customer service all around, and also I am out £45 because the food I ordered was basically inedible.

Latin House is a small, cosy, and nicely decorated restaurant. We went for the 3-course meal deal and everything was well organised and timed perfectly — the photos really say it all.

We just missed happy hour as it was a last-minute reservation, but it runs from 5–7pm with 2 cocktails for £12, which is great value. I ordered one cocktail and it was a bit of a creeper — very nice, and you feel it later. Would’ve happily had another if I wasn’t driving.

Overall, a lovely experience and definitely somewhere I’d return to.

A mixed bag, earning 2 stars.

The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, and my wife absolutely loved her mixed rice dish, which was a clear highlight.

Unfortunately, our food experience was inconsistent. The mixed grill was disappointing; the pork was as hard as cardboard and the chicken was quite dry. On the other hand, the sausage was good and the steak was nicely seasoned, although it was very thin.

The service was also a letdown. We waited so long for the bill that we eventually gave up and paid at the bar. To top it off, the automatic service charge felt particularly frustrating given the slow service. I strongly feel that a service charge should be optional and that staff should be paid a fair wage by increasing food prices instead.

Great food options! So large.
We ate and took some home
Nice and tasty too.
Ambience was good.
Great customer service, she greeted everyone with a smile on her face and seated you well.
And of course their happy hour drinks? Simple awesome!

Had a wonderful meal at The Latin House this evening.. Happy hour cocktails followed by a delicious starter of Prawns, calamari and home made bread. With so much to choose from, it was hard to make a decision on the main course, but we opted for steak and a sea bass.. all cooked to perfection! For dessert we somehow managed a plate of crepes with hot chocolate sauce banana and strawberries. The service was excellent.. very friendly staff to look after you. It’s full marks from me.. definitely be going again.. Thankyou 😊

Flavourful food, great portions and great staff. What more can you ask for?

The 3 course meal was great value (£34.50) and I left feeling stuffed with leftovers. I was recommended the prawn dish by Irene and I was not disappointed. Irene made our visit special and it certainly won’t be the last time I come.

name: Kent Restaurant & Lounge
address: 1st floor, 516 Old Kent Rd, London SE1 5BA, UK

reviews.text: Visited London and was craving Liberian food. Kent did not disappoint. I had the attieke with grilled fish and it was delicious. Excellent service. Worth the visit if you live or are visiting London!
Great,delicious  ,we do enjoy the food plus the reception is amazing

From the moment you step into this cozy spot, you can feel the warmth—not just from the atmosphere, but from the incredible owner who greets every guest like family. Their passion for hospitality shines through in every detail, from the thoughtful service to the beautifully presented dishes.

And the food? Absolutely outstanding. Every bite is bursting with flavor, made with fresh ingredients and clear culinary love. Whether you're diving into their signature dish or trying one of the daily specials, you're in for a treat that’s both comforting and exciting.

It’s rare to find a place where you leave full in both body and spirit, but this restaurant delivers every time. Highly recommended!
Great food. Limited selection due to time, but cooked to perfection
The place is really lovely, chilled and the food was amazing, everything tasted so delicious. Will definitely go there again.

19/02/2026

I had a amazing time out here I had salt and pepper squid for starters then I had pork udon noodle soup for main course which was out of this world 🥰😋👌💯

Went here for my birthday and I can honestly say: don’t let appearances fool you. Lovely House Dim Sum isn’t some polished, posh, linen-napkin joint — it’s basically a takeaway with a few tables, laminated menus, and Deliveroo riders flying in and out. But wow, the food. This is the real deal: freshly made, unbelievably fluffy, comforting dim sum — the kind you dream about later.

The prawn tempura was light, crisp, and perfect (see photo!), and a standout yam dish came slick with chilli oil, sesame, and coriander — smoky, sweet, addictive. Real sake too, served warm and generous.

Kathy, our waitress (and probably the owner), was wonderful — friendly, knowledgeable, and her recommendations were spot on. Everything felt personal, homemade, and full of soul.

Exceptional value for money. If you’re nearby, eat in. If you’re not — get on Deliveroo. Either way, this is one of London’s hidden food gems.

This is my second time visiting Lovely House Dim Sum Restaurant, and it never disappoints! The food is absolutely amazing – the shrimp dumplings and wontons are incredibly fresh and flavorful. The spring rolls are perfectly crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, especially when paired with their sweet chili sauce. I ordered  the Singapore Style Fried Rice as main dish. It is unique and packed with flavors.

The service is just as wonderful as the food. The owner is super friendly, thoughtful, they even gifted me some prawn crackers.

Highly recommend this place to anyone who loves delicious dim sum. Can’t wait to come back again!

I recently moved to London, and I had a sudden craving for Chinese cuisine. Since this restaurant had stood out in the neighbourhood with pretty good reviews, I gave it a try. The result? I was totally blown away not only by the deliciousness and authenticity of a variety of dishes but also by the amiability and conviviality of the hostess. Even though I dropped in pretty early in the evening on Tuesday, by the time I finished up the restaurant had already been packed with patrons. I'll definitely come back soon and try new dishes!

29th July, 2023
I tend to order my go-to dishes over and over again, but today I dared to try something new: Roast Pork Noodle Soup. It was so good that I emptied the entire bowl, in a nice breeze at outdoor seating.
Cathy and Jm are always so welcoming, caring and kind… the food is carefully prepared and presented… and is so tasty … lovely options for those with dietary limitations

name: Nando's Peckham
address: Aylesham Shopping Centre, Rye Ln, London SE15 5EN, UK

reviews.text: I had a great experience at Nando’s Peckham thanks to Anika. She genuinely went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect, from checking in on us to making sure our order was exactly right. Her attitude was friendly, professional, and made us feel really welcome. It’s rare to come across service like that, and it honestly made the whole dining experience so much better. Big thanks to Anika—she’s a real credit to the team!

I ordered a mediterranean salad from Nandos Peckham on 1st of November 2025 along with some other food. Most times when I place an order at Nandos Peckham they get it right. However that day the salad arrived with no Olives, no Salad dressing, no feta cheese and had two small tomatoes and a few cucumbers. I called and spoke to the duty manager expressing how upset i was and informed him to make sure that staff member is retrained. There was no apology or any offer for a replacement salad. I completed an online booking form and submitted all the information with a photo but Nandos never got back to me.
Anyway I called Nandos Peckham on 7th of November and spoke to the duty manager explaining the situation and how I havent heard back from Nandos. I said I wanted to place a new order with Half chicken and asked if he would add the mediterranean salad in the order for me but he got off the phone after speaking to someone saying they can't do it. I offered send him the photo and was even prepared to go to there. He just insisted I fill out the form even though I told him the order number is no longer showing on the Nandos app.
The customer service is very poor and they dont offer alternatives when their staff mess up the order. I have had at least three occasions where they jave messed up my mediterranean salad. No apology no care.

WHEN did you guys change management was the question I asked my server last night.
He looked at me bewildered, and I reframed it letting him know I thought the service was phenomenal and re-asked when they changed mgmt?

He didn’t really answer the question, But I let him know that I absolutely loved the service and energy.  From the Security guard, to the cashier, chef and server, everything was 10/10!!!!!

I’ve been coming here for YEARS and you always saw a manager micro-managing staff.  Last time I was there a European lady was giving orders left, right and centre.

Last night, we had no idea who the manager was, but the team worked a DREAM🤌🏿🤌🏿🤌🏿

Whoever was on shift on Sunday 18JAN from 5pm - THANK YOU!!!!!!

Me and my gym buddy ate and lounged for over 3hrs, after a solid session, where food and chill were much needed!!!! No one bothered us, plates were swept up at the perfect time, my garlic bread was replaced swiftly as I saw some random red (we think pepper) on one of them, and they came back with 2 for me. No aggro, no hassle whatsoever.

I saw the security guard helping a Aunty and her son with excess bags, and it was just heartwarming.

Nando’s Peckham is my go-to spot. The food always comes out quickly, and the staff have consistently been friendly, welcoming, and accommodating. The quality of the food is some of the best I’ve had at Nando’s, and the restaurant itself is very nice inside. It’s never too busy, which makes it a relaxed and chill place to grab a quick bite. Highly recommend.

Very spacious restaurant, it doesn't feel cramped even when it's busy, enjoyable experience to see comfortably while eating my lunch. Although it's in Peckham, i feel very chill inside the restaurant. Nice juicy chicken I had as you would expect from Nandos , staff are well mannered.
Our favorite SE London restaurant! Have been coming for years and staff and food is always a delight! Very good for vegans and non vegans! Thanks so much Naïfs!
Excellent service and excellent food. I loved the lentil pate dish and would've happy sat eating that all night.

Having been a vegan for 7 years this is one of the finest vegan meals I have ever eaten - each course was exquisite in flavour and presentation.
The staff were amazing - knowledgeable, friendly and attentive.
We couldn’t have wished for a better evening.
We will definitely be back!!
If we could have given the food 6 stars we would have!!

My visit to Naifs was a refreshing and memorable experience, defined by its creative plant‑based menu, cozy atmosphere, and welcoming service. From the moment you arrive, the restaurant feels inviting, with its modern décor and relaxed vibe making it an ideal spot for both casual dining and special occasions.

The menu offered a wide variety of innovative vegan dishes. Each plate felt thoughtfully prepared, balancing flavor, texture, and presentation in a way that elevated plant‑based cuisine. The starters were vibrant and fresh, the mains showcased bold combinations of vegetables, grains, and spices, and the desserts provided a sweet and indulgent finish without compromising on creativity.

The drinks selection was equally appealing, with refreshing juices, teas, and wines that paired beautifully with the food.

Service was attentive, friendly, and efficient. The staff created a hospitable environment, ensuring that guests felt welcome and well looked after throughout the visit.

What impressed me most was the combination of inventive vegan cuisine, cozy ambiance, and genuine hospitality. A visit to Naifs is not just about dining, but about experiencing the richness and creativity of plant‑based food culture.

Verdict:
Naifs is highly recommended for anyone who appreciates innovative vegan dishes served in a stylish and welcoming setting.

We are regulars at Naifs! This is one of the best (if not the best) vegan restaurants in London! All vegetables, all beautiful flavours. Everything is served family style with a set menu that changes based on the best ingredients for the season. We particularly love the paper plane cocktail and the chocolate mousse they often have on the menu. The (bottomless) bread is from local Toad bakery. Would recommend to vegans and non vegans - the food is always a celebration of vegetables! Great experience every time.

name: Blue Nile South
address: 25 Meeting House Ln, London SE15 2UN, UK

reviews.text: I was in London and need good seafood with  Jamaican flavours and Blue Nile South did not disappoint. The portions were very good. The seafood broil is to die for fresh lobster, prawns, yum yum. I'll be back soon.

Best Caribbean restaurant everything is produced fresh as you wait expect a little waiting time for your food but it’s well worth the wait.

I had butter fish with steamed vegetables more than enough for me.

The food was absolutely amazing! It was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The shop itself was also impressive: clean, well-organized, and welcoming. A great experience all around. Highly recommend!

My husband and I had a lovely lunch which was tasty, full of flavour and really good portions. We were hosted by the lovely Danisha and the charming Kat. There was a good range of options to choose from for a lunchtime along with a range of delicious organic drinks. Would fully recommend a visit.

GUYS, PLEASE BE CAREFUL when you’re ordering a take - away from here. If the items you order are NOT in stock and you want to cancel.  The restaurant will still accept your order and won’t cancel.

This simply means the restaurant will take your money, you won’t be reimbursed by Uber Eats and there won’t be any food.

I called the restaurant to resolve the matter, just to be told that they couldn’t do anything.  So, they can accept the order no matter if they have the food or not and you WILL NOT be refunded.

name: 805 Restaurants - West African Restaurant, Old Kent
address: 805 Old Kent Rd, London SE15 1NX, UK

reviews.text: Great restaurant serving traditional West African food in a sleek and modern environment. We went on a Saturday evening and - although very busy - managed to get a table for two without reservation. Staff was friendly and explained the dishes to us. The grilled fish was excellent- but order only if you are OK with bones. The Asaro was very special, spiced and hearty. Would recommend!

I was a bit hesitant to try this place at first, given the mixed reviews, but all of my concerns were quickly put to rest.
We visited around midday and were warmly welcomed by Yetunde, who provided excellent customer service from start to finish. Our food arrived quickly and it was absolutely delicious. Big shoutout to Chef Ben!
