The portion sizes were generous, even if they looked smaller at first glance and the interior was surprisingly stylish and comfortable, much nicer than you'd guess from the outside.
Overall a fantastic experience. Highly recommended!

I came all the way from North London to Old Kent Road 805 to get food. I asked for seafood Okro with poundo and Edikaikong soup with poundo.
This decision was my worst nightmare. Absolutely disgusting food, seafood what? Waste of time, effort and money.
The vegetable I was served, first wasn’t Edikaikong, secondly it had no flavour whatsoever. The worst food I ever ate.
I called the store once I got home and realised that it wasn’t Edikaikong I was served, I heard the chef saying it was, then, the man who answered the phone, instead of asking for a phone number or something to be able to request a photo, I insisted that I called back the day after, then they can give me a mobile number to send images to because it’s store closing time. NEVER AGAIN!!!

I have been a loyal patron since 2004, and this restaurant remains one of my all-time favorite Nigerian dining experiences in London. The rich flavors and authentic dishes always transport me back to the heart of Nigeria.

It is always a very pleasant experience for us whenever we come here, be it together or with others. The attentiveness of the staff is always 10/10. They ensure that everything is okay with our food and are always accessible if we need them for anything. The food is delicious and full of a variety of flavours and spices.👌🏾

As we are both lovers of art, the decor always really stands out to us, especially the beautiful portraits. They depict a West African tale. Simply magnificent!

Overall, the restaurant is exceptionally clean and we never have any issues when we dine here with food, cutlery, the atmosphere or the staff. 805 has continued to uphold their high standards over the years hence why we always come back!

name: Tiwa 'N' Tiwa
address: 34 Peckham High St, London SE15 5DP, UK

reviews.text: Car-park adjacent server of some of the richest, spiciest stews that a palette unaccustomed to Nigerian cuisine can handle.

I went all the way to Peckham just to eat suya because I can’t get it where I live in Europe. The place I originally wanted to visit was hard to find, so I searched on TikTok and discovered this spot instead.

The woman there was very friendly—we chatted for a bit while she warmed up my suya. It was a bit oily for my taste and  I paid £10 for the suya, which I found a bit pricey, but overall, it was still a nice experience. I’d definitely recommend this place!

Small eatery serving basically Nigerian food Yoruba dishes especially. Eja tutu (tilapia), pound yam, Amala, white Amala (lafun), assorted meat, rice, beans, moinmoin etc.

Ok place, a bit tight to manuever around. In all, satisfactory for a taste of Yoruba home cooking.
I enjoyed the suya turkey, beef and chicken with my family. It was so tasty and nice.

The food is lovely but I won't be returning... found a piece of iron in my egusi stew.. called them to let them know what I've  discovered only to be told " that's strange"....  like seriously?? I could've bit into this ting and injure my mouth but thankfully I didn't..

name: Marisqueria Galapagos
address: Unit 5, 149 New Cross Rd, United SE14 5DJ, UK

reviews.text: Very nice food, fresh fish, authentic! The atmosphere could be better (we’ve been on a Friday for dinner) but apart from that was very nice, would be amazing to have some more atmosphere like a proper Latino restaurant.
The portions are huge and delicious. The seafood rice can feed a small family and I ate most of it in one go because I couldn’t stop eating.

What a hidden gem!

We were curious to try this Ecuadorian restaurant in Lewisham and it was a great surprise!

The food was fantastic, with generous portions and great flavour. We started with the calamari, followed by a delicious prawn dish in a creamy garlic sauce and seafood rice served with plantains (a huge dish).

The service was friendly and efficient, and the prices were very reasonable. If you're looking for a tasty meal in Lewisham, I highly recommend giving this place a try.
Really lovely food, freshly prepared and such generous portions. If you want to explore traditional Ecuadorean food I highly recommend this place. Muchas gracias, todo muy delicioso!
The best seafood rice I have eaten in a long time! Full of flavor, generous portion and good amount of seafood. Happy to have Ecuadorian food in this part of London.

name: Habesha Restaurant & Bar
address: 41 Camberwell Church St, London SE5 8TR, UK

reviews.text: Absolutely delicious food and great experience overall. We’ve never had Ethiopian food, so we took the sharing menu and it was perfect. It’s a lot of food for two people for a great price! We‘ll definitely be back :)

One of my favorite Ethiopian restaurants in London. The menu has options for everyone who wants to try this delicious cuisine. The enjera is the perfect flavor and all the dishes are authentic and well cooked. When other restaurants are cutting cost with portion sizes the dishes here will leave you full for the whole day. Definitely worth every penny for a unique fine dining experience. The drinks menu is great too with a wide selection of authentic Ethiopian drinks including coffee and honey wine, cocktails and soft drinks. I would eat here every day. Atmosphere is lovely too, a great place to bring friends or a date and the staff are all very friendly and kind people. One of the best dining experiences in Camberwell.
Had an INCREDIBLE meal here! Would very highly recommend! We enjoyed the veggie plate

Amazing food and service! Our waitress hanan was so lovely and attentive we will definitely be back soon. We ordered the set menu for the meat and veg mix option which was so so delicious and flavourful would recommend

Tried Ethiopian food for the first time and loved it! The aromas when you walk in are amazing – like stepping into your grandma’s kitchen. We shared the meat platter for two (around £30, great value) and every dish was full of flavour, including the veggie options. Eating communally with injera (which is a fluffy, slightly sour bread) instead of cutlery was such a fun and authentic experience.
The decor is simple with colourful Mesob baskets, though there were a few fruit flies and the toilet placement wasn’t ideal. The service wasn’t the best and we had to flag down for attention versus staff being attentive a few times, but we can overlook that on this occasion, because it appeared like they were by themselves. Still, the food more than made up for it. I’d definitely go back!

P.s. the music was so perfect, calm and great for dates as it wasn’t too loud or distracting.

name: Hong Kong City
address: 43 New Cross Rd, London SE14 5FP, UK

reviews.text: Delicious dimsum, better than any in Chinatown! The flavours are fresh and the fillings are generous. I recommend anything with prawns (hargow, siu mai, cheung fun) but everything is genuinely great.

The food is delicious with high-quality ingredients and beautiful presentation. The restaurant offers a spacious and elegant atmosphere, perfect for hosting parties or special events. Professional service and a great overall experience. Highly recommended!

I absolutely love dining at Hong Kong City! The food is incredible  especially the dim sum, which tastes so authentic and freshly made. Every dish is full of flavour and beautifully prepared. The service is excellent, and the staff are always so friendly and welcoming. You really feel looked after from the moment you walk in. It’s definitely one of my favourite places to enjoy proper Hong Kong-style cuisine. Highly recommend!

Amazing service! Beautifully Instagramable food👀 Me & my family decided to visit this place to treat ourselves and it did not disappoint. We got the weekend buffet and ate ourselves full. Unlike Chinatown buffets, this one includes table service so you just sit down and order as you please 😋 Really good looking food presentation wise but nothing stood out and atmosphere could be better. Our servers, Jewel and Yang (who surprisingly spoke Spanish!) were attentive and warm. Will come back ☝️☝️☝️

New management which shows significant improvement compared to last 20+ years I had in this restaurant. Visiting during the day with great taste Dim Sum. A few private parking space but free off street parking at night. Will definitely come again at night to try their main dishes and seafood.

Great food for a decent price made fresh! Nice staff as well helped recommend what to get. 3 pupasas for £15 was good, and the 3 pastelitos for £6!

Worth a visit definitely. There are somw bar seats but seating is quite limited u less you manage to find a table in the communal area
Amazing authentic pupusas. Staff are so kind. Would definitely recommend

This is food made with heart and soul. We tried the pupusas and the yuca fritas and both dishes were packed with beautiful flavours. The horchata was also very refreshing. As someone with a sweet tooth, the canoas de  plátano was the highlight. This dessert was the perfect way to end the meal. The whole team were super friendly and the service was efficient. A great experience overall, and we hope to be back! Gracias 😊

Amazing value and flavours - happy, appreciative service. 3 pastelitos for £6 is a steal.
Coming back again!!

Incredible service and amazingly authentic food! The pupusas we had were incredible with the salsas and pickled veggies on top too.

Huge vegetarian selection as well :)

Highly recommend!!

name: Bà Ba (Ba Ba Peckham) Southern Vietnamese Restaurant

reviews.text: Stopped over for a quick bite and from the moment I entered the service was fantastic. I was advised on the wine selection, the notes of each were explained to me and I went with the staff recommendation. The ambiance of the place is very calm and homelike, overall I enjoyed the meal !

I used to absolutely LOVE banh banh but unfortunately it’s really gone down hill recently. I used to get the tofu bun salad and it would be a massive portion and was the best Vietnamese food around but since they’ve changed the recipe it’s just not that good sadly. They’ve also halved the portion size which does rub some salt on the wound! If they decide to go back to the original recipe I would defo start ordering again but for the price the new style is just not worth it. Am going to have to find a new Vietnamese restaurant to go to!

I used to visit quite often but had to stop for a while as I found the food quality had gone downhill. I went back for dinner tonight with a friend and I’m happy that I could feel the cooking passion again. The food was fresh and flavourful, the decor is warm and welcoming. My friend loved what he had. Service could be a touch better.

I rarely go somewhere and don’t enjoy the food. We ordered two starters and the pork noodle salad both as mains. The pork was very questionable. The service was good but I got recommended the pork noodle salad and I’m unsure why anyone would eat that!

The most divine soul nourishing food I’ve had in a long time! The chicken coconut curry was like a giant hug and Blair, our server had the most loving, joyful energy. I feel and appreciate the home cooked family vibes. If I could give this place 10 stars I would. Thank you!! I will be back!!

name: ANTHONY’S GRILL LTD
address: Unit 9- 10, 149 New Cross Rd, London SE14 5DJ, UK

reviews.text:
Everything about Anthony's is fantastic.

La placita mall is a very chilled location, great value for money with a wonderful atmosphere.

The food was exceptional. Great service, and we were also very well looked after by the bar which is a separate business.

Prices for both food and drinks were very very good.

The platter for two was huge and delicious!!!!
The food is absolutely delicious we kept wanting seconds definitely coming back here again the staff were so kind and helpful and it was such a vibe to be there.
The food was so good and flavorful! I would absolutely recommend this restaurant!

Great quality meat!
Prices are very good!
The small food hall is OK but a little bit too loud to my standards!

Nice Peruvian restaurant in a Latin American food court. We had the lomo saltado and chicken rice Peruano. Both were very tasty, with lots of flavour in the sauces. The steak in the lomo saltado was perfectly cooked and very tender. Looking forward to coming back and trying more!

I’ve been coming here for a few years now, and after getting my food today I just had to show some appreciation. I’ve been craving it all week — even travelled quite a distance just to satisfy the craving — and it was absolutely worth it. Every bite was full of flavour… just tasty in every way.

The only thing I’ll say? We need delivery down to Thornton heath please!

What an amazing atmosphere. Whether you are looking to just go out on the weekend, hosting a party,  or just dinning with friends and family. This place has the music, elegance, culture mix,  atmosphere, ambience, and the food is delicious. I have tried most dishes without a fault. The bar staff are friendly and welcoming. The music on a Friday, Saturday and Sunday nights gets you up and on your feet. This is by far the the place to be if you are looking to wine down. Amazing venue for bookings, parties, weddings and the list goes on. Don’t forget to book before going  as this place gets super busy on weekends.
I had a great experience at Ibbs, food is delicious and the environment is clean and friendly.

Friendly staff and service. The fish dish was scrumptious, tasty plantains and very soft mouth watering banana fritters (acara) . It was crowded and loud afro-beat blaring on  the speakers but it was a singalong song (salone don betteh) which makes it a lively place to be.
Word of advice, if you're taking friends along ensure that you prebook a table  before you get there. It is friendly atmosphere to meet up with friends and have a good taste of African cuisine.

The food is good but this place is FILTHY! Really dirty. I found a clump of hair, a huge clump of hair in my pepper chicken. I threw everything away that I'd additionally purchased. Wear hair nets please and make sure your kitchen is clean. Never going again. Gross!

Amazing food, reasonably priced and big portions. We ordered the askak dumplings, banjan borani, feta salad and an Afghan naan. The naan was the size of a bed sheet, fluffy and fresh out the tandoori. Could have used it as a parachute it was that big. The borani was deeply flavoured, tender slices of aubergine in a rich yoghurt sauce. We had never tried Afghan dumplings before and were not disappointed. Topped with a lentil sauce, they were bursting with silky smooth leeks and herbs. Washed down with a mango and salt lassi, the bill came to £36 for 2. Owners were lovely and spoke us through all the dishes. Highly recommended and a lesser known gem in Peckham
Delicious food, got the mixed grill, fresh pomegranate salad and fragrant rice

They had the England game playing and me and my friends enjoyed the restaurants food. We thought to give it a try as we normally just get a takeaway from a local store but the food was so amazing. About £15 a head for a group of 5 and we loved it and had so many dishes was a lovely experience and friendly staff
We had a delicious dinner after a long time. It was tasty food, as was expected. I would love to come again and recommend food. Customer service is good, like green tea served with sweet almonds.

Went with my family of 10 yesterday had a great experience met the owner Noor was very nice and told us all about the dishes and we was all satisfied. They played Afghan / Pakistani music and it was a real vibe

We ordered Marinera Paella and it did not dissapoint! It was hearty, well-portioned, and made to share, which is very much in the spirit of Spanish dining. The dish is colorful and inviting — the golden saffron rice, bright green peas, pink shrimp, and black mussels make it very appetizing. The lemon wedges are a nice touch, adding freshness and contrast.

Came here for a birthday dinner and had an amazing time! The place is decorated so beautifully and the lovely waiter, I think his name was Kesha, was so kind and welcoming. We thoroughly enjoyed the food!!! Especially the chorizo tortilla, red wine meatballs, and sizzling prawns! Couldn’t recommend the place enough! Thank you for an incredible evening ♥️
reviews.author_name: // K A I L E I G H //

reviews.text:
No 1 place for Tapas and Breakfast. I had the best prawns  ever, accompanied by Pat's Bravis, a Salad, bread and 2 glasses of wine. I was driving Solo and the portions were generous. This also applies to breakfast
. The full English Breakfast which included 2 perfectly cooked fried eggs, 2 sausages, Mushrooms, tomato,baked beans and to too it off, homemade hash browns! There is a veggie and vegan option as well, avocado and perfect scrambled egg on toast or tofu.  The quality of food and the presentation is five star.The owner Kishan, is a qualified chef having worked in the top hotels in London, this comes through in his food and customer service. This is a new enterprise for him and his wife. They are lovely people. The only reason I dropped a star was that it was very quiet, and they deserve more customers. i wish them every success in thier new venture, and I will be back.

This was without a doubt the worst Spanish food I have ever had the displeasure of eating. To add injury to insult it wasn’t even cheap. Avoid this hell hole at all costs! Arroz brut served with basmati rice. Prawns where served at a temperature hotter than the temperature of a nuclear reactor. The croquetas were circular which I have never seen before in my life. The only saving grace with the wine was drinkable!

Suitable for vegetarians. The man taking our order/running the counter also cooked the food, and yet it came out extremely fast. And as a bonus, they have lovely space heaters to get away from the cold.

Suuyar is a unique experience for Nigerian food! From the smoky grilled beef and chicken wings to the delicious smoky jollof rice, plantain, small chops, fish, sharwarma and Nigerian soup options, we loved everything on the menu! It was worth the hype and more value for money!

Really amazing food, good spice levels and a range of dishes for a decent price. The suya is 10/10. Also loved the Nigerian Fanta and coke.

However, the restaurant itself is chaotic from the moment we stepped in. The staff are really trying their best but haven’t been able to keep up with the popularity and it’s a very stressful environment. The staff don’t seem to have access to the WhatsApp messages leading to a lot of miscommunication on number of guests etc, arrival times etc.

It’s a very small space which gets crowded making it hard to even access the buffet which is by the front door. There’s a step by the front door where the buffet is which a few of my guests tripped over and nearly dropped their food.

We started our buffet late due to having to wait for previous guests to finish and then there were no plates available so had to ask for this. There were also only small wooden forks available.

Additionally, the buffet is not refilled very regularly, it’s meant to be every half an hour but for most of the time we were there, nearly everything was empty, which was really disappointing.

Might be better to try the food stall down the road. Amazing food and hopefully in time the service improves.

Service was good, food was good, though some items were hit and miss. The fish I had was too salty (2/10), the Asun was 10/10, pounded yam/Egusi (10/10), presentation of all food items (5/10) space (5/10). Overall worth the buffet price.

The environment was clean and the staffs were so welcoming and polite the food came out warm. I enjoyed the food taste so delicious and the chicken suya I picked was mild spices was full of flavour. I also took chicken suya for takeaway was done in efficient time very fast service and good portion size for the price.

Excellent food in an excellent space with excellent service. Had grilled fish to go. And moi moi too. Both very nice. And we got a drink on the house as we were waiting for the food. Will be back here again and again. Recommend!
Never have I ever been into a carribean restaurant and felt So WELCOMED! This shop is a 10/10. Definitely the best all round 👌🏾

Beautiful food best Caribbean I’ve tasked in a long time, good portions fresh tasty food restaurant lovely atmosphere great staff and even great music played to even enjoy the love of Caribbean food more. Compliments to the chef highly recommended
The best Caribbean food in Peckham! Quality and consistent food every time!! Absolutely delicious, tasty and filling!
The best Caribbean food in south London! I have been coming here for years! Great service & fabulous AUTHENTIC Jamaican food! Highly recommend!
Amazing Curry Goat with excellent service. It is the best curry goat I have had, and the dumplings were fantastic.

name: Van Hing
address: 42 Camberwell Church St, London SE5 8QZ, UK

reviews.text: If you want comfort food and no fuss, this is the place. It’s not most aesthetically pleasing but good food and very reasonable price for these days and age. It becomes my weekly Monday dinner out lately.

Great tasting, freshly made Chinese food. Those who have been following me know that I don't give 5 star reviews but this is a gem in Camberwell.  I will take my wife there when she gets back. Staff is very friendly.

My uncle and I had 5 kettles of their chinese tea. Very very good tea I must say.

A local authentic and totally unpretentious Vietnamese Chinese restaurant that always delivers. Don’t expect anything fancy but if you are in Camberwell and up for an Asian fix then this family run restaurant will tick all your boxes. I had a delicious fried rice with duck for £9.50. Great value for a plate of food that is cooked with love. 5 stars for me

This place is lovely! The food is so tatsy I felt so much comfort eating here, I really can't fault the tatse and portions. Look good too little slow but I actually like they cook the food well. However for me personally because I have sensory issues it can get a little overwhelming loud ect, esp if there's a dinner party, but that's nothing to some. The staff are friendly and efficient, had no issues here.

A very nice place to eat out! We went there on a Wednesday Evening without reservation and still got a table. The food is really good and the prices are definitely worth it! I would recommend this restaurant!

The best pork ribs in London bar none! Really lovely food in generous portions - south London meets the southern U.S via the Caribbean. Prawns, Lamb, chicken are all superb, I love the coleslaw and the garlic bread rules! An absolute gem that I can't recommend too highly

I love egi’s. I been getting food from there for a while, I normally get it online so I haven’t been instore. The food is amazing the sauce is great and they always listen to special requests. I can only imagine the friendly staff that work there. The only thing is the online price is way above what it is instore x

Not been here in a few years, I used to always get the lamb chops meal. Last time I came here he had big juicy chops they were really good however he's changed them to these ridiculously thin dipressing things that shouldn't be served in a restaurant. So disappointed, especially since the price is almost double what it used to be. So sad to see another one of my favourite food spots completely fall off 😪

This is one of my favourite spots. I've been going here for over 14 years. The taste has been consistently good. I really love the chips. I wouldn't normally pick chips over rice but honestly they are something else. The coleslaw is also very good. Now about the chicken, the prices are always huge and cooked to perfection. Please treat yourself.

I've had bad experiences with some Caribbean food, but the visit to Egi's altered my perception. My cousin recommended that I visit if I'm ever nearby. We placed our order over the phone 30mins to arrival. The food was handed to us within 2mins. Went home to give it a try and I must say I was pleasantly surprised by the portion and the food was superb. The grilled chicken and pork ribs with the rice and peas was great. Loved it and I will be back for more.
Outstanding service, delicious Thai kitchen restaurant & bar service, that also does traditional Sunday roast Beef/Lamb/Pork/Chicken too. Highly recommended. 5 Star place.
Completely delicious food accented by excellent service performed by wonderful humans. Words fail me when i think back to that soup though…wow.
Had a great time here. The staff are very friendly and the food lives up to the looks. Service was with a smile but they don’t helicopter over you as you eat. Would recommend.

Lovely little thai restaurant the pa nang curry was nice just missing the slight kick. The coconut rice did not taste of anything and was overcooked. Service was A+ absolutely love Henry. Drinks were reasonably priced. Would return for a quick lunch but not a main event.

No longer good for vegetarians! I was there last night and for some reason they have started using  fish paste in their curries when they never used to. Such a shame as this used to be my favourite Thai place in the area.

name: Plaza 809 La caribeña
address: 57 Camberwell Church St, London SE5 8TR, UK

reviews.text: I had a great experience at this restaurant. The food was absolutely amazing and full of flavour. The staff were incredibly kind and welcoming, and the whole place felt very authentic. The music was also really a vibe. I’ll definitely be coming back, and I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for good food and a good atmosphere!!
Like my second home... Ones a month is necessary at least to come and eat. I feel like I'm really at home. The best service, El rinconcito
It was very nice and amazing food, %100 recommended. The real Dominican flavour food.
Great food, fresh and homemade. Prices are great and if you like bachata, this is the place to listen good music.
Great atmosphere with amazing food. Try the Chicharon! You will not be disappointed

I took my dad here for an early Father's Day dinner. It's a really chic and chilled atmosphered Chinese restaurant, which is also easy to get to. The staff were very friendly, helpful and accommodating. They have a good variety of options on their menu to choose from. However, I was a little disappointed by the food. The starter I had, the sesame prawn toast, was very good. And we were given complimentary Prawn Crackers when we arrived, which were good. I had egg fried rice, which i also liked, with spicy shredded crispy beef. Unfortunately, the shredded beef was not spicy, had no flavour, and was a little burnt. I tasted the roast duck, which was OK but was very fatty. I don't think I would go back here for lunch or dinner, but I would revisit for a drink and starter because the atmosphere was peaceful and a vibe.

What an amazing restaurant! The food was absolutely amazing and the prawn toast was the best I've ever had. I have never had prawn toast where you are literally eating prawns and not oily. Hands down the best Chinese food I’ve ever had. A big thank you to Lisa what an amazing woman her customer service was awesome. Thank you. All the staff were kind and attentive and the food came out swiftly. I give 10/10 for the food and 10/10 for service and the decor was beautiful. Thank you and we will be back for sure. Don't walk run you will not be disappointed x

Best Chinese food we’ve ever had! Love the heated plates they bring you. The duck with pancakes appetizer was delicious! For a table of 4 we shared the chicken lo mein, sizzling beef, garlic broccoli, and egg fried rice. Everything was amazing!   Must try if you’ve never eaten here. Staff was very friendly and helpful!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
**Fantastic service and great food!**

I had a lovely experience at Chi Chinese Restaurant on Lordship Lane thanks to Bill, who was absolutely fantastic. He was friendly, attentive, and made us feel really welcome from the moment we walked in. The food was delicious — fresh, full of flavour, and beautifully presented — and everything was very reasonably priced.

Highly recommend this place, especially if Bill is looking after you. The other staff members were also friendly and helpful too. Great service and great value!

The fantastic Chinese restaurant in east Dulwich. The food is so tasty, I tried mandarin fish in sweet and sour sauce and that became my favorite! The staff are lovely and friendly! Definitely come back. Highly recommended!!

name: Empire Lounge Bar & Restaurant
address: 777 Old Kent Rd, London SE15 1NZ, UK

reviews.text:
It use to be a good place to visit but not anymore. The food was tasteless, the services was extremely poor. We waited for 60 mins for suya and when it arrived, it was very bad, no flavour.  The fish came after 90mins and the presentation was awful, served with 3 fried yams and 3 plantain.  The fish was dry and burnt. We ordered amala but we got pounded yam, it was awful
We have to cancelled the rest of our orders and went down the road to eat isi ewu, which cost less and far better.
No space it was packed
We will never go there again

Dreadful place. Avoid if u can but by the time we left it was packed. We waited 45 minutes for jollof rice , chicken and plaintain ( 3 plantain!!). It was ok. Very noisy and dreadful service. Had to ask for meal several times. My mum' s egusi took an hour. Music too loud. They must be doing something right as seemed popular. I thought it overpriced. Its more a night club serving food than a resto. Go for the experience but you cannot serve 3 slice of plantain to  Africans and expect a good review.

Oh I need to add. The staff and the manager were actually very pleasant. Its more a food organisation/ systems issue. Sort it out.

We ordered fish, TERRIBLE! The fish was soo hard we couldn't chew it. We call the attention of the manager , we gave him knife to help us cut "the so call cooked&fresh fish" 😕☹️😭😭Terrible customer service for me.
Never again.

Awful place, both service and food. Fish looking anorexic and small plantain for 25 pounds. Extortion to the highest.i wouldnt mind if it was good portion but terrible service a and terrible restaurant. If you have Enich money go there instead at least you will be full and know its money well spent.

I read some of the reviews and I'm bewildered that people have to complain about a spot I find very up to date with their services,i would say to the management of Empire lounge to keep it up,your services are 2nd to non,I will always patronise your spot,the catfish peppersoup was a banger and the seafood okro was out of this world,do not be deterred by the negative reviews cos you can't satisfy or please everyone,focus on getting better and better.
Please don't stop the music,the music is what I also enjoy,shout out to your amazing DJ.

name: Cafe Spice
address: Cafe Spice, 88 Rye Ln, London SE15 4RZ, UK

reviews.text: I was in Peckham with a friend and stumbled upon this restaurant. They have dine in and takeaway services. It’s not Nigerian owned but they sell mostly Nigerian foods. I got akara which was great, moi moi and some protein options. Prices were also very reasonable. They sell puff puff and some other Nigerian snacks. The service was also great and I got a discount on the moi moi which is always a bonus

The Most Disgusting Dining Experience Ever – Avoid at All Costs

I was absolutely horrified by how disgusting this place was. The smell was unbearable.

The utensils were reused without being cleaned, and the hygiene standards were appalling. The meat was rubbery and tasted like soap. The only thing that was remotely decent was the rice. To make matters worse, I found hair in my food, and it wasn’t properly covered, leaving it exposed to flies.

The lingering fish smell was so bad I had to go home and brush my teeth just to get rid of it. Even days later, I’m still haunted by how revolting this experience was. Unsurprisingly, I ended up with food poisoning.

This place urgently needs to be inspected by the local council’s Environmental Health Officers and the Food Standards Agency (FSA). It’s shocking that they’re allowed to continue operating in such appalling conditions. This was by far the worst dining experience I’ve ever had, and I wouldn’t wish it on anyone. Avoid this place at all costs – it’s truly disgusting.

Incredibly nice man served me, gave advice (when asked) on which accompaniments went best with the jollof. Perfectly spiced, huge piece of jerked chicken, stewed beef was really tender, generous portions of plantain and chili sauce, I was worried about the price but actually you get a huge portion and it lasts for 2 if not 3 meals. Definitely somewhere I'd recommend

A good place to pick up some authentic Nigerian food to takeaway. I like to get moi moi in the leaf here. 9/10 it’s a great consistency taste and the perfect amount of pepper. I’ve also tried some of their soups, meat on the stick and the jollof rice all of which have been good. My only gripe would be that the prices don’t remain consistent from one day to the next or by what is printed on the menu.

Came and collected take out today, staff were very friendly and helpful and the food did not disappoint, thoroughly enjoyed a mixed box of Jolloff rice, beef with plantain and oxtail. Highly recommend this place.

name: New Chans
address: 726 Old Kent Rd, London SE15 1NG, UK

reviews.text: Been eating from this takeaway for years and never had a problem.  Staff are lovely, food is always hot and they cook variations on the dishes if they can. Very nice indeed

One of the best Chinese restaurants in South East London, this place consistently delivers great-quality food, and I always enjoy dining here. The dishes are flavorful, well-prepared, and never disappoint. However, I do feel that the restaurant could do a better job of informing customers when they’ll be closed for an extended period. It’s frustrating to make the journey only to find out it’s unexpectedly closed.

Another suggestion would be to consider extending their delivery area. I have a Chinese restaurant that delivers to my home in Brockley, even though it’s farther away. While I understand Chans doesn’t deliver that far, it’s only about 10 minutes from the restaurant, and I believe many customers, including myself, would order more often if they offered delivery to this area. Overall, it’s an amazing spot, and I highly recommend it, but these small improvements could make the experience even better.

Prawn balls Undercooked batter special curry was watery curry sauce taste like gravy shredded chilli beef was not crispy was bland and gave everyone in my household who ate it and upset stomach and diarrhoea Cold sweats and severe stomach cramp would not recommend

The best Chinese takeaway on the Old Kent Road! I've been a regular customer here for many, many years, usually for delivery but occasionally I'll pop in and collect when I don't want to eat/spend a lot. The staff are always friendly, the service efficient, and the food tasty.

Menu highlights include fried dumplings, chicken balls, peking ribs, chow mein and singapore fried rice, to name just a few, plus the set meal for one is extremely good value. In fact, at a time where food costs have been ever increasing, Chan's has resisted putting their prices up as much as they possibly can, keeping them super competitive and super busy.

Sadly, they have been closed on a number of occasions this year, but always make the effort to put a sign on the shutters and/or a voice message on the phone line informing customers of this and when they'll reopen.

I've been to this family owned takeaway many times over the past year and their seafood ho fun is delicious and reasonably priced. I've tried their other dishes and they're also full of flavour. I would advise to call up and order for collection or order at the takeaway rather than delivery as sometimes the driver is not available.

If you want proper Sierra Leonean Jollof & Suya, this is the place to be.
Friendly Atmosphere.
Amazing food, incredible portions and excellent service !!! Will be returning again very soon ☺️
Great place, friendly staff, good food, excellent service. You can get all your delicious West African/Sierra Leonean food plus all the drinks you may desire Just! Just try it
The most Delicious food, Best take away I’ve had in ages, the jollof with Suya meat was perfect
Great quality food at bargain prices. Comes out quick and piping hot. Everything you'd want from a local.

Wow this is an instant classic restaurant! I was so excited to visit shurzos because it is the only Indian in Camberwell and it did exceeded my expectations for all of us. We sat at one of the booths and ordered many different dishes. I was really impressed with the quality of all the dishes, we had onion bhaji, samosa, paneer and aubergine to start and it really set a great tone. Main courses were all excellent. Our only mistake was not ordering the whole tandoori chicken - we only had the half. Faultless dishes and really lovey service from Mohamed. I am looking forward to coming back and recommend anyone to visit!!

A nice addition to the Camberwell food scene. We were missing an Indian restaurant. I didn't expect the food to be so good. The food was fresh and fragrant. Even if we were the only ones dining in at first, quite a few take-away drivers were coming in to pick up the orders. I am always worried about food rotation.
Our waiter was very professional and attentive. We are pleasantly surprised how good this visit turned out to be. We will be back. Thank you.

A fantastic find in Camberwell. Recently opened, so is brand new in fittings and furnishings and is spotless. A wide range of South Indian dishes. We opted for a chicken dhansak and a chicken bhuna with rice and garlic naan. All of the food was delicious piping hot and so moreish. The owner is a very nice man and even offered us some liqueurs free of charge! Do yourselves a favour and go here for a fantastic dining experience.

My partner and I came here and loved it. The service was incredible and the staff were so attentive. The food was so flavourful with a decent amount of veggie and vegan options. The aubergine bhaji was our fave. We'll definitely be back ❤️

Also it's no longer BYOB - they have cobra, asahi and wine in the fridge 🍻

Hurray! Finally Camberwell has a really good Indian restaurant.
We ordered a takeaway (such a relief not to have to use Deliveroo it was so much cheaper just to go directly to Shurzo).
It was a big order but the food came really quickly and piping hot and totally delicious. We have had a few Indian takeaways over the years but i would say this was among the best.
The meat was tender, the sauces felt authentic and the whole meal was full of fresh ingerdients and was made with care.
We will definitely be back.

name: Mingles Bar and Restaurant
address: 1 Peckham Park Rd, London SE15 6TR, UK

reviews.text:
Extremely impressed

I asked bro at the bar about something I couldn't order anywhere else. He reccomended me this - alcoholic coconut cola basically. Delicious

Then I asked him his favourite meal, some cassava dish with palm oil. I've never had anything quite like it before. But I thoroughly enjoyed it - spicy, peanutty & satisfying

Very glad I came in here. Friendly service, cool Afrobeat music & clean tables

Been ordering from this rearurant since last year from uber eats. I’ve noticed their portions are getting smaller. Just ordered two different dishes. Disappointed to have received half a bowl of soup (small size take away). Prices have gone up slightly, i guess cost of living etc but don’t increase prices and reduce portions. Also noticed not much protein in soups these days.

Green stuff at the bottom is the soup. The top is oil. Forgot to take a picture of the other dish.

Decided to give this resturant another try. Ordered foofoo and okra. Again very small portion, full of bones. Foofoo was cold. Stale. Called resturant person on the phone stated she has no control, apparently that’s how the food is portioned when cooked. Makes one wonder how long might have been in fridge/freezer.

Defo not worth the price.

I'm Nigerian and had never tried Sierra Leonean food before until a friend told me about Mingles. I ordered their cassava soup with rice yesterday, and it was so tasty that I went back today and got two more portions. I’m now hooked on this dish! The staff were also really friendly, and the service was great. I highly recommend it!

Firstly, the quality of the food I received was extremely poor. The meal lacked freshness and flavor, I ordered jollof rice and stew chicken. The jollof tasted old and greasy like it was days old rice being reheated. There was no stew chicken. Literally fried chicken with sauce in a small container very disappointing …it tasted like it was in the fridge for days and overheated in the microwave. My husband ordered Crain Crain with fufu. The Waitress bought the Crain Crain with rice. When he corrected her she bought the fufu which was so hard in the middle he stuck his fork through it. She replaced it and it tased off. Earlier I saw the “chef” walk to one of the fridges (wearing blue gloves…. Which for me is not good hygiene practice as you should remove your gloves when leaving the kitchen especially as I saw you touching the handrail. Not sure if you even changed your gloves) which could explain why the food tasted like it had been in the fridge for far too long. I expect when coming to a restaurant to have fresh flavoured food. The food did not meet the standard I have come to expect from here. It was a thoroughly disappointing dining experience. Literally put a damper on our anniversary lunch.

Secondly, the customer service was unsatisfactory. I found the staff to be unhelpful.  when I tried to raise concerns about my order about my meal tasting horrible she took the plate away and dismissed me. This lack of courtesy and professionalism added to the overall frustration of the experience.

Most concerning, however, is that I was charged for a meal that I did not eat. When I mentioned to her that I did not eat the meal I was being charged for she mentioned she could not take it off the bill. After going back and forth she called her manager and the finally removed it from the billI.

I hope you take this feedback seriously and take steps to improve both your food quality and customer service.
The Jollof rice with chicken stew with plantains was absolutely delicious! So many rich flavours, and the service was kind. Thank you!

Samuel is an excellent, polite and passionate waitress, Absolutely Top service from him and his colleagues some of the best I have experienced in my life, very friendly and welcoming.

The food is Fresh and delicious has lots of selection, and I have choice exactly how I want it and well provided .

I will definitely come back. Y’all should try . 🥰❤️

Best place to be.
Comfortable in any way! Can’t explain the Servise feel home anytime good be there check it out, recommend to y’all.

Always loads of customers hanging around outside, leaving rubbish and mess and urinateing in the street. My female friends are scared waking past in the evening so I have to go meet them. The road is full of their customers cars blocking the pavements and paths, probably drink driving home.
Perfect for casual dining.
Amazing place and very friendly staff sami, tsehaye and timnit

name: Daphanie's Taste of the Caribbean London
address: 173 Peckham High St, London SE15 5SL, UK

reviews.text: Do not eat from here. I ordered jerk chicken and curry goat with rice and peas and a beef patty. The patty was dry and the beef looked like it had been mashed up to a paste like a child was about to eat it, it had not be seasoned, it just tasted like water. It was almost as if they boiled the beef. Then, the jerk chicken had a weird taste to it. Never in my whole life of eating jerk chicken have I ever tasted such a taste before, it tasted like the chicken was expired. Finally, the curry goat had the same problem. It tasted off, the meat was not good at all. I then got food poisoning later that day. If you want good Jamaican or Caribbean food, please go find a place in Brixton, clearly Peckham cyaa cook.

Wasn’t really feeling this meal. I’m half Jamaican and half Guyanese I believe there was too much (if any) Cassareep in the oxtail, so it was very sweet. Gravy was VERY thick, hardly any butter beans. The “fried chicken” I think they were trying to be healthy but I wasn’t there to eat healthy food. Better luck next time 🙏🏾

I bought fried chicken and rice and peas it was disgusting the food smells stale rotten with no taste how can you get fried chicken wrong!! I was so upset with my self because I KNEW not to go there since the original owner left and moved back to Jamaica the new owners can not coook!! pls hire a proper chef your food is nasty I’ve ordered 3 times since You’ve taken over and each time it’s been disgusting and horrible. I was really gonna do a chargeback but simply because you’re a black business I didn’t but I will never step in there again. It is disgusting.

The disrespect, passing off old stale chicken as jerk and smothering it in some weird sauce to disguise the fact it was rotten meat. Nah, I used to go Daphanies back in the days but it’s gone down hill. Respect your customers cos we know what proper jerk looks and tastes like.

Food was nice
Reasonable prices for the portion that you get, just didn't get no veg on the side, but coleslaw was available
Shop was very clean and the staff very friendly. Good customer service
I would eat here again
Thank you

Lovely cafe, cozy and charming. Between 3 we shared vegan platter dish and had bottle of pop each and came to £22, great budget friendly meal. Would prob order more for dinner or for bigger appetites. Simple no fuss service, server also preparing food so some patience but nice place to spend some time in. Nice music and wide space for buggy or wheelchair. We came on Saturday about 3 and was quite between lunch and dinner but still serving.
Definition of hidden gem! Such flavoursome food, lovely service, great atmosphere. We got the Shuq special and it was £15 and served two! If I lived locally I’d be back all the time

We had such a nice time eating here! The food was delicious, service was friendly and really attentive and the cafe itself was cosy and nicely decorated! Really reasonable pricing for very generous portions too! Really recommend!
Food is very delicious and great value. Service is super friendly. The milkshake tastes really good as well without being too sweet. Lovely interior and nice vibe. Would definitely visit again!
Third time visiting, but first time eating as usually just pop in for a hot drink. The staff are always friendly. Food was very delicious and full of flavours. Will def be back to eat again.

Love the old school vibe of this place. The staff were lovely and super chatty. I thought the place opened at 12 midday but at 11am they were open with two sandwich options. I tried the vegetarian broccoli sandwich. It was great, the roasted broccoli paired well with the tangy slaw. Cost £7 so cheaper than other options.

This is my death row meal. Anything from this place. The bread is sensational. The sauce full of flavour. The meat succulent. The entire sandwich itself is perfect and cannot be beaten. I will rave about Cafe Mondo forever. #1 fan

Came from an appointment at Southwark registry and walked past this vibey sandwich shops, and had the Roman emperor and mando frango! We told them we had come from our wedding registry notice appt and they left us a sweet message on our sandwich. Will definitely come back for sure

Got bored of waiting in the TOAD line so came here instead. I loved this place! Thought the whole vibe of it was super unusual but very cool. The sandwiches were delicious - I would say the UK doesn’t do sandwiches that well in general but this is an exception. I got the turkey kale ceaser sub, which was fantastic - stuffed full of turkey, a delicious sauce and I loved the addition of the kale. If I had to critique it, I would say I would’ve liked it to included more kale to balance out the kale:turkey ratio better, as the turkey can be quite heavy/rich. I thought the addition of pickled onions was clever - their tanginess really lifted the sandwich. I also tried one of the potato latkes - it was very greasy but so deliciously moorish - seasoned to perfection! If you’re feeling like being unhealthy definitely order one of those on the side. Next time I come back I’d love to try one of their sandwiches (I tried their sub this time)

Very good sandwiches tbf, few options so you know they’re good and fresh. Vegan options too. probably worth the price although they can fall apart in your hands cus they’re filled so much, take from that what you will

I recently visited Chen Thai and tried a few different dishes.

I started with the vegetable spring rolls, and they really stood out. They had a unique twist—filled with fresh vegetables and glass noodles, which gave them a nice texture and flavor different from the usual spring rolls I’ve had before. Definitely worth trying!

Next, I had the fried rice. It was good—well-cooked, flavorful, and satisfying, though not something I’d say was extraordinary. It’s solid, just not the highlight of the meal.

The part that disappointed me was the Tom Yum soup. I’ve had many Tom Yum soups before, but this one felt too light. The spiciness and the rich, slightly thicker consistency I usually expect were missing. It wasn’t bad, but it lacked the depth of flavor that makes Tom Yum so special. I also noticed it didn’t seem to have Thai onion leaf (unless I’m mistaken), which for me is part of the authentic taste. Overall, the soup didn’t meet my expectations.

I’m sorry, but I have to give my honest review—I came to your restaurant based on the positive reviews I read, but unfortunately my experience didn’t fully match them. That being said, most of the other items were good, and the spring rolls in particular were a pleasant surprise. I’d come back to try more dishes, but I’d probably skip the Tom Yum next time.
Really delicious authentic Thai food. Great for veggies. Reasonable prices and friendly service, definitely recommend!

This was my first time going to this restaurant after seeing good reviews about it on TikTok. I wanted to try a new somewhere new and it was the perfect choice!
As a starter, we ordered the Satay Chicken which was perfectly cooked and charred. It had subtle flavour but it was enough as the Satay Sauce added more flavour.
The Satay sauce was peppery & creamy with peanuts which added some consistency.

I ordered the Green Curry & my partner ordered the Red Curry. Both curries were extremely flavourful, not salty or overbearingly spicy. It was rich with flavour, the chicken was tender and succulent, the veg to chicken ratio was on point for us & the broth was hearty. The Green Curry had a little spice but nothing unbearable. It was a subtle heat that didn’t get worse the more we ate. 10/10 & I will be visiting again to try more dishes.

Popped in on our way back to Margate after visiting someone in hospital nearby. Just a shade over £40 for two for starter, main and drinks. Staff were warm, friendly and super polite. The restaurant is beautiful with great decorations and the food was absolutely delicious we had a parang and a massaman curry, absolutely beautiful. Great service and delicious food all at a fabulous price!

A true gem just off the buzzing lordship lane. I have visited Thailand many times and this food totally hit the mark and all the flavours.

Such a lovely little restaurant. Lovely staff, and great food!!

Can’t wait to come back.

For a bar, they make some STELLAR pizza and cake. Seriously, the food here is comparable to specialised pizza restaurants and bakeries. Drinks are made fast and efficiently with a relaxed atmosphere. Great hangout spot for friends. I recommend getting an English Garden as a drink here.

I agree with the "artsy" comments, and I am a bit undecided on whether the place is purposely like that or just neglected, but either way, it did the job. Prices are definitely not neglected, fyi, but not more expensive than any other pub in the area either. There are some food options which I did not get to try but those seem to be priced all right.
The outside area is a nice touch for those rare summer days when you actually can actually sit outside but at 22:00 you will be asked to move inside.

The Peckham Pelican — Art, Pizza, and Chill

Located near Camberwell College of Arts, The Peckham Pelican is known for its affordable menu, relaxed ambiance, and support for local artists. It’s a great spot for students, creatives, and anyone looking for a no-frills, welcoming place to hang out.

What to Expect

Pizza & bar snacks — simple, tasty, and budget-friendly

Wide drink selection — beers, wines, and casual cocktails

Outdoor seating — ideal for sunny afternoons

Art on the walls — rotating exhibitions from local artists

Digital payments accepted — including Visa, Mastercard, Amex

Great vibe inside, nice drinks and comfy seating
Didn’t get food but their food menu looked very nice. Great value prices for drinks and food.

The Peckham Pelican — Where Art, Eats, and Atmosphere Collide

Located near Camberwell College of Arts, The Peckham Pelican is a local favourite that blends pub culture with a creative twist. It’s known for its eclectic crowd, rotating art displays, and a menu that’s simple but satisfying.

Food & snacks:

Chorizo pizza — one of the most popular items, spicy and cheesy
Laksa — a surprising Southeast Asian touch
Chips & bar snacks — perfect with a pint
Cakes & bagels — ideal for daytime visits
Vegetarian-friendly options — clearly marked and well-liked

Drinks:

Cheap beers & cocktails — great value for London
Corona, wine, and spirits — casual and well-stocked
Coffee & soft drinks — for non-alcoholic moments

Atmosphere:

Artsy and relaxed — attracts students, creatives, and locals
Live performances & events — music, spoken word, and more
Outdoor seating — great for summer evenings
LGBTQ+ friendly — inclusive and welcoming
Free Wi-Fi — makes it a good spot for solo visits or remote work

This is my favourite café in the whole area, and honestly I would travel across the city just to come here. The staff are incredible genuinely warm, friendly and welcoming. Every time I walk in, it feels like coming home. You get that rare feeling that people are actually happy to see you, and it immediately puts you in a good mood.
The food is amazing as well. Everything tastes fresh and real, nothing feels artificial or plastic like in many places. You can really tell the ingredients are good quality and prepared with care.
And the matcha here is on another level. It’s genuinely the best matcha I’ve ever had. The syrup is perfect, the milk is great, and the balance of flavours is just right.
The atmosphere is super cozy, and they also have a terrace which makes it even nicer.
Service is always fast, everything is prepared quickly, and the whole place just has a really good vibe. It’s not the closest café for me to get to, but I still come here because it’s worth it. If friends or my parents visit me, this is definitely the place I will take them, even if it means a few metro and bus transfers. That’s how good it is.

We discovered Love Walk Café while attending a hospital appointment with my mum and were craving something warm and comforting on a winter day.

We ordered a hot chocolate,latte and two paninis, the classic and the ham and cheese, both served with a fresh side salad. Everything was prepared quickly and to a great standard.

The service truly stood out. Both ladies, one at the till and the other preparing the hot drinks, were extremely friendly, efficient, and welcoming, with genuine smiles that made the experience even more pleasant.

As time flew by and we needed to rush to our appointment, the staff kindly helped us convert everything to takeaway swiftly and seamlessly, including carefully packing the sandwiches and drinks. Their responsiveness and calm efficiency made all the difference.

We left feeling genuinely happy and well looked after. I would highly recommend Love Walk Café to anyone looking for a cosy, family friendly spot with great service. We will definitely be returning, next time to try the Full English breakfast.

Love Walk Cafe
81 Denmark Hill
Camberwell
London
SE5 8RS

TEL. NO. 020 7703 9898
WEBSITE.  MENU – Love Walk Cafe https://share.google/DHHGEjPHabJUdZbfpĺ

The coffees are of good quality.
The décor and setting are stylised, quirky and comfortable.

A wide menu with plenty of choices: breakfasts (Full English, American style pancakes), vegetarian/vegan options, fresh juices.

Located in a nice spot in Camberwell, so good for a relaxed brunch or coffee meet-up.

Outdoor seating and relaxed atmosphere: useful for groups or catching up.

Pricing may be a bit higher than some nearby cafés.

If I were recommending it:

Go for a brunch or coffee meet-up with friends. The big breakfasts, pancakes and juice menu are strong.

If you value photography / atmosphere, this place scores well (quirky décor + good light + outdoor).

Try going a little earlier (say around 9-10 am) to avoid peak crowding and to get good seats outdoors (weather permitting).

If you're after vegetarian/vegan options, it’s a good bet here.

Ideal for a relaxed catch-up, working on a laptop or reading — but perhaps not the fastest service place if you’re in a rush.

A short walk from King's College Hospital. Good breakfast selection served quickly. Had eggs royal with a latte. Nice to get a latte that's strong and hot. A bit pricey and the loos are a bit basic. Otherwise very pleasant with friendly staff.

I had lunch at Love Walk Cafe and absolutely enjoyed it. The food was delicious, well-prepared, and high quality. The atmosphere was nice, and the service really stood out, The staff Sumon was especially friendly and welcoming. Highly recommend this place for a great meal!

A nice enough spot that popped up near a mate’s house so we popped down. Overall quite chaotic service (busy doesn’t have to always be chaotic) and the food was middling.

We came maybe mistakenly on a Saturday morning around 9:30 and found a table, but you’re really shoulder to shoulder with other guests, and it felt quite cramped. We had our order taken about 15 mins after sitting down which is quite a long time, and food was quick, coffee even quicker which are big wins, but the food was a let down. Rarebit was quite dry and the fennel salad paltry, and the pancake really need some break in texture/flavour. Some fresh fruit (can be sourced from wales haha) and maybe some sort of cream addition would help break up each bite. I was hungry but the monotony of flavour wore me down and I couldn’t finish the ditch, and neither could the surrounding tables I saw. The filter coffee however was served in lovely cups and saucers and was delicious, like standout delicious.

Would be a lovely neighbourhood cafe if it wasn’t so busy, but I think the food could also do with some work, but the kitchen is obviously small! Visit in about 6 months I reckon, maybe 10 when it’s a stretch more calm.

I wouldn’t even bother arriving after 11 on the weekend, unless you really like queueing.

Oh and there was a £4 ‘delivery fee’ on my order? No idea what that was, it was about 25% of the price so make sure you check your receipt.
The cutest new cafe! The lamb sandwich was DELICIOUS and those miso cookies are UNREAL, I could eat one every day. Will definitely be going back for more. All in all a great addition to Peckham.
Superb new Cafe, fresh delicious breads, sandwiches, buns and coffee. Faultless food and service and a wonderful friendly, bustling atmosphere
Gorgeous café, ordered the Caerphilly steak sandwich and the crab rarebit both of which were exquisite. Can’t wait to go back and try the whole menu!
Such a nice café! The breakfast granola and lunch sandwiches are amazing. Really good coffee too. I worked here with my laptop and the staff were really great

name: Just Fab Kitchen - Breakfast Brunch Restaurant
address: Unit 54B, 48 Rye Ln, London SE15 5BY, UK

reviews.text: Liked the create your own option. Good brunch with my daughter. Enjoyed the pancakes, they were full of  flavour. Syrup was nice. Loved the beans. Can't wait to go back with friends
Delicious and filling brunch well worth the price and very friendly customer service!! Serious portions so come hungry. Would definitely return to try more of the menu.

What a lovely experience my wife and I had here! The staff are all friendly, straight away we were greeted with a smile and we were promptly shown the halal breakfast menu, which we had asked for.
The food here was most definitely a 10 out of 10 for me. There wasn't a single thing on our plate that wasn't seasoned well. Everything tasted delicious. The price was a little over 18 pounds for 2 people sharing a breakfast plate and was more than filling. We will be back soon! I would highly recommend this place.

I visited Just Fab with my best friend & we were pleasantly welcomed by the owner with a warm smile and great energy.
I was pleased to see that there was halal options available (I ordered chicken sausages & turkey rashers)  which was great because it's difficult finding spots that offer pork AND halal breakfast/brunch menus to cater to ALL so you can eat with your family/friends no matter your dietary preference!
I would 100% return back to Just Fab! Really appreciate the location too, I usually have to travel to East London for these types of cafes but Just Fab is literally a short bus ride for me!
Hats off to the chef, she has done an amazing job so far with the business & I wish her nothing but more success, happy customers and hopefully a bigger restaurant in the future!

I went here with my girlfriend and got the 𝐁𝐢𝐠 𝐇𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐥 𝐁𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐤𝐟𝐚𝐬𝐭. It was amazing! The food was fresh, the portion size was massive and everything was oozing with flavour. We also got the watermelon drink. It was super refreshing and is a great choice for anyone that loves fruit.

As for the service, the founder was very hospitable, had great conversation skills, and made us feel at home. We were talking for so long that we didn't give her time to start making our food for a good while!  I would definitely recommend this place. We have tried a lot of food spots from Tik Tok before that are really bland and this definitely isn't one of them!

Was driving pass and thought I’d pop in. Instantly amazed at the healthy menu available and decided I’ll have the smashed avocado with red onion and chilli flakes on toast. Amazing presentation. Food tasted as lovely as it looked. Staff were polite, friendly and welcoming. Oh and the music was very soothing.

We had to ask for our table to be cleaned twice as the 1st time wasn’t done properly.
All empty tables had crumbs. And at 2pm they only had cheese toasties left.
The place looks worn and looks like it needs some love and care.
The food was nice though.

Cosy cafe in East Dulwich/Peckham borders with outside seating as well. Food good; I particularly like their quiches & they also do lovely cakes. Friendly service. Very popular place & can get busy at peak times.  Thumbs up.

Wonderful location, disappointing food.
Minimal menu, which is fine, but get it right: quiche was insipid and not like any quiche I’ve had, just lacking, while the yellow, undercooked pastry had to be broken and bitten as cutting was too challenging. Grubby environment and lack lustre care about table clearing.
A café with potential and few damns given, based on our experience.
Lovely place under a big tree. Sitting in the sun, shade and enyoing breakfast could not be better. Very tasteful and with the best coffees and teas. Also great for mid day drinks and lunch.

name: BAR D4100
address: BAR D4100, 143 Evelina Rd, London SE15 3HB, UK

reviews.text: The food was good, the pizzas were nice and filling and I liked how you can add any and all toppings. I loved the dough balls, the butter with it had (I think) coriander which was great. The Tiramisu was good, but honestly nothing special. The sorbet was surprisingly tasty for it being vegan. The drinks were tasty as well, though I wish my Guava Soda was sweeter. I would’ve asked for that, like I do in other restaurants, but we weren’t checked on or really had the opportunity to once we were served our food, though I understand that could’ve been because of it being busy during Valentine’s Day. The waiting staff was however very informed about the menu which was great, and polite and friendly whenever interacting. The atmosphere was very cute as well, very cozy and I loved all the pictures in the walls and the lighting, especially the bottle candles.

Best pizza in south London. Or maybe all of London?! They also have the best newsletters which I genuinely look forward to receiving. And their singles nights! I haven’t met the love of my life yet but I’ll keep buying and keep trying. Come here for chilled community vibes, affordable drinks, and the best tuna pizza going. Posting some pics from when I celebrated my bday here and they made it super special by giving me a free pizza! Also these guys have started doing BREAKFAST and COFFEE. I had a tuna panuozzo and an oat flat white (see pics). Think pizza mixed with panini (dietaries catered for). Thanks guys!
We had a lovely lunch here today. Gorgeous spot, with superb pizzas and tasty local beers. We will be back!

Hands down my favourite pizza place in London. Cloud like pizza dough, staff are lovely, cosy atmosphere, lush natural wine and cocktails (limoncello spritz is my fave) - 10/10.

Came in for lunch and had this ham, cheese and jalapeño panuozzo sandwich. And they now do coffee! What’s not to love.
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Best pizza in London. Been consistently incredible since they opened in Tele hill. We came for a panuozzo and coffee for lunch today in Nunhead and it was top tier as always!!!

Really eclectic little cocktail bar. The drinks were fabulous and we really enjoyed the atmosphere. It was quiet at the time we went...I imagine it would be really good when buzzing with more folks.
It was very cold though... So I would recommend they turn the heating up
Great cocktails, stylish bar, lovely and intimate atmosphere, perfect for a date night. One of the coolest bars in peckham! The amaretto cocktail is awesome!
Love the atmosphere and cocktails were so proper and tasty! Visited during the happy hour, so wasn’t too busy. Definitely will revisit!

This bar is a (my) dream come true: Flowers, plants, beatiful art & vintage interior, delicious drinks -  overall amazing vibes!!
We felt like being in our own time capsule, where you can relax and simply enjoy the current moment. Also the service was great - our waiter was super attentive and we had a great chat with the owner! 10/10, absolutely recommend, and I am looking forward coming back.

Love It! My friend brought me here for the first time yesterday - and it won't be my last! The Decor is beautiful, Artsy and cosy vibes, so many cool things to look at and take pictures of. The staff- particularly Devine (yes that was the young man's name) were brilliant. We felt very looked after, thank you so much. We enjoyed the fantastic happy hour, which was 4 classic cocktails for £30! And the cocktails were great! I don't often go somewhere and not have to return a drink, because they don't actually know how to make them, but these were yummy!
They also have an upstairs area, with a second bar, which would probably be good for small private parties!
Can't wait to go back! Thank you. X

name: The Pizza Joint - Dulwich
address: 42 E Dulwich Rd, London SE22 9AX, UK

reviews.text:
Used the "TooGoodToGo" for the first time.   Very quick and simple process, great App. "Vinay" great guy who made my pizza once I arrived. Which I wasn't expecting.
Great service and a very friendly guy. I would fully recommend.
The pizza was perfect, it tasted so fresh compared to Pizza Hut.
10/10 on all categories
And again I would recommend.

Pre-ordered a pizza via the website at 9pm for delivery at 9.45pm, since I would be getting home after a long flight at 9.30pm. At 9.55, I had to call the restaurant to ask where my pizza was. I got the lie: “it’s on its way, just wait 3-4 minutes”. Bear in mind I live a 2 minute drive from the restaurant. At 10.05, I called again to say “forget it, it’s too late. I’m tired, I need to sleep, I don’t want your pizza, I want a refund”. The person I spoke to tried to stall me until the driver arrived, who then brandished a pathetic free soft drink as an apology.

If you knew it was late, and you knew why, and you knew it was actually going to arrive after 10, you should have been honest and let me decide what to do. If the driver was delayed but the pizza was ready, I could have come to collect. But you didn’t say that, you lied and told me it was on the way.

I’m still waiting for my refund.

Amazing tasty affordable pizza. Great competition for papa johns next door. Got 2 large pizzas for £6.99 each. Bargain! Looking forward to my next order. I think I’ll be a regular. And the garlic dip is the best I’ve had😆
This place is way better than the old papa johns and also very affordable. This pizza is one of the best takeout pizzas Ive ever had, even surpassing dominos in my opinion.

very good food, for some reason they don't take cash on Fridays only card. but told them with me only cash so they accept my Oder so I can pay them cash. Not to sure way way only card payment on Fridays? but they do over Ture this and take cash has well. but other ways there food and service to great

We ordered a mix of starters, mains and drinks. Everything was delicious and freshly made. It is more a take away than a restaurant, but the service was good and very friendly. We were even given a bell to order and catch the attention of the staff as needed. It was novelty, but worked well for us 😁

It is one of the best Indian we have eaten in the local area. We will definitely be returning.

Incredible food and service truly ! I’m Sri Lankan and this food is at the quality of what would be served up at my family home . This is no frills joint , serving authentic South Indian. In addition the  staff were so lovely , they even brought a heater out for us and were overall very friendly, kind and attentive . In terms of dishes the stand out for me was the spicy aubergine, dhal and coconut prawn curry with Paratha ! The Plain Dosa was also great though . I will be visiting and ordering from here again and again !

Such a great local place. Often make it our midweek quick dinner. We have the masala dosa, which is excellent (and much better when you eat in so it stays crispy). The mutton rolls are also delicious; hot, robust, lots of flavour. Often a meal for two comes in at a very reasonable ~£35. We’ll be back regularly

My family and I spent Christmas Day at this truly outstanding takeaway, and it couldn’t have been more special. From the very start, we were blown away by the kindness of the people running it, genuinely wonderful hosts who made us feel so welcome. The food was absolutely delicious, all freshly prepared with top-quality ingredients, and we loved discovering several South Indian dishes we’d never tried before like for example Dosa.
Thank you again for making our Christmas feel genuinely magical!
Really tasty… and customisable South-Indian (Keralian /Malayalam cooking) 🍳. All the staff are nice. Bring cash for discounts.

name: SoulFood Peckham
address: 27A Peckham High St, London SE15 5EB, UK

reviews.text:
I got rice&peas with oxtail and coleslaw this is a small this was £10  and a portion of jerk chicken was £6 so in total it was only £16 pound for this which I didn’t even finish took the rest home.

The food tastes very nice and clean.

Shop was also clean and very nice guy at the till he took his time to explain what comes with the dishes which was really lovely.

Overall I would say 9/10 food was really good and really excited to try their other dishes soon

Suchhhh flavourful and juicy chicken that fell off the bone. The coleslaw wasn’t too mayonnaisey and there wasn’t too much - over doing the chicken so grateful for that. There was plenty of chicken - great portion size. Jerk sauce was so rich, rice perfectly cooked and my craving for jerk chicken at 13 on a Sunday afternoon has been satisfied.

Lovely friendly set up and staff. Not too much seating but of course mostly takeout. Cash and card.

Perfect for an amazing meal that will fill you up and taste amazing

Best meal we had in London, visiting from Toronto and New York area. Small local spot with amazing Jamaican food and affordable; we ordered the oxtail and jerk chicken. Halal too! Owner was SO kind and it was her birthday. Loved visiting and will we back when we are back in town
Unfortunately, I was served chicken, which was undercooked. I had to throw it away. Please ensure your food is cooked thoroughly.

Insanely good! We had to try this place during a visit to London from Somerset and not only was the food incredible but the friendly service and hospitality was amazing. Cannot wait to come back when we next visit London again! Thanks so much 🫶

name: Chick Chicken
address: 113A Peckham High St, London SE15 5SE, UK

reviews.text: Simple takeaway with good portion sizes. Not fancy, but the food does the job and is satisfying.
Food is very delicious 100 💯 percent recommend specially the grilled chicken and pizza...😋😋
Excellent food… Pizza’s and grilled wings are the most popular items…

I’ve been in here for so long I think i’m aging.Their service is horrible,I only asked for wings and chips and they are acting like I ordered the whole menu meanwhile the shop IS EMPTY,not even packed…Too busy having a conversation with his friend.
Pizza is consistently a sloppy mess. The toppings and cheese slip off the base.

Do not order from here.  Very small portions, and extremely disappointing delivery. £60 of food , cold wet and the sauces were smashed in the bag.  just about £30. Rude staff , told me they don’t control the weather ! Obviously! Bit cold wet food is not what I expected. Directing back to just eat.  SCAM ! The reviews are clearly fabricated. Do NOT order from here. Waste of money, time and energy!

This used to be my go-to spot for a kebab in London, but over the last year or two, it has sadly declined significantly—both in food quality and customer service.

One of the biggest issues is the owner’s attitude. I’ve noticed a real shift in how he treats customers, and unfortunately, it’s not for the better. While I was in the shop, a foreign man came in and politely asked for chicken wings. The owner clearly understood him, yet pretended not to and went as far as mocking his accent. To make things worse, as he was holding the raw chicken wings in the air, he continued to mock the man, dragging out the moment and making the whole thing feel unnecessarily uncomfortable and rude.

Then, while preparing my food, I noticed something even more concerning—cross-contamination. The same utensils used to handle raw chicken wings were then used on my food without being cleaned. This is a serious food safety issue that should never happen in a restaurant.

On top of that, the owner’s general attitude towards customers was just rude and unprofessional. I saw him snap at another customer for no real reason, speaking to them in a sharp and dismissive tone. It was clear he had no patience or respect for the people coming into his shop.

He also seems to be cutting corners with the food. He used to generously apply sauces directly onto the kebabs as requested, but now everything is given in small plastic tubs, which feels like a downgrade in both quality and experience.

The pictures I’ve uploaded are from a couple of years ago when this place was genuinely one of the best, and I can personally vouch for how much better it was back then. Sadly, the standards have dropped so much that I, as a once loyal customer, won’t be returning. A) The food quality has gone downhill, and B) the poor service and ignorant attitude are unacceptable.

It’s disappointing to see a once great kebab spot decline like this, but based on my recent experience, I can’t recommend it anymore.

Great place for a day with friends, family, private party or with partner or special someone!!

The food is great and healthy. Salad I freshly prepared every morning and so are the meats. Their home made burger is amazing and delicious and a must try.  Cozy atmosphere and welcoming and friendly staff. Food is always prepared fresh, always a great choice. I’ve had dates with friends here and it’s great, eating in is different prices to take out but worth the experience and atmosphere.

You can call ahead and get your order ready for pick up and it’s a great place to grab lunch during break time as they have an affordable day lunch menu.

On this occasion I’m taking out for dinner and it’s was another great experience. I ordered two large lamb shush with salad, a large chips and one portion of ribs and one portion of wings. Grilled to perfection and tender and delicious!!

👌🏽👌🏽5*!!

Full marks for amazing food, amazing service, and amazing atmosphere. So why only 3 stars for atmosphere? Because it was quite chilly inside sitting down to eat. Otherwise it's the perfect place for lunch. Much better than the cheap Chinese buffet next door.

I've been here many times over the years, usually to sit in and eat, one of my favourite places for delicious turkish food. Chicken shish is a favourite along with the rice. Has a nice atmosphere, great photographs on the walls, and decor with a friendly service. Highly recommend this place.

name: Bolu Restaurant and Takeaway
address: 7 Camberwell Church St, London SE5 8TR, UK

reviews.text: I've been coming here since 2014 and the food and quality has been great consistently. The staff are lovely and accommodating and the food is just the best I don't care where I am. I will travel for this food !!! The portion sizes are great too. Thank you for always being there for a great meal and service

A really good restaurant for mix kebab. We went in when it was a little busy but the waitress acknowledged us and asked us to wait a little before taking our order.
We were given salad and bread with a mix of sauces as well as some hummus and olives whilst waiting for our main to come. The mix kebab which came was huge and plenty for two people. You get to choose if you want chips or rice as a side but we asked if it was possible to have a little of both to which they accommodated. Once we were done, we were then given baklavas to finish our meal. Please note their dine in menu is slightly more expensive than their takeaway menu. However they do not take service charge so no surprise addition to your bill at the end, only what you see on the menu!
Very nice oriental restaurant. Delicious food, nice friendly service for fair prices. I think that I will be revisiting this place 🙌🏼

The BEST KEBAB SHOP IN CAMBERWELL/PECKHAM/BRIXTON.

I love it here, always great food and great service.
The kebabs are fresh and well cooked.
They home make all the food and minced kebabs.
