Very generous portions  for really cheap price.
The homemade burger is amazing! It’s absolutely huge, it is like two big burgers in one and has and incredible flavour and they fill it with all the salad and sauces you want. It’s very good quality meat and wow just incredible. Loads of chips also and great price for just £10 meal.

The shawarmas wraps always hit the spot too after a busy shift or a night out!

The place is super clean and everything looks good.

They also do proper barista coffee and will be the only place to get a good coffee late at night.

Love these guys they’re brilliant.

Came here for lunch mid-week, prompt service and food. Good prices. Was quiet and clean. Portions were a decent size, food tasted delicious. Had lamb and chicken kebab meals. Salad and sauces were fresh and tasty. Would definitely return!

name: Happy Inn
address: 131 New Cross Rd, London SE14 5DJ, UK

reviews.text: I’ve lived nearby for 15 years and have been ordering from Happy Inn all this time. It’s the best Chinese restaurant in our southeast area. The chicken wings and the king prawn chow mein are especially good — I order them every time. The food is always served piping hot and has a real home-style feel. Their chili oil is homemade, incredibly fresh, and properly spicy. The atmosphere is also great: air-conditioned in summer and heater in winter. I like chatting with the staff — it’s very relaxing.

Through a friend’s recommendation, I’ve eaten here many times, and this is the best Chinese takeaway I’ve ever had. The prices are about half of what you’d pay in a restaurant.

My favorite dish is the shredded crispy beef fragrant, and spicy, absolutely delicious! And chili garlic chicken wings Everything is freshly cooked to order, hot and full of flavor. I feel very lucky to have found food with such great quality and value.

I’ll definitely be coming back often! If you haven’t tried it yet, I highly recommend giving it a go.

Solid Chinese food, worth trying

Tried Happy Inn Chinese Takeaway a few times now and it’s been pretty consistent. The food is simple, comforting, and actually hits the spot, especially when you don’t feel like cooking. Portions are decent and the prices are fair for London.

One thing I like is that they’re quite flexible with spice levels. If you don’t eat spicy food, you can just tell them “no spicy” when ordering. If you do like heat, it’s easy to add chili yourself, so it works for different preferences without any fuss.

Delivery has been reliable and the food usually arrives hot. Nothing over-the-top fancy, but it does what a good takeaway should do.

I’d say it’s a good option for Goldsmiths students or anyone nearby looking for a regular, no-stress Chinese takeaway. Worth giving it a try if you’re in the area.

Feb 2026. This place is a scam. They insist on cash payments but would not accept a perfectly legal Northern Irish note. Then he asked me to pay online but the prices are more expensive! Even customers in the shop backed me up and walked out of the shop when they realised his racism towards me. I've been a customer here for over 15 years and have never been made to feel so terrible. Any legitimate business accepts both cash and card. I'm assume it's something about tax declarations.

Response to restaurant reply: Again, it is not my fault that you employed people who don't understand. Other people in the shop verified that my bank note was acceptable and it was clearly not fake. Your staff refused to look at it and claimed it was not real money. This is a very politically charged statement to tell a Northern Irish person that they are not really British.

Lovely family run business. We use for our Chinese takeaway & they smashed it as usual. Very busy, but always friendly welcome and fast service. Chicken satay skewers, crispy duck, ho fun, brocoli, pork with Singapore fried rice, crispy duck etc are the usual family orders.

I stop putting salt in my food a few months ago and actually stop eating Chinese during this time.
I decided to have a cheat meal from here and the amount of salt within my food was crazy. Ended up drinking so much water to take the taste of salt out of my mouth. Maybe it was a one off but I will not be going back here anytime soon
Unbeatable price/quality ratio. Super delicious food and generous portions. Dont expect 5-star service, be aware of what kind of place this is

Would give 0 if possible , preferred ribs in honey sauce and has absolutely no honey, ribs are stale and dry and rice smells off. On top of that I almost waited a bleeding hour for my food to come even though I live 5 mins away. Do not buy from here

Did a phone order lastnight for the children as I was away and our usual shop was closed.. we ordered sweet and soup chicken and boiled rice... The children complained and didn't eat the food protesting that it was very salty. Waste of money really. They didn't call and tell me until I came home so I couldn't call and let the shop know. I will today and see what will be there response

I strongly urge you to avoid this takeaway at all costs; it is unacceptable and should be reported to the Food Standards Agency immediately! The man taking orders was scratching his head, causing dandruff to fall onto his shirt, which he casually brushed off with his hands. Another employee was sneezing without bothering to cover his mouth. I left feeling nauseated and appalled by the lack of hygiene. They have put me off buying Chinese food for life!
Simply delicious food!!! This is an excellent place, cant wait to go back. Friendly service and very good prices too.

A nice little grill spot in the heart of the busy peckham high street.
If you're looking for a quick stop & eat while out shopping in peckham i recommend this place, the staff are  welcoming & happy to help get you exactly what you are looking for. The food is yummy and cooked to order.
They also have a small selection of desserts to round off your meal.
I will be eating here again 😊👌
11/10 Ahmed Masri and Mustafa amazing. They make the shop spectacular with the good vibes and amazing food. Everybody must try this place if you like authentic Lebanese food.
genuinely amazing, some of the best lamb i've ever had

This place used to be really good before but it on its way downhill, the guya area always friendly but the quality of food has degraded. I got a Lamb Shawarma platter today to take away and the meat was horrible, no taste and looked like it died twice, also did not look fresh. More fat than actual meat and it cost me £14. I can honestly say it was £14 wasted. I love Lebanese food but this place does not give an authentic taste anymore. Portions are also small for the price you pay. I dont think i will be coming back here

name: Patty Island
address: 40 Camberwell Church St, London SE5 8QZ, UK

reviews.text: Amazing experience, wonderful customer service (Didn't get his name, but banter and jokes from the moment I walked in) and Amazing food 🥰😍. Not from camberwell.. came for good food and GREAT food we GOT!!! Jerk rice, Jerk chicken, fried chicken, coleslaw and Patties 🤤🤤.  Thanks. Will be back. Hoping parking is better next time.
Amazing service and amazing food! Loved the sorrel juice as well. 💛💛

Not sure if it’s under new management or there’s a new chef but recently the food has been SLAPPING. Fresh patties, dark sweet plantain and the food looks fresh. Clearer pricing now too. Next time going to try the meats

The jerk chicken was very salty and horrible, the first chicken had no flavour. The festivals had no taste. The customer service was poor. If you know your food isn't great at least offer good customer service. It takes nothing smile!
I bought the patty deal for £7.50 along with 3 dinners for my family.  When I got home 🤢. Let's say they all going in the bin. Judge for yourself
Honestly, probably the best fast-food/takeaway chicken I’ve even had. Not sure what these birds were fed before being fried, but they were MASSIVE wings.
Very good best chicken shop ever

Words can not express how good this food is I was flooded with feelings of ultimate pleasure when I took a bite out of the chicken I am flabagasted by the pure passion put into making the food I had an out of body experience eating the food

I visited Monleys Local on Wednesday 17/02/2021 for the first time.
My First Impression was VERY PROMISING. The inside and Outside was Very Clean and tidy. Which usually tells ME how hygienic their Food is.
I ordered 6 Chicken pieces with Fries- which was GREAT VALUE for JUST £3.00.
I was VERY IMPRESSED how TASTY the Chicken was, really well seasoned and succulent, with just the right amount of salt.
The Chips was really fresh and tasty.
I thoroughly ENJOYED My experience and most of all THE FOOD!!!
5 STARS for SURE!
JC Anyiam   💚

Local boss man has the best wings. PERIODTTT.
I’ll only trust him with my wings n chicken burgers.

love u boss xox

Edited 5 years later:
I prefer it when the women are behind the counter. They actually listen to your order. Instead of saying “sorry we don’t have flats”, the male servers will give you drums which is so distasteful and insulting.

Where is the mutual respect??
I only go now when I see the women serving which isn’t very often.

My partner recommended getting some food here as he’s been here many times and has enjoyed the food and thought it was good value for money. He hadn’t been here in a while and was surprised to see the price had increased to £10 per meal but the container sizes were like a lunch time special size. I was very underwhelmed with the size and surprised when he said he had just paid £30 for 3 small container and be told that sides such as salad coleslaw or plantain doesn’t come with the meal. I think adding some salad or coleslaw in a meal that costs £10 is very reasonable. I had rice and peas and the fried fish. The rice and peas was nice but the fish was very dry and tough and flavourless. Luckily my partner had asked for a separate EMPTY container but was mistakenly given a tub of sauce which they charged £1 for.But I was grateful for the sauce as this gave the meal flavour that was missing. We were really hungry at this point and still felt like we could have had more to eat. I think if prices are going to increase the size of the meal needs to match this.

I ordered the stew chicken and curry goat with rice and peas, and everything was delicious! The portions were generous, the flavours were authentic, and the food was cooked well. Friendly service and no more than a 10 minute wait. I’ll definitely be ordering again

Curry goat was tender ill give you that but in terms of taste it was lacking spice and seasoning well to my taste buds anyway and the  amount of goat meat was very minimal i mostly got fat and bones and i couldnt even get the marrow out of the amount of bones i had, i dont think i got 2 teaspoons of meat in that whole meal which is disappointing and the rice was ok and the staff could really be abit more talkative and didnt see one smile

Delicious. First time but not the last. I got the jerk pork and fried chicken with rice and peas plantain, and it was lovely but I would've liked extra gravy but that's personal preference, will be back, plus the young lady that served us was really friendly.

Honestly, I didn’t realise I was signing up for a biology lesson when I ordered a jerk chicken meal. £12 later and what did I get? Flesh. Not food — flesh. The chicken was so raw I half expected it to cluck. It had been sitting in a hot container for over an hour, and still looked like it needed CPR.

I declined the offer to reheat the rice (because shockingly, I like to avoid food poisoning where possible), and good thing too — clearly food safety isn’t a top priority. I even gave it a go in the microwave myself and guess what? Still raw. Still pink. Still not OK.

Tried to call the shop at least 9 or 10 times to sort it calmly — no answer. Not once. So here I am, sharing my experience with the internet instead.

To serve someone raw chicken and then be completely unreachable? That’s not just poor service — it’s a public health hazard with a side of cowardice. I’ve supported this place for years. Sadly, this is where it ends. Do better, vile

name: Katies Kitchen Peckham
address: 165 Peckham Hill St, London SE15 5JZ, UK

reviews.text:
I wonder why this shop is underrated.
The chicken is juicy sorry didn't take a photo before my son finishes.
Can taste that the chicken not form frozen. Has wing as well they are pretty good not too salty.
Got my take away on my way back to central London, requested to change the breast to drumsticks as the breast for my 7 years old it might be too dry .
Staff didn't show his unhappy face when i request.
So far great experience.
Generous chicken drumsticks. Nicely battered so that just 5-6 with chips completely killed my hunger. I had the misfortune of taking 7 pieces! Was tasty too, i recommend the hot wings
I ordered pizza from this place on Sunday 11th January and I've been vomitting for two days. Honestly, if I could give less than 1 star, I would....

Best chicken!
Before trying it, I saw it was a fresh batch hence it didn't disappoint
so next time I will try my luck again.
I ordered waffle egg plantain with fried chicken was the best I been hooked ever since

name: Taste of Congo
address: 614 Old Kent Rd, London SE15 1JB, UK

reviews.text: OMG what can I say, I was in there today and the food was delicious the customers service was on point can’t say a bad thing! I’ve actually had everything on the menu! I will be back especially for the BBQ wings u get to choose if you want it’s spicy or not and spicy wing and the ntaba especially, puff. Puff 💆🏾‍♀️🙆🏾‍♀️ they have glazed , and others…see you soon
First time trying Congolese food and I loved it. Great service and amazing jollof

Fantastic takeaway! The owners are super friendly and the portions are really big. We’ve had both a delivery order and gone into collect and each time the food was hot and clearly made to order. The food also isn’t that spicy but has spice on the side, so if you haven’t tried this kind of food before I’d encourage you to give it a go. Also great for vegetarian/vegans and a lot of it is naturally gluten free if you have any of those requirements.
100% recommend trying everything on the menu, my favourite is the wings and pondu. Their portions, the heat of the food, customer service, cleanliness, everything is on point!

Great Family run take away Congo restaurant by the Old Kent Road opposite B&M. I love their puff puff(African Donuts). Great service. Check them out when your near the area. I definitely recommend to give their puff puff a taste.
Ordered on Uber. No chicken in curry. Called shop - rude and wouldn’t do anything about it. Forgot crackers. £38. Will never go back, make sure to tell all friends too

Really tasty food and great variety especially their 'All in one meal' selection. I had to get cash from nearby Sainsbury's but it was well worth the walk! Finger licking good. We had the crispy shredded beef and fried rice All in one meal with kiing prawn balls and sweet n sour sauce. Delicious!

Everything here is very average, but it's one of the few places that opens late a weeknights. The vegetarian spring rolls lacked flavour and filling. Add this place to the list for the moments when there's little choice
I live it here. The staff are friendly and the food is tasty.
Terrible. Ordered meal. Box of rice. Forgot crackers. Terrible service.

I used to live in Peckham, and now that I’m based in NYC, I still make a point to come back to this kebab shop every time I’m in London. Their chicken wings and doner kebab (and the quality toppings) set the bar so high for me that nothing else compares. The brothers who run it are incredibly kind, and after more than a decade in the community, their food and warmth haven’t changed a bit. A true local gem I’m always happy to support. Remember to bring cash!

27/02/2026

I came here to try out my local kebab shop since my dad told me how nice the food is in here I ordered a large lamb doner kebab with chips and garlic mayonaise sauce to takeaway which came to £11 it was full of bold flavours and I shall be coming back here again the only thing I got to remember is to bring cash since they only accept cash - George
Such a great place. The guys are lovely! Very very friendly. The wings were great in flavour and price.
Fantastic food, great staff apart from the Liverpool supporter and apologies it’s been so long but we live in Manchester. Great to see you again, awesome food. Big Lee from Manchester

My go to in South East London, fresh food that is always cooked to perfection. The wings are special. Brothers are great guys, always so welcoming and up for a laugh. Highly recommend if you’re in the area.

Delicious, reasonable price, convenient, hygienic and delicious, suitable for me to eat, save time and leave too precious time for my work and study, so it is worth giving a good review for this shop.
reviews.author_name: 云游子 云游子 云游子

reviews.text: Big fan of the food and good prices too.

My favourite go to Chinese takeaway. I get special fried rice every time, so I wouldn’t be able to recommend many dishes. But my food is always cooked so well. The store is easily accessible and you get served quick and don’t have to wait to long before you get your order.

To be honest the service is zero and i have noticed that over 10 months there has been no  reviews on the website and due to their rubbish service they have not advertised their establishment the way they should. The chicken was old and i noticed it’s processed meet and the reviews tell you everything about the customers satisfaction witch i never got. I’m a chef and any company should be customer focus. the best thing about it was the refunded it was quicker than i received the old crusty old food please order spicy Chicken wings 🤣🤣🤣🤣🤣they was cooked in old oil and just cut up onion and carrot not even chilli 🌶️ flacks and no spice the portions of barbecue ribs was 4 ribs with a little bit of sauce and i ordered a separate barbecue sauce and it was the size of the tub the minimum chilli oil and a bottle of drink witch they don't give free over £25 charge they should look after there customers but they don’t Good managers succeed but bad will be shut down i will say no more. what you sow is what you reap Sort your place out because it’s people’s money and health your dealing with.
My go-to Chinese takeaway! I usually get the sweet & sour chicken with fried rice and the chips with curry sauce. It all hits the spot and is very reasonably priced.

I’m quite particular when it comes to Chinese food, and I’m not a fan of the typical takeaway style that uses too much food colouring and cornstarch. I’m really glad I found this place!

I ordered the roasted pork fried rice  it was delicious, perfectly seasoned, and the portion size was generous enough for two people. I also tried the Chinese dumplings with chilli oil (you have to buy separate), and they were fantastic. I absolutely love chilli oil, and theirs was exceptional rich, fragrant, and full of flavour.

Just a heads-up: they are takeaways only and accept cash only, so make sure to bring some if you’re planning to visit.

I’ve been using this shop for years now; around 15. The present owner is a very loverly, courteous, happy lady! Up until this day, she won’t tell me her name! 😂
Nonetheless, the food has always been tops. The king prawn fried rice and its noodle equivalent, is the best in Peckham. Pepper wings are very yummy too. Must not forget my Chips most Fridays better than most in the area. Highly recommended!
I ordered a large king prawn fried rice only to discover a half dead fly in my food. Disgusted to say the least.
Was going on they have been closed for over a month 😵😟
Best Chinese in Peckham , order the King prawn dishes , egg rice and mixed vegetables .

I called in advance to let them know that I had reserved two too good to go meals, I was very happy with what I received, the food was delicious, nicely spiced and plentyfull I would highly recommend this place, I. Travelled for twenty minutes to get to the shop and it was worth it. 😋😋👏

I got their Too Good To Go bag today. Absolutely amazing and well worth the money. I got so much from the bag! It's basically 3 meals worth, I'm full just from a little bit of their food. Their dishes are well spiced and very flavourful and I really enjoy the different textures that the various veggies give!
My food came with 2 bowls, a curry of a sort, poppadom and a bag of crisps as a thank you. So lovely and warming!

We ordered a too good to go! The food is a different flavor from what I’ve had before! One of the curries was sweet and coco-nutty! Tastes very fresh! The man at the counter was incredibly kind and friendly!!! They were very kind about my gluten intolerance!

Delicious indian takeaway.
Cooked properly, homemade curries, tasty and fresh. Huge range if dishes on menu. I love the lamb curries, so tender.
Only thing is wait is always around 1 hour and also portions are on smaller side.
Also some of the veg sides are a bit simple.

Just had a surprising vegetarian feast from here. The food is delicious, fresh and there are a few things on the menu that you don't find elsewhere. Definitely  a cut above the rest, especially if you're a vegetarian. Veg dhansak and courgette curry excellent 👌🏼

Likely the worst chicken shop in Peckham. Hospice waiting room...
Truly frightening burger, like a masked assailant entering your home (your sacred passage) in the middle of the night. Libidinally fright'ning. Dinner lady chips, with said lady warming her mitts over the cheap oil. No napkins, no salt, we had to suck and suck our fingers in pursuit of what we once were.

ABSOLUTELY AWFUL… AVOID AVOID AVOID!!!
This is definitely the worst chicken shop in Peckham 100% The food is terrible!

The female staff here have the worst customer service I’ve seen in a long while. They don’t wear the correct clothing and their hair isn’t covered whilst dealing with the food.

I’ve been here twice and both times staff are on their phones and I’ve been given poor customer service and today when I went the food was terrible!! NEVER GOING HERE AGAIN!!

The shop was very dirty and the tables wasn’t wiped down, so there was no way I was eating inside.

I ordered 2 double cheeseburgers for £4… when I opened it up it was an ugly shock! This was not a double cheeseburger. I showed the lady who served me and she said the burger was perfectly fine… sooo angry that I’d paid for this and the lady looked me in my face and said this is how it’s meant to be… no refund or offering to make another one… AWFUL!!!!!!

Really poor. Order large combo 8 chicken, 8 wings, 4 chips. Also i added 3 extra wings and burger.

They gave 8 chicken, 3 extra wings and 2 chips.
Missed out 2 chips and 8 wings. Terrible.
Food arrived cold and soggy. Never again and will chance my money back.

my biggest mistake was not checking the reviews here before ordering on uber eats. the food was tasteless, and the portions were kids size. this is the skinniest wrap i’ve ever had in my life, and they onion rings portion wasn’t even full? like i don’t understand how this could be worth £15 for a kids size meal? i kid you not i could’ve believe my eyes when i opened the delivery, and the flavour didn’t even make it better, i was basically eating air and dreams

Don't even bother, I don't write reviews but I have compelled to write one about this hell hole. Never seen worse customer service or chicken and chips take more than 40 minutes to deliver whilst YOURE IN THE PLACE

name: Perfect Chicken
address: 259 Old Kent Rd, London SE1 5LU, UK

reviews.text:
This place is notorious for taking people’s money. Whenever you order through the app, it is almost impossible to get hold of them if the food does not arrive. This has happened to me many times, not just once. I have ordered for myself, friends and family, the money is taken but the food never turns up.
Because of this, plans get messed up and we are left hungry and inconvenienced. If it happened once, fair enough, but it happens all the time. On top of that, the staff have very poor communication and people skills.
When I go into the shop, I am treated like I am not welcome or like I have done something wrong. This is not good customer service. When you try to call, it goes straight to voicemail. It seems very easy for them to take money, but delivering the correct service is another story. This is wrong.

One of the best chicken spots around.

The chicken burger is always fresh and crispy, the wings are juicy, and the peri chicken and peri wings have proper flavour. The fries are always fresh too, which is rare these days.

What I like most is how consistent the food is. Every time I come here it tastes the same. The place is clean, the vibe is good and the service is quick.

I don’t usually leave reviews but this place genuinely deserves one.

Love this place. Been going here for 15 years. I’ve had virtually the whole menu and I’ve never been let down. My usual go-to’s being the 1/4 pounder and the chicken fillet burger. The service has always been great, they treat everyone well especially returning customers. 10/10

Honestly one of the best chicken shops I’ve been to. The food came out fresh and hot, the chicken was crispy and actually had flavour, and the portion sizes were solid. Staff were friendly and the service was quick. Proper reliable spot — I’ll definitely be coming back.

I recently visited this chicken shop and was seriously impressed. The food was fresh, flavourful, and cooked to perfection.  The staff were vey polite and the food arrived very quickly. Would definitely recommend!

Sadly ordered a Singapore fried rice and there wasn’t nothing Singapore about it! It was just a special fried rice with loads of onions added.  There was zero spice, on the menu it clearly states “hot&spicy” and they used tinned ham/spam.. not feeling.

Full Garden is hands down my favourite Chinese restaurant in London.
I’ve been coming here for over 20 years, and it never disappoints. The food is consistently delicious, authentic, and made with care. Even after all these years, it’s still worth the journey across London every time. That says it all.

I ordered special fried rice and chicken balls with sweet and sour sauce .Well,what can I say, the rice appeared  ok,but the chicken balls were horrible, dark and the batter on them was questionable (I tried 2)The recipe has changed for the worse.I had a dodgy stomach  a few hours later from the balls or rice or both .This place used to be good but has gone downhill which is a shame,
Avoid.

The best Chinese restaurant in Peckham; possibly the world; indeed, I think, the universe!!!

No need to venture into Dulwich or the city - the quality of this simple Peckham 'Chinese Takeaway' is simply excellent. Their food? Delicious!

What more can I say? I've eaten at a range of Chinese restaurants
all over London and Full Garden is right up there with the best.

I usually order by phone and pick up my meal, so I don't usually wait for too long

Well worth a visit.

I have been ordering for years now and I have never had a bad experience.⭐️ Food excellent ⭐️Service Excellent always my go to Chinese Takeaway. We recently moved from the area about 45mins away and still use even though there are closer ones by our new house.

I travelled from West London to this restaurant (Tasty House, SE5 8RX) for their food. Having relocated to West London, I actually hadn't ordered from this restaurant in probably over 10 years.

So, was my return, and my trip there and back worth it? Absolutely! 100%! More than. Here are some things I noticed:

- The woman at the till was funny and friendly! She also suggested I don't get prawn balls and sauce due to my long journey back home, worrying about potentially soggy food. She recommended I get some ribs instead. This shows they care about the customer experience and not just the sale 🏆

- The place was spotless 👌

- Whilst waiting for my large order, I noticed that other customers seemed to have a rapport with the woman at the front of house/ the shop (including one phone call order I heard). Coinciding with my points about friendliness and customer experience 👍

- My order was large but I did not feel that I waited too long. The timing seemed just right. Good things come to those who wait.

- "Quality is our first consideration"-- that's their slogan. And I agree. I was perfectly happy with each item on my order. But I noticed that all the food went into foil containers, not plastic. I am used to plastic containers when I order Chinese,  but something tells me that the foil ones cost them more. Either way, it suggests higher quality and care for your food order as opposed to plastic containers, and it's definitely better for the environment.

Overall, I was definitely pleased - it genuinely made my day. It's just unfortunate I won't be able to be as regular of a customer due to the distance. But Tasty House, you get 5 stars from me!

PS: The portions of rice/ noodles might be larger than they appear! And that's a good thing, but I'm still cracking through all this food from my £80 order, even with some help of friends... 🤣

DO NOT GO HERE!!!!!!!
THIS IS THE WORST CHINESE TAKEAWAY IN LONDON !!!!
After ordering what was supposed to be ‘sweet and sour chicken’ I received what looked like deep fried chicken meatballs that were stone cold and god knows what sweet and sour sauce they bought but it was inedible.
The ‘duck spring rolls’ were burnt and black inside! The salt and pepper chicken was the driest thing I have tasted in my life even a drink didn’t help it go down.
Do not even let me get started on the beef chowmein there was this jelly like film all over the beef!
After complaining they were extremely rude on the phone and adamant that it was just me.

Once again, NEVER COME TO THIS RESTAURANT

Went back to Tasty House for the first time in a couple of years just for a small meal. Brought a pancake roll. Got my meal home, tried the pancake roll and no crunch! It was the worst pancake roll I've ever tried in my life. Lady behind the counter tried to add special fried rice to my bill when I asked for egg fried rice in my combo meal as well. Lol. I think I'm done with this old classic takeaway.

This place used to be good, ages ago, and probably under different management. Been here today and have spent well over £35 for some salt and pepper squid, sweet sour chicken and szechuan chicken (which I beg, please do not order). The meals were overall ok, apart of the Szechuan Chicken, absolutely disgraceful and the texture was almost like raw chicken.. uneatable. The service, no comment. The lady that took our order was rude and unprofessional, wasn’t paying attention to what we have even tried to order in the first place. I asked for the food not to be spicy, but it was extremely hot. Not sure what happened to this place but will no longer visit surely.
Hopefully no food poisoning tomorrow after the order we got today.

Save your money. Food is saturated in oil, no taste and the meat tastes FAKE. The customer service is poor and I’ll be taken my business elsewhere, if you can find an alternative please do and save yourself the disappointment and discomfort!
No pictures as the food got binned after a few bites, absolutely disgusting.

Working in the area and craving peppered steak- was NOT disappointed! Food was flavoured lovely, nice size portions and reasonably priced!
Also had the jerk chicken with rice and peas and gravy..well seasoned with a flavoursome kick!
Sides of coleslaw, plantain and fried dumpling went down a treat!
Lady serving was polite and attentive!
Would definitely come here again and would  recommend to others!

We happened to walk by here and saw the curry goat on the menu. The lady behind the counter was very friendly. Good sized portions The food was super tasty, the meat nice and tender, enough gravy over the rice. Delicious food. Really recommended. It is take away but you can eat it in your hotel or in the park. The nice lady also gave us cutlery.

Worst place ever. Family known this shop for years m. Ordered stew chicken and rice and peas and they are giving me easy cook rice instead of basmati rice and gungo peas instead of kidney beans. The chicken has no flavour. I don’t know what kind of cook they have but me and my partner wasted £30 on our meal all together that went to the bin. Maybe the dog would enjoy it.
Food really nice but when you ask for a large stew chicken and rice for £12. I expect more than small 4 pieces of chicken. Very expensive for just rice. Apart from that very happy.
Delivers every time. All fresh so make sure you don't go too late or they may have run out - and make sure they give you the slaw, which really makes the goat curry. Big love!

name: Hong Kong Garden
address: 19 Peckham High St, London SE15 5EB, UK

reviews.text: My first time ordering at Full Garden , great food , delicious ! I had hot and sour soup , Hong Kong style sweet and sour pork and special fried rice , all three were delicious , full reccomend, I will be coming back for sure , great place ! Thank you

Place of legends - has been my go to Chinese takeaway for 4 years and I am UTTERLY HEARTBROKEN to be moving outside their delivery radius.
Always such quick delivery, quality is consistent each time I order. Hong Kong Garden, I'll miss you.

Had chicken fried rice
And salt and pepper spare ribs.both dish had no taste proper tasteless.waste of money.avoid this place.

As part of my order I got crispy aromatic duck yesterday as abit disappointment with it as there were bones in it. Never have I have this dish anywhere an see bones there was a whole leg bone!! And it wasn't shredded properly I had to do it myself.
I miss the other people who owned it. Food was better priced to how it is now. Been coming to this Chinese since for over 10 years now it's changed I rarely go there now 🙁 (left 2 years ago)

I recently placed an order forgetting why i stopped ordering from them. When i received my delivery i remebered. Food is over greasy everything in the bag felt all oily the pancake roll was flat with a pool of oil at the bottom. Sweet and sour balls was over done or just recooked as chicken was dry. So from when i last ordered they haven't improved they've gotton worse.
I go south feast kitchen less grease and more fresh. Their delivery service needs improving may cost abit more but worth it as its better quality.
And seeing the response to my last review and others if it is you writing these are bang out of order!!

It’s alright, not as amazing as the internet makes it sound. If I was in the area I would go here again but wouldn’t go out of my way. The prices are relatively good for Chinese food in London nowadays. One major critic is that the rice was quite fried rice was quite flavourless. With the bbq sauce it elevated the taste and they used too much chilli oil just to make it spicy.

We popped into this Yard Sale Pizza for lunch, and saw in the window that they were doing a limited collab with Dishoom. Thought it looked good so ordered it. The lovely gentleman who served us recommended we get it as a meal, which included Garlic bread with Marmite, which was different, but nice! The main pizza was unexpectedly delicious. It was like a pizza with an Indian twist. It had lentils, spices and all sorts of unusual, but very tasty toppings!
Would recommend a visit to this pizza place, and the staff were friendly and welcoming!

Amazing Pizza and great environment! Staff is fun and super friendly, especially Simone the pizza Chef and Eren from the front of house. Love it every single time.

Piece of advice from an Italian: Get the “The Aubergine 2.0” pizza and add extra sausage (look at the pic). Thank me later.

Wonderful little pizza spot in Dulwich. Top quality food, and great atmosphere. Ate so much I could barely move when I left! Greeted by Erin and Sean who were full of energy. They graciously introduced me to all the chefs/staff in the open-style kitchen who were all fantastic and the loveliest people. Erin, Sean, Will, Jordan, and Niraj. Thank you so much for a wonderful experience! I look forward to coming again soon

Head Chef Kat made a top tier customized Sloppy G when I came! The customer service was wonderful, Andrew is a great person to speak to and served me very well. Would highly reccomend to anyone looking!

The head chef kat made an amazing dishoom pizza!!
The service was 10/10 from the front of house staff Andrew
And the general atmosphere in the store was amazing and pleasant
Will definitely be returning

name: Pizza Mania
address: 356 Old Kent Rd, London SE1 5AA, UK

reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I recently visited Pizza Mania, 365 Old Kent Road, SE1 5AA, and I couldn’t be more impressed!

The pizzas were absolutely delicious – fresh, hot, and full of flavour. The dough was perfectly cooked with a nice crispy base, and the toppings were generous and high quality. You can really taste the freshness in every bite.

They have some fantastic deals too. The Buy One Get One Free offer is great value for money, and their lunchtime special is an absolute bargain. It’s hard to find such good quality at these prices!

The staff were friendly, welcoming, and efficient. My order was ready quickly, and the service was smooth and professional. The place was clean and well organised, which always makes a difference.

If you’re in the Old Kent Road area and craving a great pizza, I highly recommend Pizza Mania. I’ll definitely be coming back again!

This is the best pizza spot in London!
My family and I have been ordering from Pizza Mania for few years now and it has always been delicious and tasty every time. We have tried so many pizza takeaway spots but this one always comes on top!
The phone handler is always pleasant, friendly, patient and offers us great deals.
Thank you so much for your service! Definitely recommend :) good value for money too.
Our go to pizza is with the following toppings: Onions, mushrooms, olives, tandoori chicken and pineapple 👌🏼
Give it a try!! 🌟

This place was nasty, and the food was even worse. I came for a Too Good To Go order and paid £5, but they gave me a plain cheese pizza that costs about £1.50 on their menu. The value wasn’t just bad — it felt like I was being cheated.

The pizza itself was rubbish: no flavour, no effort, nothing fresh about it. It tasted like something they threw together in 30 seconds just to hand me something. If that’s what they’re comfortable serving to customers, I don’t want to imagine the rest of the menu.

On top of that, the place didn’t look clean at all. The floor had debris, the back area looked messy, and the whole environment felt off. Between the nasty food, the dirty space, and being given £1 worth of food after paying £5, I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone.

Best pizza shop on 356 old Kent Road Pizza Mania
SE1 5AA this is the address for the shop go and tested
Thank you Pizza Mania.
The staff here are super friendly and respectful, and the food is really tasty and clean. You’ve got to try their pizza — it’s amazing! You won’t regret it!

This is a great chicken take away place. The chicken is really tasty and the portion size is great. The prices are fairly reasonable. The service staff have always been friendly and efficient. They have grilled chicken as well as fried chicken!

I came here and the chicken and chips were so oily, not normal oily but full on oily. Half the workers don’t even understand what I’m saying and I don’t understand them do to their accent and not coming at them for it but it’s really frustrating. The atmosphere was dirty as hell the tables were first the seats were dirty and there were dirty old oily chips on the floor and the sauces have no cover so it driesnn be out

i buy from this shop alot there delivered my food with no chips i called and they said they gave the driver 3 bags which included my chips i re watched by ring doorbell footage and the driver had 3 bags but it was burgers chicken and drinks so the restruant lied they have no customer service was rude and i will not he going back i wouldnt recomend this place
In all my years I haven't seen a chicken shop like this the best chicken shop I've ever even been too

Decent enough fried chicken usually although every now and then I get an exceedingly dry piece that had been hanging out way too long. Also my pet hate is when you get a meal with pieces and wings, and one of the pieces you're given is a wing!! But hey it's the closest so when in need...

name: Delta Express Pizza
address: 9 Peckham High St, London SE15 5EB, UK

reviews.text:
"Remove the peppers and try to eat it"

People here have an attitude. They messed up my order then told me to remove the toppings I didn't want and try to eat the pizza.
2 12" pizza only having 4-5 pepperoni per pizza is shabby. Not even a pepperoni per slice.
No sincerity in their apologies. No refund option was given but an option for the driver to collect them and bring new ones. Their attitude sucked and no compensation was offered. They seemed to hate the fact that I called in to tell them they messed up.

If you mess up, be sincerely apologetic and offer to resolve it not tell the customer to remove the ingredients they don't want and try to eat it. Offer compensation if needed keep a good reputation.

Seems by the reviews I am not the only one.

Lol " remove the peppers and try to eat it"

Good pizza for like takeaway late pizza BUT I ordered double pepperoni and got several slices without pepperoni which essentially makes it half a margherita and the guy was just plain not interested in hearing me out and also there was loads of rubbish about obviously from previous customers but clearly left for a while

I will say though that the pizza is really good, like for you know takeaway fast food pizza that you know isn't good for you but you want it anyways, it's top tier just wish they would have given me my extra toppings

First and last time ordering from this place, I'm a local garage who usually orders from elsewhere but thought I'd give the locals a try, biy was I disappointed. chicken was soggy, dough was uncooked, pizza was cold and delivery took over an hour. took picture too so I can leave a bad Google review too. Avoid them like a CV19 if you don't want to be disappointed.

I recently tried the pizza from Delta Express Pizza in Peckham, and it was truly delicious! The flavors were spot on, with a perfect balance of toppings and a crispy, flavorful crust. The customer service was excellent, making the whole experience even better. Without a doubt, this is the best pizza shop in the Peckham area. Highly recommended!
I ordered a 7 inch pizza normally from a nice guy today was a new guy and he was rude gave me wrong size and wasn’t bothered to put the pizza in the bag .

name: Filishack - Peckham
address: 130 Peckham Hill St, London SE15 5JT, UK

reviews.text:
Bruh I ordered from here bc it looked soooo good online and I heard good things, but when it came it was SO mid and looked nothing like it does online. I also paid extra for cheese and added spring onion and both didn’t come, and there wasn’t any salad.
It tasted alright to be fair but nothing special, I wouldn’t get it again 😭😭😭😭😭😭

Great food and service. The only issue is the guys serving food don't seem to change their gloves. I observed one of the lady held the mop and never bothered taking off her gloves and immediately joined the other crew to finish up packing the food .  Hope it will improve at some time.

I ordered the Large Grilled Chicken Rice Box, and let me tell you ; the portion is more than generous (easily enough for two people!). The flavours were spot on, with perfectly chargrilled chicken and tasty sauces that tied everything together. You really can’t go wrong with this choice , highly recommend!

The food was so dam nice!!! I am vegan and the options were calm.. the flavours.. lovely.  I got a large and wanted more rice.. that's all. The flavour of the rice !!! Was amazing! The sauces, lovely !!! I like a likke  spice..  quick service, despite it being so busy ✨️💛✨️

I was super disappointed, I paid extra for sauces but sadly when I got my order - there was literally no sauce? I got a tiny drizzle of mayo and that’s it??? The food was insanely dry as well, I couldn’t hack it 😭😭

I was so disappointed because I literally paid extra for it to be COVERED in sauces but sadly it was not

name: Zuzu's Pitsa Bermondsey
address: Karma Kitchen, Unit 5, Allard House, 18 Verney Rd, London SE16 3DH, UK

reviews.text: Delicious and unique fusion pizzas’s with excellent combination of herbs and sauces. The rice bowls are also very good. Really enjoyed the pizza and will try other varieties again. Kids too enjoyed the pizza. Tried the fusion desserts, they are delicious.

I had pizzadilla for lunch today and it was cheesy and delicious experience . The crust is very thin and the herbs and sauces are flavourful. Also I didn’t feel heavy and felt it was easy to digest .
The fusion dessert was just awesome .
Would like to try other varieties and definitely the vegan options . I would highly recommend for a delightful , tasty experience

Not a fan of pizza, but I guess after trying it here, I can now say, I love Pitsa 😋. Tried their double layered and dessert pizza and they are extremely good. They have great varieties and caters for every age & ethnic group.
A must try fusion pizza.
Delicious and palatable varieties. Personally liked it more than other pizza brands. Double base pizza, rice bowl are finger licking good. Looking forward to try other varieties.
Delicious fusion Pizza from PITSA … loved every bite of double base pizza . Desserts are unique from Pitsa very tasty and yummy . Pizza is children friendly as well , kids enjoyed thoroughly .

Order via just eat! Never had such awful Jamaican food. Even I not being Jamaican, can cook it much tastier! Most of it went in the bin. From soup to beef (which only had 3 little pieces), oxtail, even the plantain which is so easy to make tasted horrible. The oxtail had lots of little bones and fat with a horrible like burnt taste so couldn’t finished eating it. The beef taste was okay’ish. The cow foot soup was horrible too that I don’t even know how to explain. Never again. Very disappointing considering it was the first time. Spent £35.

I wouldn't recommend going here if you have any other options. I paid £14 for a large oxtail and rice the other day, thinking the extra 2 pound would mean I'd get more meat. I also got a patty and ended up with some plantain that i didn't even want (I told the guy i didn't want it but he charged me for it any way).

As you can probably guess I wasn't impressed at all, the patty was probably the only thing that didn't leave me with complaints. The overpriced oxtail and rice had no gravy on it, even though I reminded them to put it on it, The plantain was dry like cardboard and the portion of meat they gave me was tiny and at least 40% of it was bones.

I would only go here if you want a patty, your cool with the people that work there or you fine with getting ripped off! 😤

I have just spent 25 pounds on rice and curry goat all I got was alot of rice and no gravy or goat meat I bought for me and a friend just now today BTW and spent 25 pounds for little to nothing this is terrible Nd bad

The best food I’ve had in a minute! Really packaged nicely and the jerk chicken is real Jamaican jerk not any old wash out food! I am incredibly happy with my oxtail as well!! Love the little side salad as well, thank you

I rarely leave negative reviews, but my experience here was extremely disappointing. The service was painfully slow, even though the restaurant wasn’t busy. When our food finally arrived, it was cold and clearly had been sitting out for a while. The flavors were bland, and some items tasted as if they had been reheated rather than freshly prepared.
On top of that, the staff seemed disorganized and inattentive — we had to ask multiple times just to get water refills. For the prices they charge, I expected much better quality and professionalism. Unfortunately, I won’t be returning and cannot recommend this place.

name: Super Pizza
address: 292 Old Kent Rd, London SE1 5UE, UK

reviews.text: They do a deal of £3 50 ore note depending on the size- its a decent offer and ive always been supportive of it. However i asked for my pizza to be just cheese and garlic and was charged double. I questioned this and asked to just get a pizza for half the price but nope. Shocking service considering I live locally. Go to Lizza Mania instead as they match deals. Very disappointing 😞

Vile place.  I used to use them all the time.  I used them today after a very long time and when I called to find out where my order was I got abuse.  The pizza arrived cold which was no surprise.  Do not use these people I certainly won't be ever again.  They have no customer service whatsoever and just take your money for nothing in return.

First time ordering from here and they gave me nearly half a burnt or overcooked pizza crusts and this was a 15inch pizza. Pizza lacks cheese and flavour abit dry and doughy. Chips were dry and abit hard

Ordered from Old Kent Road branch.

Absolutely the most disgusting pizza we have ever had. We had to wait over an hour for the delivery when we were told 30  mins. Delivery driver rand me to come out and meet him rather than delivering to the door. Both pizzas were burnt and were tasteless. The sides (onion rings and chips) were soft a soggy.

Do not recommend. Completely avoid. Very disappointing and completely embarrassing as we had guests over.

Honestly, Super Pizza used to be such a good place to eat at, also because they are one of the few halal pizza shops in the area. They think it gives them the right excuse to show such poor service. I ordered some pizza, and the majority of that pizza was burnt, with the fewest amount of toppings I have ever seen. This isn’t the level of standard that I have experienced at Super Pizza for years; the standard has been considerably dropping. The garlic bread was completely undercooked, and I could physically see that the wings were still raw.

So happy to finally get a chance to swing by Chaska Maska. The lamb curry was absolutely delicious. The veg biryani was full of flavour and spices. Enjoyed the samosa chana chaat. Also got a curry with paneer & spinach plus a Dal Makhani. Genuinely would order it all again with no hesitation. Really good food. Great value also. Portions aren't too huge so you can get a decent mix of food for sharing.

Excited to go back and try more of the menu!

We recently had a fabulous meal here at Chaska Maska.

There are quite a few options on the menu, but it wasn’t so vast that it was overwhelming - and I loved that there were plenty of vegetarian dishes available too.

We ordered a variety of dishes, and every one of them were flavourful and delicious.

Service was superb - the staff are welcoming and friendly but not intrusive.

Highly recommended!

I had a fantastic dining experience at this Restaurant The ambiance is warm and welcoming, perfect for any occasion.

The vegetarian dishes are flavorful, from creamy paneer curries to delicious tandoori starters. The non-vegetarian options are equally impressive, with tender meats, fresh seafood, and perfectly grilled tandoori items.

Service is prompt, the staff is attentive, and the portions are generous. Overall, a great spot for both vegetarians and non-vegetarians. Highly recommended!

"Chaska Maska is amazing! I tried the chana chaat and chicken biryani, and they were absolutely delicious—full of authentic flavors. The staff are super friendly and make you feel so welcome. Cozy vibe, great service, and incredible food—can't wait to visit again!"

Food continues to be good, but a poor take-away experience after one dish was missed and the effort of resolving.  I offered to send a photo of delivery and even then I don't feel they believed me! I have been a regular at both restaurants for a long time, but the experience means I'm unlikely to return. Very disappointed with attitude.

name: Tianjin Dumpling
address: Unit 10, Aylesham Centre, Market Place, London SE15 5EW, UK

reviews.text:
We travelled across London to this place after seeing the rave reviews talking about ‘the best dumplings in London’; did the other reviews go to the same place?

We came on a saturday lunch time, the elderly man working at the till barely spoke english and was quite rude / blunt / aggressive with us. It seemed that 80% of their already small menu was unavailable. the things that were left were basically the same, soft pork dumplings. After much confusion, we were told to sit down. We asked if we could have our drinks first and were told no.

We waited a good 20 mins for our buzzer to go off despite the restaurant being empty. when it did go off, we went to the till to be ignored for 5 mins and then told by the man (again angrily) to go and sit back down?

Finally the food arrived. They were awfully bland, fell apart upon lifting, and the only dipping sauce available was a lacklustre soy sauce one.

Coming in at £21 for a few dumplings and two cans of coke, this place isn’t cheap. Given the poor quality of the food and the frankly awful service, we felt completely ripped off.

Save yourself the journey down to Peckham and skip this disappointment.

Best dumplings in London, hands down. I’ve tried a lot of places in London and nowhere comes close. Worth the trip to Peckham just for these. The lovely owners are so sweet and put their heart and soul into making all of the food. We had a group of 5 of us and ordered quite a bit and all the food was made to perfection. Highly recommend the pork xiao long baos, pan fried buns, zha Jiang mein, and pork and vegetable dumplings. We’ll be back, and often - even if it’s a bit of a trek from North London!

authentic Asian dumplings for sure, had the soup dumplings which was definitely the best. so fresh, hot and juicy had a good soup, had the pork and chive dumplings which is fresh and made to order. however, just needed more juice in it, and the green tea is just a regular green tea bag but ran by legit Chinese folk. they kept talking to me in Mandarin

Lovely fresh made dumplings especially the chicken.
If you like Shanghai dumplings filled with bursting liquid, this is similar. However one of the pictures on the menu should be changed because it shows glutinous rice dumpling/siumai when it is just pork siumai in yellow wrap.
Had lunch there twice, and both times it was super tasty!! All very fresh; the chicken dumpling soup (handmade dumplings!) was excellent. Staff are so lovely. Can't wait to try more of the menu.

Metro’s is like an off-brand Morley’s. Decent chips and chicken with friendly staff, especially for a chicken shop.

Oddly it has kebab images, even on the sign, but doesn’t sell any. And the slushie machine isn’t always working.

Inside there isn’t anywhere to sit down other than one spinny chair and a table that is hardly supported. Aka it’s all takeaway.

Easily the best wings and fillet burgers in South. Had 4 meals that were all cooked to order. Perfect chicken. The shop was clean and the guy washed his hands multiple times and cleaned surfaces after use. Would highly recommend. Well stocked even open late.
My favourite chicken around this area and I've done the research, pitted each spicy fillet burger and chips against each place about 500 metres around these ends Metro wins
My fave burger / chicken shop amongst the huge number all around here. Friendly staff, fresh food, good price. I usually take out and have a short walk to the local park to eat

i got cold fries mixed with other oil covered overercooked Not Fresh (twice cooked fries) Oily fries? Did not enjoy this food.  Please bring back Aleenas Grill.   Fries are Not Fresh? sitting in cold tray and then being given to customers when they are run out of ready cooked Fresh  Really sad ..

Wow is all i can say. We recently stopped using our local chinese shop after the quality of food declined and we were delivered RAW meat. My mum lives local to palace and told me to give it a try. It was absolutely unreal. All hot & cooked fresh as we waited in store. Loved every dish we ordered. Will definitely be our new restaurant, even if it means us driving 4 miles to collect it!

I usually get my chips and battered sausages from here. The food is always tasty and fresh, and the customer service is polite and welcoming. I would highly recommend coming here. Also a sidenote, they only accept cash.
After eating for the first time tonight 09/02/26 Avoid at all cost doesn’t even resemble Chinese food and taste, like nothing I’ve ever tasted before absolutely disgusting

haven't been into this restaurant in a number of years but today I thought I give it a try. hopefully I don't end up in A&e with food poisoning. it's one of the worst Chinese local restaurant hasn't changed at all. I think actually got worse. ordered pork fried rice Rice was clumpy very dry and soya sauce. as if they use the minimum Tash  no flavor. the rice look like they've took it out of the fridge. I should have never gone there I already wanted to give them a try but as usual waste of money and I hope I don't end up in hospital with food poisoning
Standard Chinese takeaway. Usual menu. Prices about £10 a head. Food was nice. Recommended.

They went above and beyond. I had been going past this place quite a bit and live locally and finally decided to give it a try. And man they didn't not disappoint. The lamb bhuna was soft and succulent and very well cooked, the cheesy naan. Was one of the best bread i have ever taste. Very Fresh. Mushroom rice amazing and nice. All in all with the fast delivery and service giving this a 10/10. Very helpful, kind and understanding people. Great customer service

Genuinely the worst food I've ever had, the paneer dishes were sweet - and I mean disgustingly so. As if they had spoonfuls of sugar added to them. Saw a response from the restaurant telling someone 'not to order cream based dishes as they are always sweet' - saag paneer is never meant to have 'sweet' as a primary flavour. What on earth... There was barely any actual spinach in my saag paneer just this strange sweet concoction that bears no resemblance to Indian food. Disgraceful

Seriously bad customer service. I ordered on their website for a home delivery which didn't arrive and it was only by telephoning them after an hour and a half's wait that they told me their "website isn't working at the moment" - so my order had not been received! No apology. I would not recommend Purple Mango to my worst enemy after this experience. A real shame as the food is usually great but this is not the first time I have had reason to complain about the chaotic customer service. An order several months ago was delivered cold and in torn bags and containers which had to be replaced with an inevitable further delay while they prepared a fresh order. Tonight's experience has been the final straw.

Ordered delivery. Was perfectly on time.

The food was so flipping delicious my face has morphed into the happy druling emoji, like buttery deliciousness in every bite.

We have been shopping around for a new local for months with many disappointments either by extortionate pricing or drab food. This was the fifth menu I spotted on my Just eat price comparison and worked out about £4-5 cheaper than others, with more food.

From now on they'll be getting all our perk points.

The name has Indian in it but food tastes different and nothing like Indian food. The Vegeterian variety specially is not that good. The paneer tikka was chewy and looking extra red due to lots of food colour and lacking taste. The Veg. Jalfrazi curry was extra hot and spicy with very less salt and big chucks of very few vegetables. Rotis were good and fresh. Portion size and quality can be better. Food delivery service was good. The food packaging was good. Prices are moderate.

name: Alanya Kebab & Fish chips
address: 164 New Cross Rd, London SE14 5AA, UK

reviews.text: i go to this shop to get 6 wings and chips and its so good,then recently i’ve ordered mixed doner kebab with chips and vegetables and its 10/10

excellent food, tastes perfect, and the right temperature, quick service.
next time in Landon, I will make sure to visit again, all because of the nice people there, and the good food.
after trying 10s of specialized fish&chips places, this place is unequivocally the best I ever tried,
there should be some kind of competition, for all fish&chips restaurants, to try to meet this place quality

For me this fish and chips completely blew me away. The price was very reasonable and average. This fish cooked well battered throughout as well as the chips with salt vinegar and sauces. Tasted very delicious, extravagant and full of joy. Best in New Cross will definitely come back. Thanks for such a spectacular evening!

Called for a collection. Started the order and then he decided we were ordering too much, became extremely rude and hung up. We tried to call back, was rude again. Will never go here again. Plenty of kebab shops around. We ordered somewhere else and they were absolutely lovely. If you have the choice, go elsewhere.

Used to be alright but prices are quite high now. Got offered salad with my chicken burger but had to pull out most of it as was brown and soggy. Not worth my money unfortunately and potentially getting ill from old salad

DON'T ORDER FROM HERE.

I ordered from the Balham branch on Deliveroo and this is the worst Sushi I've ever had.

The Fish was half cooked when it arrived and the Sushi was very messy. (see the pics)

Finally they couldnt even be bothered to included Chop Sticks.

It's safe to say I wont be ordering again.

Used to order here a lot from Uber eats. Won’t do again - the salmon was cooked. Looked really disgusting. The fact that you saw it, packed for order and called it a day is crazy. Now looking at google maps it’s ghost kitchen - makes sense now. Overpriced and disgusting compared to Wasabi and other chains.

I wanted to leave a review to say how much I very much enjoyed this Sushi as a takeaway.

Something to tick the box in terms of healthy and a good option if you don't have time to cook.

Ordered off Just Eat as they had an offer at the time, so worth a look if your thinking where to order from.

Solid A****

LDT x

I give two stars because sushi tasted ok but the tampura was really old dirty oily  one :( also no sticks with the food :( , the sushi looked no where near what I have seen as original sushi . Pls see the pic . I have never seen sushi like this before .. half open

Absolutely delicious! Such great portions and at brilliant prices. The size of the salmon in the maki was incredible! It tasted so good - almost don't want to review because I want to keep them my secret haha but they're an amazing sushi place and I'm so happy they're local!

After seeing this food stall for so many years I decided to try it out! I ordered a large Chicken Biryani (£8) and a Lamb samosa (£2). They kindly offered to heat it up but I was taking it home.  The Biryani was tasty it was seasoned nicely, not too spicy at all. Rice was a little bit soft but maybe because I came late in the evening. The samosa wasn’t really nice, after heating it up it became very greasy and tasted like vegetable rather than lamb.  The customer service was good, I was given spoon and tissues, also food set up looked clean!!! I’ll definitely go back to get another Biryani to compare!!

Had a great chicken tikka wrap freshly prepared there and then for £8. There's a good selection of curries there and you can eat there.  Its down an alleyway and very much now frills, just tasty and honest good food.
The best biryani and okra dish  I’ve had in a while and that’s after locking off brick lane for 15 years. Don’t be put off by simple decor. Really good food.

Got a chicken tikka roll on my way home. The guys were friendly, and I enjoyed watching them make bread while I waited (5-10 min). The chicken was so succulent, and the naan was soft and chewy. Where else can you get fresh naan straight out of the tandoor for this price? (£6 for a small roll, and it was big enough for dinner). Totally regret not trying this place sooner (it's down an alley).

Service with more than just a smile, this hidden gem will be a weekly treat for my family. It’s so clean and the food is delicious and fresh. As a fine dining chef eating here, it tastes just like home. 10/10
Must try their curries and wraps!
My go to Chinese spot. So affordable with current inflation and the quality is always top notch.

Food was absolutely below par. Lacked quality, I ordered for fried squid with ginger and onion, it didn't look anything like fried squid more like plain squid in sauce with spring onion. Man was very rude when we called to complain. Specification should be made on each dish. Very disappointed with the service. bad food and bad service =PLEASE STAY AWAY FROM 😷😷😷😷😷😷😷😷

Ordered from here and the owner phoned saying I always cancel my order although I’ve only ordered once LAST AUGUST I told him there is 2 of my address that always get mixed up but he wouldn’t listen and cancelled my order. I don’t order often because of the £18 minimum and it’s just me ordering but he wouldn’t listen to a word, customer service is appalling and it’s sad because I actually like their food but it looks like I’m band for no reason at all🙂

I have ordered from here for many years. It’s normally extremely tasty! But recently it has taken a total nose dive! The pancake roll & noodles was dripping with grease! My duck was oily and no crisp to it. The rice, well that was something else.  The only decent thing in my order was the prawn crackers!

Wasn't going to write anything until at several occasions my food has arrived a whole hour and a half late. It's quite sad that Shanghai doesn't have good customer service I was told my food will be an hour and a half late and you would expect a explanation but all the guy said is "it's a new driver" is that my fault you are understaffed and have a driver that's not capable of driving literally down the road. I asked ok how are u going to keep ur regular customers happy he said we can't do nothing for u and laughed ? How rude in the end they sent us some free mini spring rolls? "Geeze thanx coz that makes things better doesn't it" well anyway the next day ended up having a bad tummy I did think those spring rolls looked like they'd been laying around a day and a half won't be ordering from here anymore.

Order took ages, pizza was awful, especially the toppings Christ. Chips were like something from a school canteen, and tiny portion. Shop is horrible as well. If you're in the area go and get Hampton's chicken up the road instead.

Ive noticed the service has had a huge drop recently. I used to buy vegetarian pizzas from there often but the way the treat me and others during our recent order was so bad I refuse to buy from them any longer.  Summer time I would see the owner around and he'll always have a great manner about him and so did the staff (if he was around), so it's a shame their customer service has taking a turn for the worse. Even calling their shop to tell them about an order they done incorrectly is pointless. To avoid having to sort it out they'll say that it was the wrong phone number and that I'm calling a corning shop(obviously a lie because I used them frequently).
For further context I ordered  a large vegi pizza, onion rings and drink. I noticed once delivered I had received a kebab, medium meat pizza and two cokes... this also happened to my sister (w/ being given the wrong order the same night). Called to tell them and as soon as I mention the problem they hand up, I call back then they say wrong shop. I then went there to inform them but the manager says I have to just eat it like that because he won't give me my correct order and apparently has nothing to do with him. This is followed by him shouting at me.
NEVER AGAIN!!!

What a shambles. Seems like new owners in there now. Horrible food, chicken shish was like rubber and the chips were cold and stale....and that was after waiting 10 mins for it to cook. Shop staff are rude and the cooking area could do with looking cleaner. Definitely not going back.
Food use to be amazing but ever since the chef left the the food became small and tasteless. Not a lot of meat on the pizza either. I don't know why the chef left but I want them to come back.
The fries where over cooked, cold and edible,  the donar kebab made me vomit after 30 mins of eating it, I would never go back there and if you have sense you will never eat anything from there.

Absolutely delicious restaurant-quality Chinese food and friendly customer service too. Highly recommend the set meal for 2 which they allowed me to make a couple of changes to. The food came quickly (30 mins!) and was piping hot and all the flavours were lovely. In particular the chicken crispy noodles were fab and the crispy shredded beef with chilli was probably the best I've ever had. Give these guys a go!
Rice and soup a tiny bit bland but the service is great, really sweet staff. Good prices

I've been ordering from this restaurant for a while . I think it's almost been about 7 years. Maybe more and I don't think I've ever had an issue with the food. The food is always up to standards and is affordable . Furthermore, the delivery time is quick and staff friendly .No complaints here .

Food was bland and had no taste. Chicken ball burnt again!! Noodles taste watery and food has no taste.
Avoid poor food!!!
Have bought from here before but in the last year the food quality has deteriorated drastically. I won't be back!!!
Always done collection so can't comment on delivery, but the food is always excellent, hot, and I've never been kept waiting upon collection. Fantastic! (Oh and you DO get free prawn crackers! )

PF Peri Peri is hands down the best local chicken shop around!
Every time I order from them, the food is consistently fresh, flavourful, and cooked perfectly. Their peri peri seasoning is unmatched—just the right balance of spice, tang, and smokiness. The portions are generous, the chicken is always juicy, and even the sides taste like they’re made with care.
The staff are friendly, quick, and genuinely make you feel looked after. Whether it’s a quick snack or a full meal, PF Peri Peri never disappoints. If you haven’t tried them yet, you’re missing out!

Highly recommend! 🔥🍗🙌

Ordered lunch from here today had the worst experience ever! I ordered a chicken wrap and was told come back after 20 minutes. I went back after 20 minutes and he didn't ever start making it! Rubbish service! Vile food! Unhygienic! Untrained staff! Charge double despite the original price! The chicken in my wrap was so hard that even not fit for animal consumption! Would avoid at all costs! Don't waste your money!

Visited this pfc  today and was really impressed. The service was fast and our order came out quite quick. A special thanks to Asif for his outstanding assistance and friendly attitude. The food was delicious, and the atmosphere was warm and inviting. Highly recommend this PFC!!😋

Yuck, so disgusting. The donner was dripping in oil like its been deepfried and it was burnt/dry at the same time. Very bland salty taste. Chips were stale dry and crunchy all i could taste was oil. Even though i put on the notes not to serve me greasy left overs i got worse. Also the first time i went there last summer i was made to wait around 30minutes just for cheese burger and chips instead they served abusive drunk customers before me who had walked in long time after me. I will never order from them again.
Yesterday I went this shop superb atmosphere and especially peri peri Chicken taste is too good everyone go and taste it guys

Ordered a butter chicken last night, absolutely delicious. I've ordered about 6 times in the last 4 weeks and the chefs been faultless, they must be doing something right, long may it continue.
P.s. great delivery driver, very polite, excellent customer service.
Delivery guy was very rude and impatient. Raita was just plain warm greek yogurt. Garlic naan wasnt even garlic, and was really chewy and bad. there’s better takeout than this.
Tried the naan with tikka. Nice and fluffy, didn't go hard even after a while. Could tell it was made with love. The tikka was just right. Welcoming and friendly staff too. Thank you.
Top service. One of the best Indian takeaways I've had in a very long time. Efficient and top notch service. 10/10.

Decided to try this takeaway after a flyer came through the door. And so glad we did! The food was superb! We had the lamb biryani and saag aloo and a rogan josh. The delivery arrived bang on time and the driver was very polite and friendly. I’m also very impressed by the website. This will definitely be our go-to Indian takeaway from now onwards..

name: Morley's Fried Chicken - East Dulwich
address: 102 Dog Kennel Hill, London SE22 8BE, UK

reviews.text: Tasty food and quick and friendly service also cheap😁

Lived around the area for a long time. rarely order from this Morleys, every time ive taken a chance to order from here.  I have suffered for the consequences. Ordered on saturday night, got food poisoning and previously as well.

They should consider closing the place giving Morleys a bad reputation. Ive written off this place in book.
Good burgers and good looking ones too. Much more aesthetically pleasing with the burn on the bun. Don’t really like the wings but everyone has a different opinion 🤷‍♂️

Seresly!!!!!

seriously,
I've never written a review but this restaurant diserves.  I was insulted to mean I'm invisible with my 98kg, who would say God works miracles, and served in this way “see the pictures”.  I want to run, going back to the center of london for there I know, I pay 3.5£ but it's twice the food.

Ps the souce is good
The food so bad the place so cold and the service they rude

name: Rare Burger - Smash Burgers & Wings (Delivery & Pickup only)

reviews.text: The chicken hangover burger at this takeaway is a true delight - tender, flavorful chicken nestled in a perfectly toasted bun, creating a mouthwatering experience that will leave you craving for more. A must-try for chicken burger enthusiasts

The best halal burgers in town. ❤️"I had an amazing burger at Rare burgers The patty was juicy and flavorful, and the toppings were fresh. The service was also great. I highly recommend this place!"
Must try rare burgers Takeaway shop

Should have given a zero star if possible. Ordered via Uber eats and they did not send the food until I called them after an hour. The food came out really cold. Multiple items were missing such as fries, sauces. Really hated the experience. The fried chicken tasted stale and it was burnt.

This place is a gem! No frozen chicken and patties, everything is fresh and house marinated. I love how soft the burger buns were, never had something like that in London.

Tried the beef smash burger (not sure how they call it), chicken wings and fried chicken. I’d definitely recommend each one of them, it’s truly heavenly.

The burger spot is incredible! The burgers are juicy and flavorful, and the buns are always fresh and soft. The menu offers a wide variety of toppings and sauces to choose from, allowing you to customize your burger to your liking. The fries are also delicious, crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside.  ,  Overall, the burger spot is definitely worth a visit if you're craving a tasty and satisfying burger.

I’m honestly disgusted by my recent experience with this restaurant. I ordered Chinese fried rice and found what appears to be a MAGGOT inside my food. I’ve attached photos as proof.
This is completely unacceptable and a serious hygiene issue. I couldn’t eat another bite and ended up throwing the entire meal away. I’ve reported this to Southwark Council’s Food Safety Team for investigation.

I hope the restaurant takes this seriously and improves its food hygiene practices — no customer should ever have to deal with something like this.
We order from here regularly, and the food is consistently outstanding—easily on par with, if not better than, many of the most celebrated restaurants in central London. Highly recommended.

I normally go the this place quite regularly, on this last occasion I unfortunately found a roach in my chilli prawns. Needless to say i will not be returning! It’s a shame as they have been there for years, but once u see that u can’t go back!

We had Singapore vegetable hofun, egg fried rice, and vegetable chow mein, with dumplings and spring rolls, to take away. Food was good, prepared in less than ten minutes. There was plenty of space to site while I waited. The table was a bit sticky.

Shabby looking place, wish i read the reviews before visiting. Thankfully i did not find a roach/bug in my food.
The good, however was pretty bad. The egg fried rice was stodgy. Didnt really see any egg and it was overyly salty or possibly filled with MSG.  Would not recommend any one visit here to be honest.

Delicious! We ordered for the first time recently and will definitely order again. Duck was cooked perfectly, beef in black bean sauce was tender, and everything tasted fresh. Even the spring rolls that I usually don't care for tasted amazing. The portions were very generous, it's a good value for money.
Favourite local takeaway. Really good price. We always collect so it's nice and quick - piping hot. Lots of great bean curd options

This was my favourite takeaway until a few months ago. I had a bad meal service was not good when I asked to discuss the issue. Therefore I stopped using it. Forward 5/6 months I thought I would order another meal. I  ordered prawns and mushrooms. Took my meal home. Opened it there were 5 baby prawns and no mushrooms in the tray (I had ordered the large). When I went in to discuss. I was told it was the end of the evening when I ordered and they did not have any mushrooms left.
I certainly will never use this takeaway again. I have since used Golden Palace on Commercial way. You have to wait a bit longer for your food. The food is worth waiting for.
Writing this review does not make me happy as I like to support local business. However unless people say anything nothing will change.

We have always used golden wok and been happy. It must have changed hands, or chef, had tonight and it was like half a tub of salt had been put in the curry sauce. Foul. It seems to have gone same way as other local Chinese takeaways near us. Won't be having again that's for sure

Ordered from this restaurant a few times and it’s definitely gotten worse! Today I ordered chips, king prawn chow mien and prawn balls with sweet & sour sauce. Firstly the delivery was LATE by 15 minutes, wouldn’t of cared if the food was nice.

The chips were luke warm and tasted like they had been cooked from earlier in the day. The prawn chow mien was ok but the PRAWN BALLS were absolutely awful! They were slightly MUSHY and didn’t have a fresh taste, it seemed like they were left out far too long. Also the amount of sweet & sour SAUCE was RIDICULOUS it was just ENOUGH FOR ONE PERSON.
