The food here was unbelievably good. I had a Jerk Bun and it was massive, and so flavourful. My partner had a cauliflower bun and it was also delicious. Plus, we had such a friendly waitress, wish I got her name to shout her out! Will definitely be returning

Visited this Pub 2 months ago. Had lovely chicken and rice and a cocktail as I started. Indoor was packed as it was a weekend night and was very busy, so I got a seat outside.

Food

Chicken and rice were excellent. Rich in flavour, texture and cooked well.

I decided to go indoors when I some seats got vacant. Got a table at the corner and ordered a drink and their chicken wings with honey glaze. It was the best chicken wings I had so far. Crispy, tasty, and with right flavour. It had a flavourful ginger zing to it which elevated the taste experience.

Love to go back.

Ps: I am not able to upload any photos as I haven’t taken any. I will be uploading the photos when I go back there.

Overall verdict: 4.7

A year ago I came here, the jerk chicken plate was good.

But today... A very disappointing meal/wasted time and money

the food was beyond disappointment 😥 ended up in Costa after to wash it away.

I came during very quite times,  so I was very confused at the bad quality of food (burned chicken which was mainly made up of very burned skin and hard to chew, bland rice and beans meant to be rice and peas, and strings of raw tasteless cabbage served as coleslaw. The young waiter was not getting much help so customer service was not great (not his fault)

For 20.00 (15 for the meal, 5 for side of plantains).... Was not a good experience. Won't be risking it again.

I asked for a refund but the young waiter had to find the manager and I had to go.

Overall.... A very disappointing meal/wasted time and money

Hands down… go for the rum punch! Got on that bus late but man was it packing a punch! The vibe was amazing. DJ was spinning Afrobeat jams, bar gets crowded but second floor bar is available. Enough room for everybody and their mamas to dance off their feet! Atmosphere is just outstanding!

Amazing afternoon at dulwich tandoori. Shoutout to Maz and the team who looked after us so well. We had two birthdays in our group and they went above and beyond to make us feel special, even bringing out a birthday cake!! Food was delicious and very well priced. Would recommend 10/10

Oh my gosh! Me and my partner was blown away from the very first bite we had. The butter chicken was so delicious. Atmosphere of the restaurant was cozy and not too fancy (which is what i LOVE) definitely going to be part of our dinner out rotations! 😋😋
Great food, lovely atmosphere and friendly staff. Maz and the team were great. Would highly recommend

First time here and will definitely be back can't wait to try other dishes on the menu 😋 staff was friendly bathroom was very clean 👌. If your in the mood for a tandoori give this place a try you won't regret it.

Hi I add a lovey time and the food was top top notch Staff was very friendly, engaging and knowledgeable on the menu Also very helpful as they prepare this for me that would not on the menu Definitely, we will be back here again. It’s such a joy to have something that’s local close to you doing this quality on standard of food.

name: KOKUM
address: 58-60 E Dulwich Rd, London SE22 9AX, UK

reviews.text:
We decided to come to KOKUM after a reservation at another restaurant was cancelled and I’m so happy it was cancelled!

Our second time here and the staff was really lovely and kind. We got the tandoori roast and lamb rogan Josh (so tasty) and a good portion of food.

They even gave us a free dessert as it was our anniversary! This place is officially our Indian go to!

This is my third time here, I can’t stop coming back!
The food here is really flavourful and fresh. The dishes are elevated and polished without being fussy. Just an all around great meal guaranteed.
Would recommend the samosa chaat and the butter chicken(it’s smokier, tomato-ier and tastier than butter chicken has any right to be!)

The nice design and atmosphere is just the cherry on top. Lovely for a group dinner with friends or family.

What a delightful experience visiting this restaurant!
The place is beautifully designed, and the service we received was exceptional. Since our trip to India, we hadn’t had the chance to savor such authentic and delicious dishes.
Our daughter and her boyfriend took us here, one of their favorite restaurants, and it made the experience even more special. Highly recommend it!

I had the fish curry and it was delicious. Excellent cocktails. Incredible desserts. I've also had the biryani which comes in pastry! Amazing! Best of all, my spouse and I came here for our wedding anniversary and when we mentioned it in passing, they brought us out a chocolate dessert with strawberries and 'happy anniversary' written in chocolate sauce. And gave us a free special drink of rum.

We had the pleasure of dining here on Sunday evening. I’ve lived in London for 10 years and I must say this is by far the best Indian restaurant in East Dulwich.
Standout dishes include the chicken lollipops / lamb chops and chicken biriyani.
At the end of our meal the Chef Sunjay checked in and we shared a lovely conversation together.
Highly recommended

Ordered lamb balti, mushroom rice and paratha. Lamb was tender and tasty, mushroom rice delicious. I actually didn't expect the little surprises in the bag (my first Uber Eats delivery 🙂) the salad was fresh and crunchy, sauces delightful, popadoms light and crispy.
Delivered by there own staff, he was sweet and charming.
My whole experience was lovely...I've lots left for lunch today too.

Have been here several times but recently went on a Sunday evening and tried their buffet experience! Such good value for money and the range of options included in the buffet were fab. There were several meat, fish and veggie options so it's perfect when visiting with a group of people.

Every time I am here, the staff are so incredibly friendly and attentive which makes the experience so great. Always recommend to people looking for good Indian food in the area

Very good and kind welcome at the restaurant 🙏 Ambience & atmosphere were great… & excellent customer service and food was awesome 🤩Drinks menu was interesting and had unique collection in menu 😊 My partner Ashley and I would definitely return 🙆‍♀️ Overall excellent experience and I would definitely recommend this restaurant 💜💜💜

Truly exceptional Indian cuisine, extensive menu, crisp beverages and immaculate vibes. Memsaab is a class above and nothing in the Dulwich region comes close. I and my 8 friends enjoyed many naan and pilau for days. Celebrating a birthday? An anniversary? The conception of your first child? Memsaab is the venue. Tarek was our server and I never want to be served by anyone else again, perfection. We’re off to play some darts.

The 4 star is for the service the staff provided right from the start till the end - it was flawless. There wasn't a time when you felt left out in the crowd, which is quite rare to be honest. They were super attentive and cared to make your time at their restaurant relaxing and enjoyable. The food was good but there is room for improvement. All in all it was good experience.

name: Ranna (Old Kent)
address: 354 Old Kent Rd, London SE1 5AA, UK

reviews.text: Had a really good experience here the other day. Could not complain about anything about Ranna and so I would definitely go again. Our server was very hospitable and very humorous. It was a pleasure to be there and experience dining in. Highly recommend!

So I ordered a meal for 1 on deliveroo, and it came up to £30, to be fair I got given a decent amount of food for that price, only thing il moan about.. the onion bahjees were stale...must of been left overs or over cooked...but I bit into it and it was so hard it could of broke a tooth...it also fell apart.

Otherwise the food is decent.

Stopped here 4 dinner outstanding.
Service amazing. Highly recommend.
Will definitely go again. Had mix grill. Cooked to perfection.
So local to me to grab a quick bite to eat, always a firm favourite for me and my friends! Staff are lovely and the food is always hot and tasty
Ordered take out based on the excellent reviews.  Sadly, very disappointed.  Paneer tikka did not looked cooked and the motor paneer was bland and no taste. Expensive for a main dish.

name: Kingdom of Flavours (KOF)
address: 260 Old Kent Rd, London SE1 5UB, UK

reviews.text: The people here are incredibly kind and accommodating, and the hospitality is truly amazing. The warm and welcoming atmosphere is reflected in the delicious Indian food they serve, and when I requested it, they even made a cup of chai for me, which made my day. I would highly recommend this place for both the food and the exceptional service

I recently ordered the biryani from this restaurant, and it was absolutely fantastic! The rice was perfectly cooked, fluffy, and fragrant, with spices that added rich, authentic flavors without overpowering the dish. The meat was tender and juicy, and the portion size was more than generous—great for sharing or indulging solo! This is definitely a biryani that Asian food lovers will appreciate, with just the right blend of heat and aroma that reminds you of traditional home-cooked flavors. Delivery was on time, and the food arrived fresh and hot. Highly recommend for anyone craving authentic, flavorful biryani!
My experience @ Kingdom of Flavours was absolutely amazing.The Flavors we're perfectly balanced and the presentation was beautiful. I can't wait to come back try more dishes.Keep up the great work😊
The food we ordered was really good, and we had a catering party from KOF. It was really yummy; all our friends and family enjoyed the food. The customer service is excellent.

The food is fantastic with amazing flavours and is good quality with great tasting ingredients.
The team of chefs and staff are lovely and are very friendly and helpful.

name: Village Tandoori
address: 71 E Dulwich Grove, London SE22 8PR, UK

reviews.text:
Been wanting a nice curry for well over a year now but been skeptical of wasting money with prices these days , I gave this place a shot 2 weeks ago and ive just ordered the same again tonight.

Great quality
Great price

Will be a regular from now on
Thanking all the team 🙌

Ordered off just eat with 40% off promo. everything was hot and fresh and good portion sizes, a good standard Indian take away and good value. Naan was quite simple but fresh. Chicken good quality. Free popadoms and chutneys.
Food was beautiful I’ve been twice now. Prices are very affordable and the quality is top class this place is definitely my new favourite and I’ll definitely be back

I completely agree with the other reviewer – this is, without a doubt, the best Indian takeaway in Dulwich, and that's saying something considering there are about ten within a two-mile radius!
Every dish we've tried was delicious. The curry was fresh and perfectly cooked (and that’s a difficult balance to strike with curries), the onion bhajis were crispy and flavoursome, the saag paneer was really creamy and we loved the little extra sides. Really glad this place is now only a five-minute walk from our house and look forward to exploring more of their menu.
Tandoori chicken the best. Nice mix of spice and flavour. My regular place for Indian

name: Chinese Noodle Bar
address: 176 New Cross Rd, London SE14 5AA, UK

reviews.text: This place is such a gem! The food is sooooo good, portions are big and probably one of the cheapest eats around! Honestly blown away! Was here last night and tempted to go today aswell. Highly recommended:) also the ladies working were so lovely

Fantastic find! Truly authentic noodles with bold flavours. The sesame noodles were a highlight and a steal at under £8.

The flavours really stand out, higly recommended, I went with a friend who lived in China for 7 years and he was totally impressed too.

the food was so good and the prices are incredible for the portions you get!
i had the sesame peanut noodles and the smashed cucumber and it was only £14. i had to take half of it away as a takeaway because i was so full!

I recently visited here for a hotpot experience, and overall, it was a great meal! The spicy broth was delicious, with just the right amount of heat to keep things exciting without overpowering the flavors. I was also surprised by how spicy the pickled soup base turned out to be—definitely a pleasant kick! The meat selections were top-notch and tender. The variety of ingredients made the meal even more enjoyable. Service was friendly and attentive, adding to the overall positive experience. Highly recommend for hotpot lovers!

If you’re craving a feast for the senses, hot pot is undoubtedly the ultimate choice. The bubbling broth brims with rich aromas, creating a perfect harmony with the fresh ingredients, delivering warmth and satisfaction in every bite. A table of hot pot is not only a celebration of flavors but also the coziest companion on a winter’s day.

Deliciousness awaits—come and indulge!

This Chinese buffet is not great but there’s a good range and the price is low.
The price reflects the quality so don’t expect great food but it’s a big cheap meal.
Most of the food is okay. But the seafood was a bit too fishy and not fresh tasting
The wings are good.
The place is always busy and generally they tend to refresh the food often

⸻

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I’ve driven past Noodle City Denmark Hill so many times, always curious about this halal Chinese spot. Finally tried it today for lunch takeaway, and wow – I was so impressed!

The food tasted amazing, way better than I expected for a buffet-style place. The service was excellent too – the guy at the counter was polite and clearly explained how it all works. For just £5, I got a takeaway box that was so generous I had to save half for later.

Really great value, great food, and such respectful service. Definitely coming back again
All the bad reviewer I don’t know what u was expecting with £9 which is a coffee price shame on u all . I need to see the price before u gave all the bad reviews about not having fresh food .do u even know the cost of a apple 😂

I’ve visited Noodle City many times in the past and always enjoyed it for its fair prices — a nice treat for a family on a budget.

However, on my visit on 10/08/2025, I was shocked by the condition of the restaurant. The smell was unpleasant, some food were cold and off, the environment felt unclean, and the chairs were so filthy that I nearly felt sick just looking at them.

I raised the issue with the manager, but my first complaint wasn’t taken seriously. Only after bringing it up a second time did he say they would clean the chairs “within the next two weeks.” I told him I would return to check if this had actually been done.

Something needs to change urgently.

Sitting in the restaurant right now as I write this. Took my friend here as a mini bday gift because it’s local…. I lowkey apologised to her because we took one bite of the chicken and looked at each other. The food is cold even though it’s under ‘heat’. Chicken is soft, soggy and rubbery at the same time? Noodles are horrid and the rice is oily could barely stomach it to be honest. Everything in the spring roll section is cold and tough and the only thing we probably found decent were the prawn crackers because they weren’t made by staff. Luckily we bought our own drinks and the only way we were able to survive was through laughs (about the food mind you). Service looks like they don’t want to be there and matter of fact there is a lack off. The only vibes in this place was our own. Never coming back and I will be apologising to my friend AGAIN because no one deserves to go through that. Definitely not worth £18. I wish there was a refund policy based on how good the food was because I’d get a full refund. I just hope I’m not on the toilet later because dis a guh run mi belly!!! woiiiii!

I had come here yesterday evening for dinner with my partner, I’ll give you a run down of the restaurant and the value for money and quality of food:

Price: £9 per person, this allows you to eat as much as you want for around 2hrs. 2/5 stars

Service: hardly any service, just main counter where you pay and get a plate with cutlery from. So I would not say much of a service, 1 cleaner who is also taking plates away from tables once you leave. 1/5 stars

Food quality: by looking at the food from the outside it looks pretty decent, when we attended the food buffet counter I found some of the food to be warmish and not hot enough, the selection was not massive but had some of the usual things you would find in a Chinese takeaway but missing quite a few basics too.
There were also no deserts or fresh fruits which would have probably helped the shops selections. 3/5 stars

Overall I can’t give more than 3/5 stars for this place but felt if I could give 2.5/5 stars this would be a better reflection.

I probably wouldn’t come back here unless things changed and there were more selection going on considering the amount of food places within a 2 min walk.

Great lunch time deals and Food is unbeatable, never a problem! I do feel bad for the old lady who seems to be stuck in the shop everyday, sometimes looking very confused. It’s about time you let her rest !
I starting going here recently and the food is spectacular! I got sweet and sour chicken with friend rice and a side of curry sauce and it tastes amazing

Super super yummy. The price is unbeatable and the hours are great for a night owl like myself. It’s right across the street from where I live but they also deliver free of charge! This is one of the best late night spots in Camberwell especially when I was having lots of people over

I come here once a week and get the stir fried beef hor fun (#222, £4) for lunch. Can't really vouch for anything else but this one hits the spot every time. Ask for chilli oil, fruity, fermented and spicy.

Me and my other half found this Chinese by happy accident. Honestly, it is one of theee best chinese we've had in a very very very long time. We are so impressed with the flavour, choice and value. Their lunchtime deals are really delicious and such great value. We can't seem to get enough of it now we've found it! Reccommend the chicken curry with rice and the chicken in Black bean sauce with chowmein. Also, the soups are really yummy too, crab and sweetcorn was incredible, my fave so far.

Amazing food!! Big portions and so authentic. Only two tables for dine in but that also means the food comes to the table only seconds after it leaves the wok, the aroma is absolutely fantastic. Will become my go-to spot for Dongbei food!!! Best authentic northeastern Chinese food in London!

Astonishing fried rice and delicious roast park buns.
Really recommended!

As an authentic Chinese:
— the food (chief special) taste great! (Maybe less salt would be the best)
— Friendly service!
— unbeatable prices!

Would visit again!
Authentic north eastern Chinese dishes! I’m a regular, highly recommend all stew dishes and the classic aubergine dishes

Their delivery guy has an unbelievably arrogant attitude. As he can’t find my address, he blames me for the wrong postcode. But, my postcode is correct with no doubt. Be careful when you order their food.

Delicious, authentic pizzas in a small, bustling and atmospheric dining room. Service is friendly and attentive.

I visited with my partner and we shared the aubergine balls and frittatina to start, followed by the Bomba di Maradona fried pizza and the Pistachhiosa (which was the favourite).

The fried pizza was very filling which meant we got to take some of it home to enjoy for lunch the next day.

There's a lot of good pizza in the area but this is certainly up there as one of the best!

Came here as I wanted to treat and introduce my 5 year old daughter to a real pizza and I wasn’t disappointed!! We ordered a Four cheese pizza and we loved it!!! This is a nice little Italian spot with friendly customer service, clean tables, room and food temperature was perfect!  Also didn’t have to wait long once the order was made and it was about 18:00 on a Thursday.  I noticed that they had won numerous awards in recent years. Food was really nice!! We will definitely be back again!!

Outstanding food and truly professional staff. We stopped by briefly while on duty with the ambulance, and the kindness we received was exceptional. The team generously treated NHS staff in appreciation of our service to the community and even applied discounts, which meant a great deal to us.

The food was absolutely delicious and authentic — a true taste of Neapolitan Italian cuisine. Highly recommended for anyone looking for real, high-quality Italian food. Experiences like this clearly show why Neapolitan cuisine is considered the best in the world. Keep up 081 and thank you.
An amazing pizza place, they got some authentic toppings and very creative options: fried pizza, pea pesto, tuna on top etc. Highly recommended!

Had an amazing experience with friends celebrating a birthday. All the staff from the management to the kitchen chef were amazing. Food was amazing also. Next time I shall visit the Shoreditch branch.

Came in on a Friday night with a group of 9 and were immediately warmly welcomed. The house red, a 2024 Chianti paired well with the bolognese.
I had the Steak with Peppercorn sauce, and it was delicious. The kids loved the Tiramisu, Chocolate fudge cake and very smooth Gelato.
The owners were wonderful hosts and gave wonderful service.

I come here every week. I always order a pasta dish, and the pasta here is really delicious. The prices are very reasonable and the portions are very large. You can also order a smaller portion at a cheaper price. The pizza is authentic. For me, local restaurants like this always taste better and feel more authentic than big chain restaurants.

Been walking past this place for 20 years. Finally visited after many recommendations as only hear good things about this place. Didn't disappoint. Loved the food, loved the atmosphere, loved the price. La Luna has a nice traditional feel about it and will definitely return soon. Thank you for having us.

Tucked away from the usual tourist hotspots located in South London Walworth Road, La Luna is one of those places you only hear about if you know where to look—and trust me, it’s worth discovering. We visited on a Sunday, which was quieter than usual, but the warm ambiance and attentive service made it a perfect dining experience.

We started with the Traditional Bruschetta, a simple yet flavorful classic that set the tone for the meal. For mains, my partner had the Linguine alle Vongole, a beautifully balanced dish with fresh clams, olive oil, garlic, chili, and white wine. I opted for the Gamberoni al Aglio—six succulent king prawns cooked in a fragrant garlic, lemon, chili, and white wine sauce, served with pasta. Every bite was bursting with fresh, bold flavors, proving that La Luna prioritises quality ingredients and authentic preparation.

The food was absolutely delicious, the portions were generous, and the flavors were spot on. It’s clear that everything is made fresh to order, which makes all the difference. I haven’t tried their pizza yet, but after this experience, I’ll definitely be back to do so.

If you’re looking for an authentic Italian restaurant that delivers on taste and quality, La Luna is a must-visit. Highly recommended! deliziosa!!

The best meal of our visit to London by far. Our family group of 9 had pasta, steak, and pizza choices. The calzone was epic. Birthday cake was appreciated. We may come back again before heading home.

Got my order wrong (twice). I ordered 5 sandwiches - 4 sausage/gorgonzola, 1 chickpea (which I specified should come with vegan cheese). Upon being given the sandwiches, I checked the chickpea sandwich had vegan cheese - it didn't. No problem, I waited for them to make a new one. Returned to eat the sandwiches with my team at work, to find my chickpea sandwich now didn't have chickpeas in.

The remaining ingredients were decent - albeit way over spiced - but was a pretty paltry affair without the key ingredient. My colleagues enjoyed their sandwiches, so I'm giving 3/5. Disappointing.

Jewel in Camberwell, very underrated.
Amazing starter, good selection of pizzas, and Desserts. Friendly staff and quick service with friendly suggestions when required. Friendly to kids. Value for money, quality ingredients and fall homemade condiments and well made and well balanced. And good portion sizes. Should try pizza place.
Shoutout to the amazing Tiramisu!!! Such a lovely space with a warm, friendly team. The pizza was great, we had the aubergine and the seasonal fig pizza, both absolutely delicious!

Pizza was very tasty, but a tad light on Anchovies. And the drink could've been in a bigger glass. But it was 10 times better than Pizza Pilgrims, and free so...
:-0

I went for an afternoon meet up with a friend. Great space if you looking for good food and quite ambience to talk. The pizza was delicious. I also ordered a montenegro and lime cocktail which I found too bitter but the manager was kind enough to change it for me at no added cost.

Popped in unexpectedly on a Saturday evening for dinner after deciding we couldn’t be bothered to cook.  Aga greeted us with a smile and found the perfect spot for the two of us and our little dog. Fantastic food, excellent service, and treats and water for the furry guy. Can’t wait until next time!
Lovely experience. Service was very good as well as the Pizza ! Very delicious. I recommend the truffle pizza

Absolutely the best experience at Franco Manca! The service was incredibly quick, efficient, and friendly, with staff who were attentive and welcoming from start to finish. The food arrived fast without compromising on quality — fresh, delicious, and perfectly cooked. Easily the best service I’ve had.  Highly recommended and will definitely be back!

Great place, well received even without reservation, enough time given to settle and Oder taken and service was very friendly even though there was just a manager and a waiter. They know what they were doing.

We ordered our drinks. Aperol  and lemonade. However the lemonade tasted very old. As I highlighted and the manger swiftly changed to different drink and didn’t charge for lemonade. Which was nice gesture. ( when asked, they said the get lemon juice order from supplier and I realised the lemon juice made couple of days back originally and hence the taste).

Our pizzas came on time and  I really enjoyed the sourdough and well baked.

I always suggest go to Franca Manca  than than going to Pizza Hut or domino’s.

This place is delivers better pizzas than rest. It’s a value for money what is offered  and compared to their competitors.

Was bit disappointed with Tiramisu. Lack of mascarpone flavour and very subtle taste of coffee soaked Savoiardi biscuits. Probably they do like that for kids.

Really loved there serrated knife which are easy to cut the pizza who wants to eat with fork and knife. ( fine details).

Overall it was a pleasant experience and a very friendly manager.

Great experience at Franco Manca East Dulwich. The sourdough pizza was perfectly cooked with fresh, high-quality toppings. Friendly staff and a relaxed atmosphere. Definitely one of the best pizza spots in the area.

name: Ristorante Da Felice
address: Unit K19, 107 Ormside St, London SE15 1TF, UK

reviews.text: A chance drop in as we were passing and hungry. A really nice feeling to the place as you enter the railway arch. It's spacious, warm, has a nice background noise and a generally good "feel". We were greeted by a friendly member of staff who showed us to a table. The theme of friendly and attentive staff continued throughout our visit. Despite being a busy service we never felt as though we were left waiting. The food menu felt a little limited but we ended up with quite a diverse range from chicken skins and wontons to pork belly Hung Lay curry and tasty salad. We probably only needed a single portion of rice to share. The Cha Yen was really good and we didn't have any but other tables cocktails looked good and seemed to be going down a treat! Defo worth a visit if in the area.

Very good Thai restaurant in a railway arch a couple of minutes walk from Peckham Rye Station. We visited for lunch and the menu was divided equally between meat/fish and vegan offerings. We shared aubergine skewers, pork belly curry, lotus root and homemade tofu curry and a bowl of rice and it was all very tasty and spicy. Draft lager was available on tap as well as wine and cocktails. Very friendly and helpful staff.

Highly recommend.

Delicious for meat eaters and veg/vegan as menu is matched for both.

Food tastes amazing, like you're in Thailand... right level of spice (for me).

Innovation on the vegan menu is great as well - that prk belly!

Will be back to try the meat menu.

Had a wonderful dinner at KRUK. Great vegetarian and pescatarian options. The food packed a punch, cooked to perfection. Service was friendly and attentive. Personal favourite was the black rice and mango dessert closely followed by the veggie pork belly.

Really, really good Thai food. I felt elated eating it! We were treated to four sides and shared a main and two desserts.
A note of caution, if you are sensitive to punchy levels of spice, you’re in for a ride 😅

name: Rice Paddy
address: The White Horse, 20-22 Peckham Rye, London SE15 4JR, UK

reviews.text:
อร่อยฟิน เชฟPaul กับทีมเก่งมากค่ะ

Very grateful to my friend that recommended me this gem of a place! Me and my husband mutually agree that this is hands-down one of the best Thai places in London - it’s a pop up that you would love to have as a restaurant. Everything we ordered was impeccably delicious - not too pricey for London and not too salty either! We had the crispy rice salad, prawn in fish sauce (the ceviche), gaeng hunglae somtum and the roast chicken. I’m Thai and I can say that everything was spot on. Ok, maybe some might not like the celeriac in the somtum but personally I thought that was a good choice. I’d recommend all the dishes but the most comforting one would be the grilled chicken with Jaew and sticky rice. Yes, it is very different from your average rotisserie chicken! Even our toddler loved having it along side sticky rice as we would in Thailand.

Given my recent disappointment dining experience in another Thai place because of a rude staff, I must say the staff here at the White Horse are lovely which makes the ambience relaxing and fuss free. The pub itself is pretty cool.

Appreciate I’ve already written an essay but if you’re a south Londoner and you like proper Thai food, you’ll understand why this place is worth getting excited about. Peckham is very lucky to have a pop up like Rice Paddy!

Misleading Portion & Undercooked Chicken

We ordered two £25 platters (£50 total) after seeing the Instagram promo (photo attached). What arrived (see second photo) was served as one combined tray for two and looked small enough that we initially thought it was only one portion.

Even as two platters combined, the quantity was noticeably less than the advertised image for a single serving.

More concerning, part of the grilled chicken was pink inside. When we raised it, there was no apology and we were told it was due to the marinade. When it was returned to us, it was no longer pink.

If you’re visiting based on the promotional photo, be aware the portion may not match what’s shown.

This isn’t your usual Thai pub food. The menu is fun and creative with classic favourites but also stuff you won’t find anywhere else, like the excellent sai ua hot dog with namprik noom relish and the genius dessert of mango sticky rice rice pudding(!). The food packs some serious punch and is honestly unbelievably tasty. The grilled chicken bursts with flavour and falls off the bone. The prawn ceviche and nam jim seafood is just like what you get in Thailand. This level of craft and attention to detail is hard to find, especially in a pub at this price point. I’m a huge fan and can’t wait to come back again and again.

I’m sorry, I really wanted to like this place but I just couldn’t and left the place actually annoyed. As a Thai person it’s quite rare that I would go to a Thai restaurant as it usually disappoints as the food gets very “westernised” and I can usually make it at home or go to my parents… but Rice Paddy had really good reviews and the food and menu looked really good an authentic. I even had it under my google saved places to go as it’s just 5-10mins away from me. So on my mums bday my sister and I decided to treat her and took her here for a Sunday lunch as it’s been a while since we had “proper” Thai that wasn’t ours. 4 adults and 4 kids

First of all, the staff was pretty good and managed to accommodate us as it was busy (we made reservations) and when we ordered, the food came out quickly. We ordered quite a lot (or so we thought)….

4 x pork skewers (£4 each)
2 x betal leaves (£3.50 each)
1 x portion of fried chicken (£8)
1 x Crispy Rice (£7)
2 x Roast Sunday platters (£25 each)
3 x extra sticky rice (£3.50 each)

The pork skewers came first (2 per plate) and the portion was tiny. It was about a quarter of the skewer stick and we paid £4 each! The kids were supposed to eat it with the sticky rice but that didn’t come till 5-10mins later and they ate the skewers in just a couple of bites! Same with the betal leaves… we just wanted to try them but all we really tasted was peanuts and chilli. The fried chicken was ok,   But it just powdery and dark/black…. The crispy rice? It was ok, but the rice was mainly just hard, not crispy. Overall just very disappointing, so ok, we thought the 2 platters of food would make up for it, and so we waited a bit for it and a platter came. It was impressive and looked good. The kids were reaching over to grab the items and we told them to wait as we were expecting another one to come soon…. So we waited (so we can share and serve it out fairly).

But it never came, so we called for the waitress to ask when we can expect the second platter and she said that the platter we had was for two!! I was shocked!! It was basically about half a chicken chopped up, a Thai sausage, a few slices of pork belly and sauce and one sticky rice! I could have finished it all by myself!!

As we were all hungry we decided ok, just to eat. We gave most of it to the kids and the adults barely had anything.

But it got worse, as we were eating the chicken, my sister noticed that the meat was a bit red and showed it to me. I believed it wasn’t cooked properly and called a waitress over and asked her… she said that it was cooked because they “brined” the chicken before they cook it. I reluctantly said oh ok to politely say I don’t believe it. She did offer to “recook” the piece of chicken!!? But
It was already half eaten so I declined her offer and when she left, we all just left the chicken. Picture provided so you decide if it’s cooked or not.

Overall, very disappointing. I have never left a bad review before anywhere but I was just so annoyed with the food and the portions that I had too, especially with the pork skewers as normally you would have at least 4-5 each per person but at £4 EACH it wasn’t worth it. I’m sorry but I wouldn’t go again.

Everything was okay, the rice was well cooked, but the papaya salad was super bland and the tamarind nam jim jaew. The pork belly was decent as were the other meats on the platter. theyve taken the goong chae nam pla off the in person menu, but its still on the website menu which is the whole reason i came so that was disappointing. My main issue is that they sat me near the toilet which smelled awful and wafted towards me every time someone went inside so i had to ask for help to move mid-meal. I doubt ill be back.

We had a late lunch here and everything was soooo gooood!!!!
Papaya salad was big surprise. Delicious! And don’t miss the desert-creme brulle- yummy!
Everything was very tasty and the staff was helpful with order.
We will definitely come back!

Cool contemporary Vietnamese cuisine in Peckham. We enjoyed the mussels, the pork neck skewers and the fried sticky rice croquettes. They also serve cool SE Asian tinged cocktails. We were sat upstairs, which has canteen vibes with long tables and plastic chairs. Overall a decent place for a group catch up, and fairly reasonably priced.

A really trendy vibey spot serving modern Thai food with a twist - would have loved more traditional Thai dishes but everything we had was delish. The sticky rice & beef was the highlight dishes for sure
We had a very enjoyable dinner at Lai Rai a few days ago. The standout dishes were the roasted red kuri squash, mussels in the coconut and lemongrass broth, and the rice paper salad.

Great cocktails, nice food and ambience but just 2 stars from me!
We had a reservation for 18.15. Once we had finished the food, we were offered dessert and coffee.
Before the dessert was served on the table… they brought us the bill saying that we have to leave as we were there for 1h and 10’!!!
Basically , the kicked us out!!!
I checked the website and the reservation confirmation email and they do not mention anything about the time you reserve the table for!!!!
Clearly, if there is such policy , it should be mentioned somewhere!!!!
In addition, if they felt we had to leave… they should not have offer desert or coffee… did they expect me to pay additional 20£ to have it as take away?!?!

Unacceptable treating customers these way!!!

Hidden spot in Peckham ! Was recommended to go and absolutely enjoyed it , the service was really good and the food was amazing aside from one hiccup. The waitress was able to explain the Weekday lunch menu to us and the differences in bowls. Even though it was a first time trying I was a little bit disappointed with finding hair in the edamame, the waitress was quick to rectify this and replace with a new one. Definitely would visit again

The food was amazing. We tried the vegan gyoza, chilli tofu ramen, and the sweet chilli king prawn hiyashi — all absolutely delicious and highly recommended. The service was excellent too, with very friendly and welcoming staff. We’ll definitely be coming back to try more of the menu, as every dish we saw looked fantastic.

Came here a couple of times now. I have to say the food is never disappointing.

I will say ask for these three staff members; they are as good as gold. Yes, it was busy, but they will look after you.

Alfarse,
Mahin,
Jess.

They are a star, and the chefs are world-class.

Proper comfort food. My friends work here and introduced me to it, and now I keep coming back on my own. The ramen’s rich, the noodles are spot on, and the sides never miss. Great vibe, lovely staff, just a solid place when you want a really good bowl 🥢

Had a great and refreshing experience at Tonkotsu Peckham! Tried their special 2-for-£12 cocktail menu – loved the Cherry Blossoms Martini (non-alcoholic, sweet with a creative touch) and the Japanese Gin Martini with pineapple juice – perfect summer vibes 🍸🍍

The Chilli Ketchup Wings (£5) were crispy, crunchy, and tender – so satisfying! Also loved the Seasonal Chilled Ramen with cherry tomatoes and ponzu – light, tangy, and full of flavor.

Big shout-out to Ella for her amazing service – so caring and thoughtful! She even suggested serving the non-alcoholic drink first with the wings, followed by the alcoholic one. Made the whole experience even better 💯

Highly recommend for great food, drinks, and genuinely lovely service!

name: MOMO Sushi Bar Camberwell
address: 23 Camberwell Church St, London SE5 8TR, UK

reviews.text: This place mainly specialises in sushi probably can tell by their name, however we had some starters, donburi and yakisoba. The beef tataki was good but was expecting better as i had many times before from different restaurants. The duck donburi was delicious and so is the salmon, however the beef yakisoba , more  beef would be appreciated as it’s hardly any in the dish I had. The cocktails were delicious, the Kyoto was strong and the other was sweet. So overall I would recommend this place.

A beautiful Sushi restaurant with amazing decor, tasty food and great wait staff. I have recommended this place often, and will continue to take friends here! Staff are super friendly, and I’m never waiting long for food.

Momo Sushi is a lovely place. We enjoyed it very much.
The king prawn yakisoba was full of flavour and perfectly cooked, and the spider sushi roll was fresh, crispy, and delicious.
Relaxed atmosphere, great food, and friendly service. Would happily come back.

Good atmosphere and excellent service welcomed us to this small place.  We tried most of the dishes offered on the concise menu.  The wait wasn't long, the dishes arrived gradually and we were given the opportunity to taste all the courses in due time.  Excellent presentation of the food, excellent quality of the products, different dishes with varied, distinct and surprising tastes.  From the photos you can see the beauty of the food and at the same time you will understand that it will be good to the palate.  This is one of my favorite restaurants.  I advise you to go on foot, if you go by car you will have some problems with parking, I found a really expensive paid one, 3.75 per hour, or go in the evening after 6.30pm.

Had a lunch here and it was really good, a pleasant surprise in Camberwell.

Sashimi platter is very nice. All fish was fresh, nicely cut and had a good taste. Very decent sashimi.
The salmon volcano roll was also really nice with a good taste and texture. The roll was well made. The only thing was the inside of the sushi roll is filled with crispy tempura batter. This is fine, but for me personally there was too much of it making it too crispy. I would have preferred more rice and a traditional filling like avocado, fish, prawn etc. I would try a different sushi next time.

The lemon ice tea was very nice.

Service was really friendly and professional.
Food was made fresh and super quick. I was in and out within 30 mins.

Definitely recommend and I will be returning very soon to try some more things on the menu which caught my eye.

There was a slight mix-up with the starters and mains being served at the right time, but Andre, our waiter, went above and beyond to make sure our meal was pleasant. The food was outstanding, and the whole team made us feel welcomed and comfortable.

A big thank you to Andre for making our first visit meaningful — we will definitely be visiting again!

I went to this Japanese restaurant yesterday, and it was such a wonderful experience! The food was absolutely delicious — the chicken was tender, and the sushi was fresh and full of flavour. The ambiance was beautiful and really reminded me of when I visited Japan — calm, authentic, and inviting.

What truly made the visit stand out was the service. The staff were amazing, and our waiter, Moses, went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect. He was so friendly, attentive, and genuinely cared that we had a great time. You can really tell he enjoys what he does.

Highly recommend this place, can’t wait to come back! 🍣🇯🇵

Surprised this isn't rated higher tbh. Had the Mon saver menu yesterday and it was excellent and probably the best meal I've eaten in London at that budget in a long time.

Only note I'd make to the restaurant is that the soft/non-alcohol drink selection isn't great. Would be great to have fresh juices or to have more interesting soft drink options. Feels like they're a bit of an after-thought.

Place is lovely, buzzing and run by young people but thats okay, make it more interesting. Moses is definitely the server more sure of whats going on. He’s Polite, smiles and takes initiative. I enjoyed my experience. Food is really nice, perfect for a night out. The staff probably need more training but im sure soon this will be a 5 star experience.
Had a lovely meal here and the service was great service. Reem was very helpful and orchestrated a nice gesture for my mums birthday. Thank you!

name: Little Tokyo
address: Marketplace Peckham, Unit 10, Aylesham centre, 24 Rye Ln, London SE15 5EW, UK

reviews.text: Got a delicious salmon teriyaki bento box for lunch. Everything was of great quality, but the dumplings and miso soup pleasantly surprised me the most! Fresh, tasty, exactly what I was craving. Took it to go, packaging was great also. Anything over £10 hurts a little for lunch, but it did feel like a special lunch and was well worth it. Will come back!

Delicious authentic Japanese cuisine, recommend the Teriyaki Chicken and Rice dish... The staff are friendly and welcoming with a great attitude towards their customers, a service with a smile.

The 'Market Place' Mall allows dogs 🐕

Absolutely wonderful experience and I enjoyed the relaxed atmosphere.

I highly recommend it.
The sushi was good but too sweet. We ordered from uber eats and got the wrong food. I ordered 2 bentos with prawns and yakisoba but got Chicken katsu with rice!
Really boring Bao buns - it’s just bao, katsu chicken or a veg pattie and salad….!? You can get much more creative and cheaper and tastier ones in central. Rev up the menu!
I had the Salmon Teriyaki Bento box with extra 3 Tempura prawns which was absolutely banger! The variety of food I get within one single bento box, worth every penny!

This poke bowl is perfectly made. The fish is fresh and tender, carrying a light taste of the sea. The rice is fluffy, just the right temperature to complement the raw fish without altering its texture. The toppings are well-balanced to create a beautiful harmony. The sauce has just the right richness, enhancing the flavors without overpowering them. The bowl’s colors are vibrant and inviting, and every bite offers a mix of freshness and depth. It’s a simple yet refined dish — that’s exactly what makes a poke bowl so irresistibly good. I would recommend my friends to come here and try.

Super nice hidden poke bowl spot near Denmark Hill!

Good quality, the fishes felt so fresh! Generous portion and super friendly staff! It’s so nice to get 10% off for students and NHS staff! Perfect for a quick healthy takeaway lunch

I recently had the pleasure of trying the Poke Bowl at momoto, and it was an absolutely delightful experience! From the moment the bowl was placed in front of me, I could tell that a lot of care and attention had gone into its preparation.

The base of the bowl was a perfect blend of sushi rice and fresh greens, providing a great texture and balance. The star of the show, the marinated tuna, was incredibly fresh and flavorful, with just the right amount of seasoning to enhance its natural taste without overpowering it. The salmon was equally impressive, with a buttery texture that melted in my mouth.

What really stood out to me was the variety of toppings. The crisp cucumber, creamy avocado, and tangy pickled ginger added layers of flavor and texture that made each bite exciting. The addition of crunchy sesame seeds and a drizzle of spicy mayo tied everything together beautifully.

The portion size was generous, and I appreciated the option to customize the bowl to my liking. The staff was friendly and knowledgeable, making great recommendations that enhanced my meal.

Overall, the Poke Bowl at momoto is a must-try for anyone who loves fresh, flavorful, and healthy food. I will definitely be returning soon to try more of their offerings!
Really enjoyed our meals, hot, tasty and generous portions! Quick and friendly service. Hoping to visit again next time we are in the area

Had the chicken katsy curry - I didn't expect it to be so good! For one thing, the katsu remained so crispy, without too much breading and the chicken was still tender! The curry was very flavourful and I also got mine with the addition of 3 veg spring rolls which were perfectly crispy!  Bonus points for the portion size, I was stuffed to the brim!

I had amala, gbegiri, and ewedu at Lolak Peckham, with classic Barrister music playing in the background. Honestly, it felt like I was back in Nigeria. The food tasted proper Naija ✅

I was so satisfied that I literally got up and danced after eating 😄. It gave real buka vibes, and the food was delicious — it truly gave what it was supposed to give. 😊

This place is the best buka vibe in the UK I have been to. I keep coming back.

Food is very delicious and portions are massive. Vibe is good too.

There is parking out front.

I couldn't even finish my food.

My first visit, I enjoyed the food and the company.
I was rather disappointed at the restaurant and decor and the toilet left a lot to be desired.
For a place of culture more investment is needed.

I think this was a decent place considering that we went late on an Easter Monday (bank holiday). The prices were fair, but there was really no display of what we were dished so we didn’t see what we were being served; this I consider not good enough. Staff were excellent, literally at our beck and call, but the stew had too much pepper😃😃

Avoid if you're looking to introduce someone to Nigerian cuisine for the first time. It's basically a glorified "Mama Put". Food was mediocre but reasonably priced for the portion size. Customer Service? What's that? Go and Customer Service yourself. Why are we Nigerians unserious when it comes to presenting a nice, clean and socially endearing food establishment? Some will say, "It's Peckham! What were you expecting?" I can't argue. Na me carry my two legs waka there. Last time.

I’m visiting London and I’ve been craving Nigerian food and this place gave me what I needed! The food was amazing and the lady who prepares it was equally nice. I got abula (£17) and a jug of apple juice (£5) and I was so full leaving! I also have to mention the waiting time wasn’t bad at all considering how fresh the food was. I was waiting for 10 minutes maybe 20 max I’m definitely going back again! Also the aesthetic was really nice which is always a plus!

The food was so good.
I can’t remember the last time I had abula that was this good.
The meat was so soft too. We cleared our plates.

They had so many options on the menu but since the reason we came was to eat abula, we focused on that.

We will be back to try the rest of the menu.

The service was also very good. We were waited on by a very nice lady.

This was such a great experience. The owner and staff were very friendly and accommodating. We came to London for a few days and while here, we were in search of good Jollof and found the best Jollof I’ve ever had! The pepper soup was also flavorful. This place is a gem!

First of all. It’s an 8mins walk from Peckham rye station which is fantastic.  We met the Biz in kaybiz and she was fantastic very sweet woman. Now down to the food.  We ordered the Abula and it was delicious omg the meat was soft fresh and flavorful!!! For drinks we had malt and Nigerian Fanta! We also ordered small water.  The food is go good I am considering having a plate to go! Overall the Abula is 17pounds(with meat o. ) which is affordable… anytime you are in Peckham please come down to try this yummy food and support a Nigerian owned business… we spent about 44pounds here and it was worth it.

Came here serendipitously as the Gambian restaurant we originally wanted to check out in Brixton ended up being closed, but we were still craving west African food so we came to Peckham / this spot after a quick google search - this place did not disappoint!! Probably my fave Nigerian food I’ve had in London (that Abula!!!) also the service was so friendly - will be back ❣️

name: The Flygerians - Peckham
address: Peckham Palms, 14 Bournemouth Cl, London SE15 4PB, UK

reviews.text:
First time at Flygerian and I am pleasantly surprised at the quality and tastiness of the food - absolutely delicious 10/10! The service was also excellent, chilled yet professional. The ambience was also lovely with good Naija music playing.
I had the Jollof suya box, supa dupa wings and gizdodo…yum! I’m glad I dined in because I thoroughly enjoyed my experience.
Keep it up @The Flygerians

The food, absolutely spectacular. 10/10. We went when it was pretty empty but it's such a nice spot and the price, personally, was perfect. Big portions too. Go here for one of the nicest food spots in Peckham

The food was amazing, this is the second time I went and the presentation and taste was I would give a 10/10. The atmosphere and decor was beautifully kept with notes of  Nigerian culture and hints of Peckham culture.
Will definitely come again!

10/10 wonderful customer service, Fantastic food, great ambiance, great prices. Ade serving was fabulous! and another lady but we didn’t get her name, we’re both wonderful  We definitely will be back again! Thank you & God Bless.
A lovely restaurant with a kind and cheerful owner. It was my first time trying Nigerian food, and I thoroughly enjoyed it! Thank you for such a wonderful experience.

name: Wazobia Nigerian Restaurant
address: 670-672 Old Kent Rd, London SE15 1JF, UK

reviews.text: I had a birthday meal here with my husbandandchildren. We were welcomed like family into this very stylish restaurant. We were served promptly and the food was amazing; jollof rice, oha soup and croaker with plantain. Thank you for an enjoyable evening. We have come several times already, and Wazobia is becoming a favourite for a special occasion.

Went out on a Friday night with my friend as we've not been out dancing for a long time. It was quite busy and the music was great.

This is where my complaint starts, my friend and I sat at the bar as that was the best place to be closer to the music but felt like a set up soon after... I was talking to my friend when a random guy started grabbing my head (thinking we met long time and forgetting if I did) he started licking his lips (trying to flirt) got the security to get him off my back.

After 10 minutes another guy came from no where touching me like he knew me from somewhere, when I asked him why is he touching me like he knows me... he responded saying he likes me, he asked he can buy me a drink; as I refused and rejected he started getting aggressive. Got the security again and this time the guy was extremely stubborn.

Instead of the owner of the restaurant to tell the security to take him out instead he tapped me signalling that I shouldn't mind him because his drunk. African given excuse for stupid behaviour.

My friend went the toilet so this same nuisance came to try dance with me. Warned him twice to leave my site but he didn't listen so pushed him (no body reacted and attempted to stop from meeting me, instead reacted to how I pushed him). The security came back and calmed the situation.

As my friend and I were ready to leave, the owner came and apologised saying that he is catching up with friends that travelled from America (like this any of my business)

Shout out to the Security man but men that think it's okay to harass should be escorted out and not served anymore alcohol.

As for the Owner of Wazobia, DO BETTER, its not because you offer free shots of tequila in the beginning that we girls should endure anything regardless of what we wear.

If there was zero star you guy deserved it, I came to you restaurant ate jollof rice it wasn't good, I bought takeaway Ayamase, suya all poorly prepared...the Ayamase pictures I've attached with my receipt. what the hell are you guy sell.
It is not edible at all. It going down toilet..you guy are so lucky I don't live close by🤮🤮🤮

Plenty of parking in the evening.

Atmosphere is great but the service needs improvement.

It's takes up to 1 hour to get an ordered food through on top of that,  there might still be some misunderstanding with what was ordered.

Ordering drink is swift and no issues.

On food-patience and endurance is highly needed.
Owner is great only place near by that stay open until  the time on website. Amazing definitely would go again

name: Calabar Zone
address: 263 Old Kent Rd, London SE1 5LU, UK

reviews.text: Very clean, neat and calm setting (my 5 months old baby slept peacefully in the pram) in the restaurant. Nice choice of music - nostalgic/romance. Our first time trying  efo riro (with assorted meat) and pounded yam - perfectly seasoned to my taste and spiciness level (high - I am Asian). Had the pleasure of getting authentic experience of trying the pounded yam the traditional way using my hands (which I was ecstatic to try) ! They even provided a bowl of clean warm water to wash your hands before eating. Husband tried their jollof rice with assorted meat. Both dishes were surprisingly very generous portions with very good price (£14.00 each). Nice interesting textures of assorted meat - tripe, ?cow's skin, fish, meat. We also met the chef, who was very pleasant and gave a very warm welcoming motherly vibe. The waitress was also very nice and made sure we understand our orders. Would definitely recommend and we will likely be back for more!
The food was incredible! So delicious and flavorful, and the owner was very kind and friendly. The portion sizes were extremely generous as well, especially for the price point!

10/10, my first time having Jolof Rice and it was so good! I was with a friend so we tried both the chicken and beef, both were amazing! Shout out to Coco for being such a lovely host, such warm hospitality and smiling the entire time. If I lived here I'd be there every week!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Calabar Zone truly delivered with the jollof rice they cooked for my 40th birthday party. It was absolutely divine and had that authentic 9ja party jollof flavour—rich, smoky, and perfectly cooked. Everyone loved it and kept going back for more. The quality and taste were top-notch. I highly recommend Calabar Zone for any event if you want food that people will genuinely enjoy.

This was my first time trying African food, and it did not disappoint! The host was so welcoming and taught my friend and I how to eat fufu. The jollof rice with chicken was amazing, and I'm already craving it again!! We also got the egusi soup and that was very good as well. The portions were also generous and at a great price too. 10/10 recommend for the great food and service!

name: Tasty Jollof
address: 154c New Cross Rd, London SE14 5BA, UK

reviews.text: This store stays open till almost midnight, and I gotta give props for getting through my study sesh at this late hour. I grabbed a big plate of jollof rice and fish from Just Eat, and it only set me back £10 for a seriously huge portion. Loving those spices, especially that black sauce (no clue what it's called).

Calling all kelewele lovers! Lovely portions of food and kindness served here :) A joyful little eatery with a limited but delicious menu. Excellent recommendations by the young man running the show. Jollof Rice with chicken was served with spicy sauce was very tasty indeed. I’ll be back for more kelewele!

Went with the lovely too good app to try. I felt welcome and the food in my surprise bag was just extremely good quality and flavour rich. The sauce dip was mindblowing too. Will def going back and it’s a very authentic spot much recommended!

I had Jollof Rice , with beef, and salad in coleslaw. It was full of flavour. The food preparation area looks spotlessly clean. I was made to feel welcome, and intended to take away, but was then invited to sit down and eat. Very hospitable, and friendly. They are good people. Thankyou will definitely be back.

I ordered jollof rice only because I was buying my meat from Smokey Jerky. (Big up Smokey Jerky) anyway the rice was hard. All £7 of it. I had to throw it in the bin!! This is the second time this has happened. In future I will stick to Nims or Lits restaurant to buy my jollof rice.

Also if you’re only accepting cash, state this on a notice on the shop. It’s annoying ordering and collecting the food to be told cash only!!

name: Alaowerri Restaurant and Bar
address: 129 New Cross Rd, London SE14 5DJ, UK

reviews.text: For authentic isi-ewu, nkwobi, ugba and stockfish...etc and other African dishes, visit here. The owner, Uncle Joe, is very nice and makes sure customers are well attended to. His prices are also very good. I will visit again for sure.

Service was good but food was unfortunately not there at all, the moinmoin was soaked in salt, the amala felt like water until we sent it back but they were kind enough to make another amala which was better. The price was a bit on the high side.

Really great Nigerian restaurant. Space is small so plan your visit against/ahead of peak times. The food is delicious and the owner is a very nice and friendly man. The service is great and I will definitely be coming back. The isiewu in particular is amazing! Honestly, the food there is really good.

Firstly I do not leave reviews on google unless I really have to or see the need to. I haven’t been there.however I ordered online on deliveroo. The jollof rice was more of curry rice definitely wasn’t jollof .it was a yellow colour tested nothing like jollof.

Thank God I had some shito at home to make this taste better the meat was laking seasoning 🧂 and the fish I ordered was like it was just cooked in a plain  tomato sauce.

The only thing that was nice in my order was the plantain. Potion sizes are really good but yeah the food could really do with some seasoning and the jollof needs to improve.

I’m hard to please when it comes to Igbo soups but Alaowerri surpassed my expectations. I ate Oha soup with poundo yam. I’ve never eaten Oha soup this good in London. Also got beef suya from here. The suya was so tasty.
The food portions are huge.
The guy who attended to us was warm and friendly too.
I love the ambience in the restaurant as well.

I’m defo revisiting.

name: Teju's Street Food
address: 89 Peckham High St, London SE15 5RS, UK

reviews.text:
Please save your money, this is a legitimate scam.

Not fresh ❌ (they microwaved a pre-package order of suya)

Bland ❌  even the yaji couldn’t save it.

Ludicrous portion size ❌  (so small, it’s not worth it at all, paid £10 for this small container.)

Please save your money and go elsewhere. This is not authentic Nigerian food.

Edit : I see the business have accused me for being a “competitor”. It’s laughable really. I’m not involved in the food industry, I really just don’t like wasting my money as a customer. Speaks volumes of their attitude, instead of taking feedback, they bite back. Stay clear.

I’ll provide alternatives though, since they think I’m a “competitor”. There is no competition to be honest, it just wasn’t good, and not good value for money considering it’s £10, quite pricey.
Suuyar, Tiwa n Tiwa and Alhaji Suya are great alternatives.

Pulled in here after running out of energy halfway through my cycle ride home - so glad I did. I had some puff-puffs, plantain and spicy charcoal grilled beef. Super generous portions and all soo tasty. I cycled home a new man

I went to Teju’s today to try out some new food spots. I ordered Jollof rice, puff puff and fried fish which was red brim. Honestly, I didn’t have any faults with the Jollof rice, it was lovely especially paired with the fried fish, the fish was delicious. I thought the puff puff’s were alright, kind of sweet to be honest compared to the ones I usually have. I would’ve rated this a five star place but the lady serving me asked me for plantain and I did say yes to having some, had no qualms with paying extra for it but when I opened it for my lunch, the plantain was never packed in the container. Additionally, I don’t think the customer service was that great, it’s like the lady wasn’t that bothered when she was serving me, deffo would’ve gone back if there wasn’t a problem 😭

One of the best Places for Authentic Nigerian smoky jollof, their Suya is so succulent and tasty and you can customize the spice level to your preference, I had their Jollof and Suya combo and it was so amazing, will definitely try again, the customer service was really lovely 10/10🤭
food is consistently delicious, portions are sized well and great service. my new favourite spot :)

name: Afrikiko Bar Restaurant & Club
address: 871 Old Kent Rd, London SE15 1NX, UK

reviews.text:
On the 18th of April 2025 I ordered yam, plantain with grilled tilapia and hot pepper for takeout.
To my disappointment the food was not what I expected from a Ghanaian restaurant.

The yam and plantain were definitely leftover food that has been re- fried over and over. Plantain was all mushed and soaked in used and dirty oil. I had to throw all the food in the bin to avoid food poisoning.

Tilapia tasted funny and not properly made. Afrikiko at old Kent Road should be ashamed for serving unpleasant food to a customer.
We pay lots of money for foods and you just chose to serve disgusting meals to the customer.

I have attached photos of the rubbish food served to this comment.
On this note I will definitely not recommend Afrikiko.

PACKAGING WAS REALLY POOR!
THE RESTAURANT NEEDS TO WORK ON THAT TOO!!!

This is my first review ever, I never do this but this particular one is necessary.

On the 29th of August 2025 I was craving Waakye before leaving London to go back home from holidays. And unfortunately this Restaurant was the only Ghanaian restaurant close to where I was so i decided to go eat there.
At exactly 17:05 i entered the Restaurant and was the only one there so i thought “nice my food wont take long to serve then” so i immediately started ordering.

Before i started ordering I asked the waiter (Waiter 1) how long will my food take to be served so im sure i wont be spending the rest of my day waiting for my food, she said “ooh i will have my food in less than 10 minutes max 15”. In my head i was thinking “damn thats long but okay”.

At 17:10 I’ve ordered and seated waiting to receive me food before 17:25. Shockingly at 17:40 my food was still no where to be seen and there was also nobody onsite so i went calling for somebody and a lady (Waiter 2) came out and she told me she knows nothing about my order but she will go check.

In about five minutes (17:45) she (Waiter 2) came out with my food and my egg was missing. She then told me i will have to wait another 5 minutes for my egg. I was really surprised she expected me to eat my food when the meal was incomplete.

At 17:55 Ten minutes of waiting for my egg came to pass so i had to follow up again. To my surprise Waiter 1 came out with foil paper to cover my food saying the egg is still not done and i will have to wait longer and she doesn’t know how long. I complained and she gave me two options;
1. I eat my food without the egg and hopefully by the time I’m my egg will be ready and I can take the egg To-go. (Just the egg).
2. I eat my food without the egg and I get a discount of 1 pound because my food was incomplete. (I don’t understand how thats a discount).

After she mentioned the “discount” option I then asked “what about the delay” and she replied “That i can do nothing about it because the owner is absent”. I just sighed and finally after waiting for my food for an hour my egg appeared.

And yes I paid full price for the food if you’re wondering. My meal was ice cold literally and almost missed check in at the airport, thanks to London Underground and my legs i didn’t ( I had to run).

When I first walked into the restaurant I actually thought I was in the wrong place. Walked in from the back entrance straight into the bar and they were playing constant Mexican music. I didn’t feel as if I was in a Ghanaian restaurant at all. So I had previously booked the table which thank God I did since the new post lockdown regulations you don’t get to be seated without making prior bookings. Even though there were lots of empty tables. So I ordered Nigerian Fanta with jollof rice and beef stew. I really enjoyed the stew and the jollof was nice too. There was also an order of banku with okro soup. The okro soup tasted lovely! Last but not least there was another order of banku and tilapia. The atmosphere was different as I think the place was rented for a bunch of people who were into Spanish, Mexican music so that’s what they played throughout. I was expecting a bit of authentic Ghanaian, Afrobeats music but got none of that. In all 10/10 highly recommended this restaurant as staff were really lovely and attentive and food was great!

Real authentic Ghanaian food. Highly recommend Turkey tail and jollof rice and extremely flavourful and was executed perfectly. Staff were extremely helpful and went the extra mile to ensure everything was perfect, from the food presentation to extra straws with our supermalt. My new favourite restaurant

My friend took me to this restaurant for my first time last month, i was on holiday in London. I ate their jollof, tsofi and kelewele, it was amazing, marvellous, great and what else ? Enjoyment!! I am in love with this restaurant and their food was soo plentiful. I mentioned it to all my friends in London and in Italy.
I was so exicted, so i went there for the second time with my brother and other friends.
Their menu and site are full of different and many dishes, it reminds me my home-land Ghana. The location was lovely with some afrobeats that accompany you while you are savoring and enjoying your dish.
The service was excellent, helpfull and very careful of the costumer needs.
I will definitly go there again and try the fufu, banku and the akyeke!!

I really enjoyed the Jollof rice, the Mac&cheese, and suya chicken and meat. However what really did it for me was the Puff Love and lemon drizzle sauce, I have never tasted anything like it, it was so good. This place is a must try.
The food here is amazing, and flavoursome ! The desert was super tasty too! Would 100% recommend and will definitely be ordering again.

Food was sooo tasty, enjoyed the fried rice, Mac and cheese with the  Suya wings
But the ‘Puff Love’ with the lemon drizzle was something else
Would defo recommend and will be ordering again!
The suya chicken wings and the mac and cheese were really tasty! If you’re after some good comfort food. You found the place!
The jollof and suya lamb was very nice.The dessert was 10/10. Would definitely recommend.

name: Tasty African Food
address: 62 Peckham High St, London SE15 5DP, UK

reviews.text: It’s truly heartbreaking that a place I once looked forward to visiting for a lovely meal has now become somewhere I no longer enjoy going to. I bought T. Beans from the Peckham store, and it was full of sand  I had to throw it away. I decided to give the Catford store a try, but to my surprise, it was even worse. I’m extremely disappointed. I’ve wasted almost £40 in just three days.

It was my first time of visiting Peckham and I was so hungry needed a delicious African meal. I asked around and someone recommended this place. I decided to try it out with my friend. We both ordered egusi soup and pounded yam. It was sumptuous 😊🥰. It is really hard for someone to satisfy me with egusi soup but to my greatest surprise, Tasty African food did. I will recommend this place for their nice meals. However, their customer attending skill is poor and I would recommend they try put in more effort. We were eating and my friend needed a tooth pick. First of all, meal was served without toothpick…come on who does that? ..so we requested for it and she told us to come pick it up…like😞😞….my friend who was still eating, had to leave her sit to get it and that was it.

with a friend of mine who is also a chef like me, we decided to try again to eat African, this time the experience was incredibly surprising because all really good foods, different but well prepared combinations, and as a motorcyclist as I have been for years I also really appreciate the generous portions as in this case were, truly surprising for those of us who are looking for new dining experiences; few seats to eat on the spot but for a place that mainly deals with takeaway food I can say that it is a small detail really appreciated
I bought efo riro today and I must say I was very impressed with the portion size and quality of the food. I will definitely come back 👍🏾

Must be a change of management?
● SPOTLESS!! Store; Friendly attentive staff; Fantastic food.
● This is now my new "go-to" branch.
● Up till now, it's been...(the still wonderful)...Leyton Branch.

name: Just A Favour Food Services
address: 24 Peckham Park Rd, London SE15 6TW, UK

reviews.text: Really i was the best service i saw and nice staff and kind all of them with smile and nice test food  till i become daily my food from them thanks all of favor eat restaurant and beba head with coming years to be top in shaa allah

JAFFS Nigeria meal is the best in London South East, I enjoyed every taste of the food, the pastries are second to none especially the meat pie and forth sh roll. Oh the pauf pauf is something too delicious to do without.
The customer service is 👌👌the woman is very lovely
Every visit to London JAFFS is always my eatery 👍👍👍
Love the food from here. Have had the puff puff, egg rolls, meat pie and chicken pie and they're all elite
Good presentation, great taste, excellent customer service over the phone for my order substitute and efficiency in delivering via Ubereats👍🏻
J.A.F.F.S is so by far the best Traditional Nigerian Taste in London.

I really enjoyed the food and service. They were mind and welcoming. I didn't wait too long for my food. I'll definitely be coming back to try more of their food. Oh and great value for more... just drop down and try it for yourself 🤗
one of the best meat pies i’ve had in london. the puff puff was tasty too. and the owner was very lovely and kind, I will be returning soon
Fantastic lunch deal. Plantain very succulent, well spiced and a good portion. I’ve also tried the meat pie which was lovely.
If I knew how to cook rice like them I’d start cooking more. Took me back to my childhood meals and made me want to make stew forever more! Lovely people and amazing meals xx
Great restaurant. Such lovely service and delicious food, can’t recommend enough

Great local location for us, however food was good, drinks were good, atmosphere was low, but we were there for the food only.
Staff were friendly, not over friendly but hey depends on what you're looking for.
We would go bad as a local food source but not as a party with friends for the atmosphere unfortunately 😕

I would give ZERO stars if that was an option!

Where to start from? After waiting over an hour for food to to be delivered, it arrived cold. And then to take food out of the bag to discover the grilled chicken ordered to pair with our cold fried yam was not in the bag. Instead we had been sent bean stew we did not order.

We had inedible jollof rice with bits of white uncooked rice, Kelewele either spiced with something or fried in very old oil which left it with a very strange unpleasant taste, flavourless/tasteless okro stew with fish and nothing else, hard saltless tasteless fried yam and plantain.

Tasteless, flavourless cold food which went straight into the bin after tasting. Biggest disappointment ever!

Fourth Garden African Restaurant….NEVER again.
The worst customer service ever see especially the kitchen I mean cooking section they even don’t understand how deal with customers
Food is always on point and the atmosphere is homely and welcoming
The environment was lovely, the  food was to die for,  reception fantastic,  I can't complain,  it was I lovely place to be

The food comes in small portion sizes and is actually tasteless. Really disappointed as always like to support local business. I could have cooked more flavoursome food - it’s clear they just don’t care. E.g. the jollof rice was pale and had no flavour. Do not waste your money.

Lovely ambience. Cool and cozy. Tasty food and pleasant staff. Nice place for a group of people to meet or have a private party  and enjoy Sierra Leonean cuisine. Hot chicken wings was very delicious for starter and fish was deep fried with pepper sauce took the fish to another level. If you liked to eat fish head, here is your chance for a finger liking experience.
The food is so good, the portions are large! The service is above and beyond. So grateful to have visited this restaurant instead of going elsewhere.  God bless the cook!
Nice relaxed restaurant. Had the fish with jollof rice it was great. Can't wait to go back again.

Really relaxing, cosy and friendly place. you feel 100% welcomed.  The only downfall is when they have private bookings you are turned away. Always better to call first.

I love it.

name: Lit African Cuisine by Zee
address: 134A New Cross Rd, London SE14 5BA, UK

reviews.text:
I’m genuinely disappointed. I ordered jollof rice and a "full chicken", but what I got was half of a small chicken breast and half of a leg, both cut into random pieces. I love supporting Nigerian spots because I’m Nigerian myself, but I also believe in paying for value. The price wasn’t the problem, I’d happily pay more if the food matched what was promised.

What really threw me off was the pricing. They have a lunch special that comes with two sides and rice for two pounds less than what I paid. Yet I got only rice and what they called a “full chicken,” which turned out to be the equivalent of one side of jerk chicken packed into the same small box. When I pointed out the issue, they acted like I was trying to be difficult and ended up forcing me into taking a refund. I never even got to eat the jollof rice I was looking forward to.

The sad part is I only went there because the better-rated restaurant nearby was closed, and the barber next door recommended this place. I could’ve been a loyal customer if they’d just served what they advertised and treated me fairly.

If you’re thinking of ordering from here, be careful. The food might look good on the menu, but the service and attitude don’t reflect the care or pride you’d expect from people representing Nigerian food. It felt like they just wanted to make their money for the day, not serve customers who actually care about good food. I hope they learn from this, not just as a bad review, but as a chance to do better, to deliver good food, what is advertised and treat customers with respect. I wasted my time today, and with their careless attitude it feels unlikely they’ll change, but I still hope they do.
Had a take away last night! Honestly the most tasty food! I live in north london and will happily travel to south this weekend for more! Food was soulfully good!

Went there for jollof and bbq wings, some of the best food i have ever tasted in my life, amazing service, atmosphere was some of the best ive seen at any restaurant from decoration, will be coming again

Thank you so much for saving our night with the last minute food you made possible. I appreciate the enormous effort and the food was yummy too.
Will definitely stop by again 👌🔥

Went to Lit the other day. It first started off not well ask I have them a curtsey call to say I am running late and they tried to tell me that my reservation money will be taken and not given back and we will be a walk in, I just find this a bit ridiculous as one I called them to let them know and if you go to British establishments this is not the case but whatever so be it.
When I got there it was not busy there was only 1 table in use. Food was really good, service was good and they didn't take my deposit which was great.
