I would recommend this restaurant and go again.
One of the best places for authentic Ghana food! The owner is so pleasant and welcoming! The restaurant is neat and the food is soooo good! I can't recommend this place enough!

If you are looking for authentic Ghanaian food to eat this is the place for you

I have been eating from here for years! They sell the best waakye in the whole of London no word of a lie! My favourites are the waakye and their tsofi. If you are a big eater try their tilapia it’s massive, well seasoned and super juicy.

Oh their food is VERY affordable

Come back and tell me how it goes
Excellent food, excellent service, affordable prices.I couldn’t recommend more if I tried! 😍

I ate here Saturday evening with a friend of mine. Amazing food! Jollof was fantastic. The table next to us had the tilapia which looked amazing. Will be eating that next time. Nice friendly service. Thank you and glad you are local to me!
I can’t recommend them enough. The wakye is delicious. The place is very neat. We are so far enjoying our holidays in the UK with Mozah foods😍

name: Made's Kitchen | African | Nigerian Restaurant
address: 115 New Cross Rd, London SE14 5DJ, UK

reviews.text: Excellent food any lady fall in love  with man
The food was really good and was made fresh as I waited

name: Yummy Fingers Restaurant
address: 626 Old Kent Rd, London SE15 1JB, UK

reviews.text:
I really enjoyed myself and the food in Yummy Fingers.
Their customer service is excellent compare to none.
I will always visit the restaurant, I advise you do same.
Nice one yummy.

I order the Jollof rice, meat pie and fish roll and this is was the best meal I have eating in a very long time
The meat pie and Fish roll was the absolute best I have ever had
Always enjoy my food from here. The lady is always kind and caters dishes to your likes.
I have ordered for their mixed okra three times or more and met with no regret.  It tastes really nice
Very mannerless staff especially black old lady very disrespectful

I had a wonderful experience at Delta Tavern - I ordered Banga soup with pounded yam and it was cooked to perfection. The food is authentic Nigerian cuisine which is moderately priced. Thank-you Delta Tavern for the wonderful hospitality and warm, friendly atmosphere.
Not sure why it took me long to write this review because I enjoyed my meal so much I came back with a group the next time!
The food literally took me home. Excellent service with the most delicious taste in London

My partner and I wanted some authentic experience of local delta dish made with palm oil  called Banga, and served with starch. We came across this restaurant on a recent visit to Peckham to find out what the local vibe is all about. The Banga soup with fish and assorted meat was absolutely delicious- it exceeded our expectation! The food was served in the traditional clay pot and it was piping hot! The meat was tender and the fish was well cooked. The service was good and prompt.  We liked the Banga soup so much we returned a couple of weeks later to have the same meal! And it was just as good as the first time! It was a nice experience and we recommend this restaurant for its speciality food from the Delta state of Nigeria.

The place is nice the service is 10/10
The owner is very friendly and welcoming I will definitely visit again and again

name: Agrobeso African Cuisine
address: 139 Peckham High St, London SE15 5SL, UK

reviews.text: Been going here for many many years. Agrebeso and staff are respectful, friendly and professional. Food is tasty, and usually warm. The food is a reasonable price and portion. They sell mostly Ghanaian foods and some general West African drinks and snacks.

My first time visiting Agrobeso African Cuisine and it couldn’t have been any enjoyable. I had their Waakye which was £12 per plate. The taste was top notch. The quantity also did it for me, very filling and delicious!!! I highly recommend.
I had waakye and my friend had light soup and we loved our food. Good service too
Their service is top notch and I enjoyed every bit of the home made meal

One of the best African Cuisine in London!
If you miss home don't worry I bet this even taste better than home😃

We got the best customer service when we visited and the lady was very friendly!

Try it and I guess I will catch you there one of these days
One of the best african food I’ve ever had, The atmosphere was really good.
Such a shame, the jollof rice was very dry and clumpy! Suya wasn’t too bad
Jollof rice is out of this world!!! And the most succulent chicken wings!!
Love this place not too expensive and great atmosphere
Delicious meal good atmosphere. Good music and a great customer service.. The owners are one of a kind

name: Enish 24
address: 46 Camberwell Church St, London SE5 8QZ, UK

reviews.text:
On entering the premises, you’re greeted with a smelly, extremely dirty carpet that’s meant to simulate grass. You’ll then find a woman sitting behind the counter, who does not acknowledge you, listening to a sermon on loud speaker through her phone. Then, the possible chef will come from the back and take your order - to give it to them, they don’t take too long to prepare it.

I ordered jollof rice, beef suya and beef stew.

The jollof was brown in colour and burnt in flavour. As in, there was absolutely no other flavour to the rice except for the burnt bottom of the pot and the rice was not vibrant and orange like you’d expect, it is mud colour brown.

The so called suya was just boiled pieces of beef that were maybe boiled with a ‘suya flavour sachet’, and slices of red onion. No dusting of suya powder like you’d expect, no nice grilled pieces of meat. Just grey, boiled slices of beef

The beef stew was about 80% oil 20% tomato and the beef pieces were just these humongous squares of meat. I had three of those in the container and honestly, just on a sensory level, the meat was off putting to look at, so that coupled with the amount of oil just made me not want to eat it. We had to siphon the oil from the stew before with dished.

Honestly, the meal was dreadful and we ended up throwing it away.

In the strongest way possible, I’m advising against eating from that restaurant. Like, the food was actually vile. I, personally will never eat there again .
They have delicious food, very nice and clean environment and very friendly staffs, will come again , keep it up
I love this place so much,customer service is superb always smiling and I'm still bringing my family again

The customer service was absolutely terrible, no greeting from staff and just felt rushed to make a order, poor packaging and food was spilling on the way home, the lady at the front really needs to change her attitude and be more nicer to paying customers.
Why have you not try Enish24 moi moi this Enish food is something else the moi moi is Top notch I can give 10 stars 🌟 good customer service I will come back every time

name: Exclusive African Restaurant
address: 905 Old Kent Rd, London SE15 1NL, UK

reviews.text: Seriously good! much flavour. Jollof rice impeccable
It was a great night out with friends we really enjoyed the food,  music and the services

Worst place I've ever had. Bought a chicken and rice for 10 pounds they charged me 20 I'd rather have flushed the money down the toilet. Take away no utensils provided I wish I never walked into the place. The patrons were nice and so was the music that's the only reason it even gets 1 star.
It’s a lovely restaurant and their food is yummy. Nice customer services and very easy to locate. It’s a nice and neat place. I highly recommend this place.

My friends and I were disappointed with their unprofessional service and rudeness  We made our order base on the menu they gave us, and were shocked when our bill came, completely different from the price in the menu. The bleached lady jumped into defence when one of pointed out their deceit. It was was obvious she planned it. She went inside picked three menus and chose the one that correspond the bill they gave us. The music was loud , we could not have a friendly and normal chat among each other. The bitter leaves soup was a disaster 😫.

name: Yakoyo Spot
address: 7 Peckham High St, London SE15 5EB, UK

reviews.text: Do NOT eat from this place. I once ordered efo and pounded yam. It gave me and my daughter food poisoning. My daughter was so sick she missed 1 week off school.  I was also very poorly.  I would NOT advice anyone to eat from here
Tasty and affordable food. Food took a bit to arrive after order although it came fresh.

I asked for my food to be delivered cold so I could reheat it at home, but instead, it arrived frozen solid. This wasn’t a simple misunderstanding, the food was fully cooked, then frozen, and completely inedible on arrival with zero stew. It’s outrageous for a takeaway to deliver frozen meals without telling the customer.

On top of that, the portion sizes didn’t match the descriptions at all. What I received was nowhere near what was advertised.

I’ve reported this to the food authorities because this isn’t just poor service, it’s a food safety concern. I won’t be ordering from here again, and I’d advise others to be cautious.

Pictured is the supposed (turkey stew x large). Instead it’s a frozen half turkey wing! Despicable.

The food is HEAVILY overpriced for what it is. The price increases have been unnecessarily quite steep in recent times (especially on specific a product that cost next to nothing to produce in mass) I used genuinely used to love this company and would always buy puff puff in quantities as to take to family gatherings or as a gift when visiting friends but the ridiculous pricing brought that to to halt and has deterred me from buying as frequently as I once did. As disappointing as all of this sounds additional issues with being charged more than the advertised amount. I hope thing take a better turn. But hey 🤷🏾‍♂️

They are honestly so rude and unwelcoming , as u walk in you are not greeted , you are not offered your recipe nothing just "what do u want". They need to work on their customer service honestly. Only thing good is their food

The quality and portion sizes of the food has gone down drastically and yet I am paying a higher price. I get way lower value for my money. My last two orders were terrible. It was basically like I was getting the remnants left in the store. Never ordering again.

I haven’t had African food in so long, but this brought me back to my roots. I got so much food all under £20. The meat pie is so soft and tasty and the suya was delicious. Ogbono was also lush. I’ll be going back for a takeaway again.

name: Roti Wrap City
address: unit 10, Market Place, Aylesham Centre, London SE15 5EW, UK

reviews.text:
Kevin is a welcoming Gentleman. Had a Good Chat and Some Great Jerk Chicken like my mates mum used to make. Great atmosphere quick service.
Independent food vendors need more support. Thanks for a Good meal.
Me belly them full..

Came down here for the first time today and got to try the brand new jerk prawns with the curry prawn roti. 1000/10 it was delectable! The prawns were so juicy, a fantastic portion and beautiful smiles behind the till! Great spot, can’t wait to come back and try more on the menu!

Visited Roti Wrap City with my mum today for lunch after seeing an advertisement on Tiktok and I’m honestly so glad we did. From the customer service, to the food, everything was amazing.

I was struggling to decide between the curry chicken and curry goat and the woman who served our food was very accommodating and offered us a taster of both the curry chicken and curry goat which I thought was so lovely of her. We also happened to meet the owner Kevin, who was also lovely and contributed to our positive experience.

We both got the Curry Chicken Roti Wrap, flavours were tasty, food was hot and prepared well. I would highly recommend visiting, the great food and great service is unmatched and will take the business far! Thank you so much, I will be recommending to everyone and be visiting again very soon!

Bwoiiii! Lunch today was courtesy of these guys. I had the Jerk Salmon with Rice and Peas. Food was hot, jerk sauce was jerk-ing. My mouth is still singing. The Rice and peas was just how I like it and the plantain was just right. Will definitely travel back from North Weezy to lunch again.
Big up!
My first time eating here and definitely not my last. The curry prawns were AMAZING and the plantains were cooked so well. I’m looking forward to trying the rest of their menu. :)

name: Little Deli God Bless
address: 17 Peckham High St, London SE15 5EB, UK

reviews.text:
I visited this spot last night & was served by the lovely Aimar. He gave great customer
service, was funny, kind & very knowledgeable about the food dishes & went the extra mile to detail all the dishes for me when I was unsure about it. absolute great food & service. would highly recommend & definitely will be going back. I got the curry chicken and rice and peas.

Very very nice food and great customer service.  A friendly Jamaican shop (I’m not joking) just ring the bell.  Jerk chicken is good mutton is good too but just make sure whatever you want they have as with all Jamaican shops

Today, I visited the Little Deli Gad Bless Restaurant to purchase food, and a staff member made a remark implying that I may not be Jamaican because of my appearance. As someone with Jamaican heritage, I found this comment offensive and hurtful. In my view, such judgments based on appearance can hinder businesses from thriving. If I were a business owner, I would never make such comments or discriminate against anyone. I believe in welcoming people of all nationalities to maximize profits and create an inclusive environment. As a result of this experience, I have decided not to patronize Little Deli Gad Bless Restaurant in the future.
Amazing jerk chicken and rice and peas 10/10 good value good service and amazing food❤️❤️

There was no vegetarian option on the menu, but I got a delicious Calaloo with egg instead of saltfish.
Order in advance if you don't want to wait in the shop.

Dear Chef, what a disappointment.
Mutton soup with no mutton! - gristle does not count as meat. 🙁 3 tiny spinners does not a soup make and filling containers with large lumps of potato is cheating. Not even a hint of thyme appeared in my order & grey yam is not an appetising addition either! 😳

This restaurant must have changed chefs (repeatedly) as the quality of their mutton soup has diminished significantly since I first ordered from them. Cho! Waste of my money. Do better…in the name of ‘Caribbean’ cuisine I beg you.  I’m so upset..😩 I’ll try again in a few months -see if things or chef improves 🤷🏾‍♀️

Made a quick pit stop here, whilst on the go, and picked up a pattie and BBQ chicken....OMG, probably the nicest BBQ chicken I've had. You can thank me later 😉

Service was also fast and friendly. The lady behind the counter was warm and welcoming.

I'll be coming back, even if for the chicken alone!

Delicious food, lovely presentation, great portions and I really rated the added hot sauce and dressing for the salad! I also realised I'd missed calls from the restaurant I was wondering why and then realised it was regarding my options of the chips and mash🤦‍♀️ instead they sent me both! All for £20 aswell so can't really go wrong definitely ordering again thank you!

The oxtail and rice I had was unreal. The meat was so tender, the bones practically melted in your mouth. I’ve never had oxtail that soft before. Honestly, I chewed the bones like they were a snack. The rice was perfect, fluffy, and balanced everything out nicely. It’s the kind of dish that makes you feel like you’re being spoiled, and you can’t help but wonder why all oxtail can’t be this tender. One of the best oxtail I had in a while!

I can’t lie I was disappointed. The plantain came dry and cold. The chicken was alright but more like bisto gravy with some pepper sauce in. The mutton was a bit gross. Sorry guys but we deserve better

Scam !!! Don’t spend your money here . I did order on just eat a large jerk chicken and rice …13£ I got some rice and two wings Mainly bones …they charged me for a large but  didn’t even get a small …rip off

Just been here for lunch had a really cheap filling meal, good service and relaxed environment with great music. Had the curried goat , rice and peas and coleslaw and a bottle of water for £7.00 Tasty, filling and great flavour, meat was tender and delicious! Beef and cheese patties needs bit more spice!
Food was nice, full of flavour.  Shame we were overcharged for our food. We were also missing one of our sides.
The food is exceptionally good for the cost £6 with a side (Coleslaw, pasta or veg). With a bottle of water. From 11:00AM to 2:00PM. Get down to Dellys in Camberwell.

Some of the people working in this place let's hope it's there business and not Someone else. Some of them are so rude especially this old woman that attends to me on my visit today. If it's not her business then you better get rid fast.

name: Rusto Shawarma
address: Unit 15, Peckham Market Place, Rye Ln, London SE15 5EW, UK

reviews.text: Love this place for a quick bite to eat. Chicken Shawarma is our favourite. Full of flavour, packed full with chicken and salad and definitely well worth the price.
Honestly one of the best meals we’ve had in London, what a hidden gem. The Shawarmas were so fresh and tasty, but the jerk chicken wings stole the show! Would highly recommend to everyone.
the large chicken shawarma was a bit small for a large one but delicious, definitely recommend!

went here the other week ,nice Shawarma just wished it had a little more spices and was more hot as it was warm , a different wrap/ bread other then that good for the £s dont miss out

THANK YIU
Good shawarma wrap, well loaded (go for the large one for less than a fiver). Not 5* because the meat was lukewarm

name: KOREAN PECK
address: 44 Camberwell Church St, London SE5 8QZ, UK

reviews.text: Great experience at Korean Peck! The food was nicely cooked and flavorful. The service was very good, and the price was reasonable. What really impressed me was the cleanliness of the establishment - it's clear that they take hygiene seriously. Overall, a great spot for a delicious Korean meal!

Ordered the chicken rice box. Was fully prepared for disappointment, like most things in life. But instead, I was greeted with perfectly crispy chicken that made me briefly forget the void. The rice was fluffy enough that I considered contacting it for emotional support.

Sauce had a kick, but not so much that it felt like a personal attack—just enough to remind me I’m alive. For a brief, greasy moment, I felt something close to joy.

In summary: Korean Peck didn’t fix my life, but it definitely improved my lunch break. Would recommend.
One of the best loaded fries I’ve ever had. Just look at it. For the price too, only £6. I had the sweet and spicy sauce it was amazing. Recommend this spot. A hidden gem in south London
The food is really good and tasty. Lots of flavors. My favorite is golden honey with extra cheese. Extra cheese is not on the menu, but you can buy it. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️/5 Plus, NHS DISCOUNT is awesome!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Absolutely loved this place! The food was fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with care. Every bite was delicious, and the quality really stood out. The staff were friendly and welcoming, making the whole experience even better. Service was quick, and the atmosphere was clean and inviting. Whether you’re grabbing a quick bite or sitting down to enjoy a meal, this spot is definitely worth a visit. I’ll be coming back for sure!

name: Korean Kimchi Bowl
address: Unit 17, Karma Kitchen, 18 Verney Rd, London SE16 3DH, UK

reviews.text:
I ordered today for the first time there (from Uber Eats) and I am a little dissapointed. The scallion pancake was the best one, but the chicken could be crispier and tteokbokki could be more soucy, cause It was too soupy and the thumbnail on "uber eats" looked thick and creamy, bit Instead It was very soupy. Also for me personally there wasn't enough rice cakes.
Also I didn't get any fork or spoon and It's kinda a big Issue, when you stay at a hotel :(.
Idk about the service there simce I wasn't there pedsonally, but In the end, I wouldn't order again.

Thoroughly enjoyed the creamy tteokboki, it is however very super (but still so enjoyable).
The Kim Chi rice was gorgeous as well.

Very enjoyable and reasonably priced. Will be ordering from here again!

Amazing food,
First time trying their food and we love it !
Thank you so much definitely am gonna be your regular customer
Thank you guys.
Great korean food with reasonable prices. Korean fried chicken taste awesome. 10/10 recommended..
Five start absolute the best restaurant, so much flavour . Will come again for sure 👌

name: King Samgyeop
address: Unit 21, 18 Verney Rd, London SE16 3DH, UK

reviews.text: Tried Samgyeop(pork belly) with rice from this new restaurant in London — the pork belly was fresh, flavorful, and still sizzling hot. Definitely ordering again!

name: Huong Vi Viet Camberwell
address: 49 Camberwell Church St, London SE5 8TR, UK

reviews.text: Visited this restaurant to prepare for our upcoming trip in Vietnam and we were not disappointed at all. Friendly staff, a comfortable setting and really delicious food!! We went for a vermicelli dish with spring rolls along with a chicken and rice dish… both seriously yummy! After returning from Vietnam, I can honestly say this is authentically Vietnamese. Will definitely return!

Best spot for pho in Camberwell! Very delicious meal, and the waitpeople are just the nicest people. Love food, love the service, the price is fair - would definitely come again. They accept cash and bank transfer paiments.

I came in for Vietnamese Pho(Noodle Soup) to keep the cold out, the service here is amazing , the server welcomed me on arrival and was very hospitable during my time here. The food was amazing and the art on the wall is breathtaking. I will definitely recommend and return to this establishment. If you’re having a hard time choosing from the menu she will give you great suggestions.
Such a lovely little place, had the beef pho it was delicious, super flavorful meat, really good with some sriracha. Also the Vietnamese coffee AMAZING. Our server was so sweet :)
The food is amazing and the staff are friendly and accommodating. Best to book a table in advance as it gets super busy. Best to check out the Pho and Mamas Chicken. Won’t be found anywhere else l.

If you're a seafood lover, you absolutely must put this restaurant at the top of your list. My visit was nothing short of spectacular, with a few dishes that truly left me in awe.

The standout, without a doubt, were the prawns. The menu description likely doesn't do them justice. They were quite simply the most beautiful prawns I have ever eaten. Perfectly cooked to a tender, succulent texture that practically melted in my mouth, they were bursting with fresh, sweet flavor. The presentation was often elegant, making them a feast for the eyes as well as the palate.

Beyond the prawns, the culinary excellence continued. The squid was equally impressive—incredibly tender, not the least bit rubbery, and masterfully seasoned. It was clear that the kitchen has a expert understanding of how to handle seafood.

To tie the meal together, we ordered the spicy seafood soup. This was the perfect comforting yet exhilarating bowl. The broth was a complex, aromatic, and fiery delight, packed with a generous bounty of fresh seafood. It was the kind of dish that warms you from the inside out and has you craving more with every spoonful.

Overall Impression: This restaurant demonstrates a masterful command of Vietnamese seafood. The ingredients are phenomenally fresh, the cooking techniques are precise, and the flavors are bold and authentic. It’s a destination for an unforgettable meal.

Highly recommend for: Seafood enthusiasts, special occasions, and anyone looking to experience expertly prepared Vietnamese cuisine.

Will I be back? Without a doubt. I'm already dreaming about those prawns.

Very happy to recommend this place. I had the pho, wife had the vermicelli with spring rolls and mother in law had bun xeo pancake. All of this was super tasty. For our kid we generally just order a side of noodles (lol his choice) and the restaurant were kind enough to make it into his own bowl with soup. The two course set menu makes it great value too.

If you have ever visited Vietnam and experienced its cuisine, Viet Flavours offers a wonderful opportunity to revisit those authentic tastes. The dishes are beautifully prepared, rich in flavour, and truly reflective of traditional Vietnamese cooking. Each bite brings a sense of nostalgia, capturing the essence of Vietnam’s culinary culture. An elegant and enjoyable dining experience, highly recommended for anyone seeking authentic Vietnamese flavours.
Service is good and fast. Food is absolutely flavourful and so tasty ! Very good experience, I will come back ! I recommend the spring roll tofu and  the beef brisket and meatballs pho.
Tasty Vietnamese food with good portions. It's comfortable to sit down and have a meal there. Nice lunch menus of under £20 which includes a main dish and a side.

name: Dac San Xu Nghe
address: 899 Old Kent Rd, London SE15 1NL, UK

reviews.text:
Đặc Sản Xứ Nghệ is such a wonderful place. The staff are incredibly warm, friendly, and genuinely helpful — you’re made to feel welcome from the moment you arrive.

The food is truly authentic, with many regional dishes you don’t often find at other Vietnamese restaurants in London. Everything tastes homemade, and the cozy atmosphere makes it feel just like being at home. If you’re looking for real Vietnamese flavours and a comforting, down-to-earth dining experience, this place is an absolute gem.

I wasn't sure what to expect as this cafe is on old Kent road and feels pretty much in the middle of nowhere. But was pleasantly surprised by the tasty food. The pho was tasty, broth was beefy without being overpowering, I choose the well done beef (beef wasn't melt in the mouth but was good).   I would say one of the better bowls of Pho I have had for a long time in London. Service was friendly and welcoming. The food is good but the location isn't great. I will now go check if they do deliveries!

This is a very authentic Vietnamese restaurant, and as far as I could tell, it’s a family owned business that is still quite new. We spoke with the owner, who was very friendly and welcoming.

The food was absolutely delicious I would especially recommend trying the pho, which was outstanding. The garlic pickles on the table are also a must try, they pair perfectly with the dishes.

The prices are very fair considering the generous portions, which makes the experience even better. I would definitely recommend giving this place a try if you’re looking for authentic Vietnamese food.

I came here as a van I was picking up nearby wasn't ready. The atmosphere leaves a lot to be desired - there was a young child loudly playing on an iPad throughout my entire meal (not a guest, a staff members kid). The service is good, they barely speak any English at all - not a problem for me, sign language will get you there but I showed them a picture from their old menu and they happily made it for me even though it was technically off menu.

However, the food is AMAZING. Genuinely some of the best Vietnamese I've had outside Vietnam. Extremely authentic and just delicious. I literally went back the next day when I returned the van just to try the Pho.

Would definitely come back again!!

Very small place. The servers don't speak English but the chef's daughter is able to translate very well. She is adorable and is adept at marketing and communication. Family run business which I am happy to support. The food was hearty and warming.

Quaint little restaurant with a very homey vibe. Loved the people, very friendly and kind. They explained the menu in detail and were very welcoming. BONUS POINT - CHICKEN AND BEEF ARE HALAL!! ✨
The food tastes amazing, almost like coming home to your mom's cooking after a long rainy day. 😊
Very large portion sizes, well worth the price🙌🏻
Would definitely treat myself every few weeks❤️

Absolutely amazing rare beef pho, up there with the best I’ve ever had! The broth is incredible, so light but with such a depth of flavour. Can’t recommend enough. Pho usually only on the menu on Saturdays though! Lovely, friendly staff too. Banh mi also very good, nice selection of fillings and delicious iced and hot Vietnamese coffee.

My favorite restaurant in London!!

The grilled pork with rice and prawn noodle soup is super delicious, close to my work as well, I visit this place almost every time I work, highly recommend!! :)))

The grilled pork and rice was juicy and a great portion size. The spicy pork banh mi was fresh tasting due to the vegetables used , perhaps there could be a bit more pork but it was nice regardless. The viet beef stew was very nice too, the meat was soft and tender. The service was incredibly fast , our food came out in 5 minutes. This is definitely going to be a regular new spot for me.
Food was nice, I like their banh mi selection. Service was okay. I do suggest to go earlier on the day to get best selection of food, as it sold out by the afternoon.

delicious food, great service and excellent price points! we ordered a couple of their tacos, the refried beans and mussels to share - the prawn tacos was our favourite! as we were a walk in we waited around 15 minutes for a table outside, but then we were quickly sat. our waitress was so attentive and we’d definitely recommend :)

Table was in a corridor, so not a great start. Food was really good though – loads of flavour and nicely done. The scallop (pictured) looked great but the spice completely drowned it. Tacos were good but small, and £8 for chips felt ridiculous.

Service was friendly but rushed, and the table wasn’t cleared between courses – a real pain. Floor and tables felt a bit grotty, sauces everywhere.

Then the service charge… why? Just pay staff properly instead of skimming it off, and stop prompting for another tip on top.

Still, the food was strong and I’d go again – just wish it was cleaner.
some of the best tacos I’ve ever had!! The pork and beef tacos were 😮‍💨😮‍💨 and the leek enmolada was amazing!! Thanks so much for the wonderful service from Grace, you made our night ⭐️

Food was ok but nothing special. Scallop was nice, taco's were very basic we had both the pork and the beef ones, really nothing special and at £6 for 1 taco they are extortionate. Margs were decent but nothing to write home about. I feel like I'm missing something because of the rest of the reviews, maybe we just went on an off night.
Delicious Tacos! We had the pork, beef and prawns and they were incredible! Cocktails are a little pricey but nothing beyond the usual London prices and they were also very good.

name: chickntaco
address: Unit 10, Aylesham Centre, unit 10 Rye Ln, The Alys, London SE15 5EW, UK

reviews.text: The Chicken Wings Are A Banger! And Dont miss Out On their Chickken Bowl. The food is So delicious! Youll keep wanting It more! A Truly Hidden Gem In Streets Of Peckham!!!!

What a hidden gem! Fantastic tacos, super juicy and flavoursome, with the fabulous texture. Sauces were delicious and guacamole was light and fresh. Highly recommend and will come again! Sagar (I think that’s the gentleman’s name who served us) was lovely.

Really great tacos! Very unreal and delicious. Also a plus point— all the items in the food menu are halal! And they fresh prepare everything everyday!! You can taste the freshness in the tacos! I really love the ambiance of the place too
Amazing tacos

Ive been here 2 times in 3 days and I know Im gonna keep going very often. Best tacos Ive ever had in my life. Ive tried the chicken taco with pineapple sauce and the birria taco and honestly I cant tell which one I prefer😍the staff is very kind and friendly and I would definitely recommend this place to everyone! Trust me, when you try their tacos and their tortilla chips with homemade guacamole, you wouldn’t go to any other Mexican food place! See you very soon x

The food was 10/10. I would have taken a picture of my burrito but I had no time to waste! Lol. Chase served us and he was an absolute delight from start to end! I've had a lot of burritos but this one tops most that I've had! We had pulled beef brisket! Yum yum yum. I can't wait to come back when they get the liquor license because burritos and tequila always go down nicely!

Everything is a quality experience. Food , service, drinks. These unique drinks are not to miss. The churros were perfectly warm and crispy, when dipped in caramel sauce … wow tat was heavenly. Even after a full meal I couldn’t stop eating. Highly recommended for families as well.Thank you plan burrito , you made our evening memorable.

Plan Burrito Elephant & Castle – Exceptional in Every Way

This spot is a must-visit for Mexican street food lovers. The burritos are packed with fresh, flavorful ingredients, and the generous portions make them great value for money.

Service is fast and friendly, with staff going the extra mile to ensure you get exactly what you want. Their welcoming and professional attitude makes the experience even better.

If you’re in the area, don’t miss out—great food, great service, and a great team!

Wow, such a great experience! I was served really quickly and the food came out fast too. The place has a nice vibe, it’s aesthetically please and the staff were super friendly. We got the chicken burrito and was impressed by how many toppings there were included it was absolutely delicious. I’ll definitely be coming back to dine in!
The food was delicious. The services was brilliant. 🤩 definitely worth a visit. Good food and good company. 😍

name: Los Tacos
address: Market Place Peckham, Unit 10, Stall, 24 Rye Ln, London SE15 5ER, UK

reviews.text:
Fantastic place to visit and enjoy authentic Mexican cuisine.

The chicken burrito rice box was a delicious meal! A combination of chicken, rice, and burrito ingredients served in a convenient box format. It's a popular option for those who enjoy the flavours of a burrito but prefer a bowl-style presentation.

Polite staff and excellent service.

The food hall is Dog-friendly too... 🐕

I highly recommend it.

Wow! The Best Birria I’ve tried yet! Juicy cheesy goodness! They also offer normal soft shell tacos which came with lots of salsa options. They were also so so good! Will definitely be visiting again!

Very slow at preparing our order, over 25 mins wait for our order of two plates of tre tacos and nachos and when were ready, were very poor.

The salsa is poorly made the tomato chunks are far too large, fillings for tacos ok, nothing amazing. The nachos hadn't even been put under the grill to heat thru or even melt the cheese, after a 25 mins wait isn't really good enough.

Wouldn't go back or recommend.

A lot of reviews are fake, it's not actually mexican. I'm mexican and I have tried them and I do not recommend them and very expensive by the way.
Try the ones at Kensal Rise, Birria taco
They're the best ones.
Lovely rice bowls and service was so great. Generous portion size as well so its incredibly filling. Loved how quick the food was made and received as well. Will definitely be coming back!

We went out for dinner and had a really great experience. I ordered the guacamole, green chicken pozole, and pastel de maíz. The guacamole was fresh, smooth, and perfectly seasoned with just a hint of zest. It was simple but done really well. The green chicken pozole was warm and comforting—perfect for a cold evening. It was full of flavor without being too spicy, and the portion size was generous. For dessert, I had the pastel de maíz. It wasn’t overly sweet, and the cream was light and airy, making it a lovely way to finish the meal without feeling too heavy. The ambiance was also wonderful. Authentic Mexican music played in the background, and the décor was beautiful without feeling over the top. The atmosphere felt relaxed and welcoming. The prices were reasonable, and overall the food felt warm and nourishing. I would definitely recommend it

Absolutely loved my experience at Maiz Tacos & Pozole! The service was excellent — very attentive, friendly, and welcoming from start to finish.

The food is simply amazing — full of flavor and beautifully prepared. The steak taco was delicious, but the Norris taco with cheese was definitely the highlight — super tasty and perfectly balanced.

For starters, I highly recommend the corn ribs and the guacamole — both were fantastic and packed with flavor. The cocktails and mocktails are also great, especially the Aqua Loca and the Jamaica — refreshing and well made.

Highly recommend this place if you’re craving authentic and tasty Mexican food!Absolutely loved my experience at Maiz Tacos & Pozole! The service was excellent — very attentive, friendly, and welcoming from start to finish.

The food is simply amazing — full of flavor and beautifully prepared. The steak taco was delicious, but the Norris taco with cheese was definitely the highlight — super tasty and perfectly balanced.

For starters, I highly recommend the corn ribs and the guacamole — both were fantastic and packed with flavor. The cocktails and mocktails are also great, especially the Aqua Loca and the Jamaica — refreshing and well made.

Highly recommend this place if you’re craving authentic and tasty Mexican food!

What a great find! Maiz Tacos & Pozole truly impressed me. The service is outstanding — very attentive and caring staff who make you feel welcome.

The food is absolutely delicious. The steak taco was cooked perfectly, and the Norris taco with cheese is a must-try — so flavorful and satisfying. The corn ribs are a perfect starter, and the guacamole is fresh and super tasty.

Their drinks are just as good as the food — Aqua Loca and Jamaica are refreshing and beautifully prepared.

I will definitely be coming back and highly recommend this restaurant to anyone who loves great Mexican cuisine!

Came here for taco tuesday. Had an amazing night with my friend. The food was delicious. Both meat and plant based options were amazing. And I could try Pozole and Carajillo which are not easy finds in London. The staff was amazing and super friendly and the atmosphere immaculate.
Happy to have found this place. Will be back soon.

We had such a great experience at Maiz today! The food was absolutely delicious from start to finish. We ordered the birria tacos, the steak taco, chicken pozole (my +1s absolute favourite), corn ribs, and guac with chips, everything was full of flavour and tasted so fresh. The birria tacos were rich and juicy, the steak taco was perfectly cooked, and the chicken pozole was so comforting and hearty. The corn ribs were a standout side, and the guacamole with chips was the perfect way to start the meal.

The horchata was my favourite! so refreshing and just the right amount of sweetness!

A special shoutout to the server who was incredibly kind and attentive. They even ran out to the road to get my hair clip that had fallen without me noticing, which was such a thoughtful gesture. Truly amazing service.

Can’t wait to come back, highly recommend! 🌮✨

Great experience at Chipotle in Dulwich. Good seating at this location, fresh juices, and fresh food. Service was friendly and efficient. No shortage of hot sauce. Toilets as well! Top 3 Chipotles I’ve been to in the UK (other two are Watford and Islington.)
Loved it. We went when it was quiet. Service was good, quick, friendly. Food was great, generous portions, and very filling. Tasty, and flavourful. Well worth it, and I will definitely go again.
I got a salad bowl from there that came with no salad. Their food is not super cheap and it’s annoying that this happens. It should have been clear as the bowl clearly looked empty.

Tried the veg burrito with chips here and honestly it was so good. Everything tasted fresh, the flavours were on point, and the portion size was really satisfying. Chips were crispy and went perfectly with it. Staff were quick and friendly too. Definitely coming back again. 🌯✨

I had been coming here on and off for a few months at lunch during the week as its relatively quick service and huge portion sizes.

However, the last time I came, I paid and went out about my business. Only later that day my wife saw that £39 had been taken from the account from Chipotle, which was obviously wrong as it was just one burrito.

I went back in and explained that there had been an error. The manager at the time eventually said he would refund me. But the refund amount was less than the total amount they charged me, so they still owed me money. I only realised this after leaving. I went back in and the worker gave some excuse that 'this was the maximum we could give' and that 'you can get a free meal next time'.

I mean really?

You steal money off trustworthy customers, then don't even refund the full amount?

Beaware of overcharging as I would not be surprised if they do this often. Check the amount you paid and make sure you get a receipt.

I won't be going back there again. The staff give strange vibes to be honest, I couldn't put my finger on it completely but after that experience I suppose it makes sense. Shady workers that aren't to be trusted and you wonder what else goes on and how the food hygiene really is.

Avoid.

Ordered from here for a late night snack and was HORRIFIED! Should have known how bad things were gonna get when I opened the bag and there were Fantas in there instead of the Lilts we ordered. Took a bite of the taco and immediately knew something was off. The meat tasted like it was chewed up and spat into the tortilla and it whole thing was dry as hell. I opened it up to take a look and whatever was inside was burned to a crisp. I don't know how the food ended up being burnt and cold simultaneously. I got a refund through Uber Eats but I think it's actually immoral to serve people this food, knowing that most people won't actually seek a refund. Avoid this place!
Genuinely one of the nicest tacos I’ve had, food quality is absolutely top tier and the beef taco was by far the best. Wouldn’t recommend anywhere else for a proper French taco.

The worst ever, I ordered loaded fries a the fries were old and the le big boss also had old fries and the chicken nuggets inside were soggy! They don’t answer their phones either. Terrible done order!

That was the first time I tried French Tacos in my life and I will definitely go there again. I highly recommend trying the Algerienne sauce. Good old dinner you can have after hard work and this can feel like a reward.

third time i’ve given this palce a chance & each time they forget an item in my order. it’s sad that they don’t pay attention to their orders & make the same mistakes. Can’t enjoy a proper meal when you order from this place lol. My last time for sure.

I love this style of pizza. I was really excited when I saw the ads about this new pizzeria opening. And I am very happy that it’s just as good as the photos and videos are showing it. The atmosphere is nice, the staff and chef are really friendly and welcoming.
We tried four different types of pizza and all were very tasty. I will definitely come back, even though it takes me almost 1 hour and a half to get here.

Went with a friend on Friday night
Buzzy and cozy, the team is friendly and polite. The pizza full of flavours - great pairing with a cold beer and some mozzarella sticks on the side!! Thumbs up for the doughnut with sweet ricotta 😍 well done guys!!!

Went to Connie’s Pizza in Peckham after seeing it on Reddit. Fantastic tasting pizzas. Super crispy. We decided to have the ‘Connie’s Pizza’ with a marvellous spinach sauce (Pesto like) and a soft egg in the middle. Tasted amazing and will be back to try some of the other flavours. Met the owner who gave us fantastic service along with the waitress.

What a great new addition to Queens road Peckham neighborhood! I am so happy Connie's is here. We had a lovely meal and we are looking forward to having many more.
The pizzas are wonderful, thin crispy crust, great balanced topping. We went with Funghi and Nduja both delicious. The negronis were great. And the desert, brioche bun with pistachio filling was a good way to close Friday off. Highly recommend to end your meal with this satisfying, perfectly sized desert.

The staff was lovely, the decor and vibe felt relaxed and cozy. There are only high chairs indoors but there is lots of heated space outdoors too (rain protected). This will be amazing in the summer.

Friday evening was already packed. Well done Connie's!

Thank you Connie's pizza. I would definitely recommend the Connie special - I often don't like egg on a pizza but it was done very well here. Also had the vodka sauce pizza which was really nice. Wasn't too impressed with either of the starters we had (mozzarella sticks and Mac n cheese balls) and overall downfall was that the food could've been hotter. Overall nice vibes and good food. thank you and good luck!

Dough Hands, Dough Hands. What incredible pizza this is. Lives up to the hype, and then some.

I’d visited the East London based Dough Hands about a year before.. and I’m so glad it’s now in South London.

I love this pizza. Top 3 I’ve ever had. Can’t wait to go back.

The best pizza I've had in London. Nice and crispy but not taking it too far that it feels like a cracker, touch of cheese on the crusts just makes it better. Every detail is essentially perfect. The OG and Jode are my favorites, but the spicy tuna is a dark horse for sure. With a pint it's like 20 quid or so, not terrible. No matter what you get, it's good
Always delicious pizza and dip. Probably the best in London !

Pizza tasted pretty good (we got the margherita, spicy tuna, and mushroom) the flavors were definitely there and worked well together. However I was a bit let down that the pizzas were not as “crispy” as a lot of reviews said, the edges had a bit of a crunch but the bottom crust was an absolute flop, all the pieces instantly flopped down when picked up.

Nuts that (at the time of writing) we're sitting at only 16  reviews. This is a city of 9 million or so and everyone should be eating this pizza at every pizza-related eating opportunity they get. Probably every salad-related eating opportunity too, life's too short.

It isn't easy for me to express in words how good the pizza is. It is the best pizza I have eaten, at least in London. Everyone talks about the crust and the base here. Rightly so - it is incredible. This is something between neopolitan and New York style, and what is perfectly executed is the firm, crisp base. You don't need cutlery.

The toppings are also just brilliant. We got the OG and the  Jode. Jode was best, but both good. Other than "brilliant", two specific comments here. (1) The tomato has a presence on this pizza - it isn't just some forgettable paste or a vessel for the rest of the ingredients. It's there, and it brings a deeply pleasant, fresh, slightly acidic (in a good way) bite. This brings me to (2), that there is real harmony among the ingredients. I truly believe that real thought has gone into this menu and each pizza. The jalapeno in the OG felt unnecessary when reading the menu, but on eating it married well with the heavier, richer pepperoni.

Also, shouts to manager Allie (I hope I got the name right) who is absolutely top tier and went out of her way to make us have a good night, while managing a restaurant / pub that was absolutely rammed.

Lovely service, very kind staff and very accommodating. The interior was clean and fresh. Our pizza was out of the wood oven and as hot as can be, it was perfect. Delicious pizza, the ingredients felt high quality and the base was spot on. Will come back here again if I am in the area.

Very good pricing.

Delicious, freshly made pizza with the perfect crust and rich, flavorful toppings.
Warm, cozy atmosphere and attentive, friendly staff specially qasim that made us feel right at home.
A perfect spot for a casual night out — we’ll definitely be coming back!

Pizza is simply amazing, the chicken wings are tasty and tender, venue is clean and tidy with a great atmosphere offered by the woodfired oven. PS everything in the photos (pizza, wings, bottle of drink) was £20 which I find a bargain! Would definitely recommend!
Beautifully cooked. Took less than five minutes. And reasonably priced. 😊

First time customer here for 2 take out pizzas and i will definitely be coming back. Beautifully cooked with a crust that doesn't break a tooth. The staff were extremely friendly & polite & the whole atmosphere in the place felt really calm and peaceful. My wife absolutely agrees too. Definitely recommend.
The food is so delicious I love it and the service is great I recommended to everyone 5 stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Been going for the past few weeks and the food has always been great, Especially the Half Boneless Chicken Meal. Prices are very reasonable as well. Would recommend to everyone who is on the fence about it.

Always come here after gym. 10/10 food
1/2 chicken and chips can’t go wrong
Had an amazing food and great service. Lamb was mouth watering.
Great food!!!

FIRST REVIEW FOR 2026 JAN
Came back last night and sadly it wasn’t the greatest!! The rice was hard and the chicken strips are very small, almost like chicken dippers size. The strips were also hard to cut and burnt to a point where all I could taste was like charcoal. Disappointed! Gonna stick to my usual half chicken! Yall getting 1 star deduction!!!
————————————————————————————-
SECOND REVIEW OCTOBER 2025
Been back here a few times since first review and today I went for half a chicken and rice… EXTRA HOT…. Yooooo it was fire!!!!! 🔥 🤪😁
————————————————————————————-
FIRST REVIEW SEPT 2025
Finally a good spot to get some grilled chicken, there is another chicken shop near but it’s AWFUL!!  So… I was very excited when I saw this shop opening because I love and enjoy grilled chicken after a gym workout. As I walked in I was happily greeted by the chef/cook and he showed me the menu, he took my order and told me to have a seat. The seating was good cosy not hard like other shops. The decor was nice and clean and the tv was on playing music.

As they just opened I had to wait 5-10 minutes but it was worth the wait. The Chef was very courteous and friendly offering me tissues, wipes, cutlery and sauces which was impressive because of the manor it was done.

Got home and tucked into my food and it was DELICIOUS!!! 10/10 so good I had to bring my friend for an encore last week!!
We went out to eat with my family and the gentleman’s service was wonderful. The food was some of the best we’ve ever had
Very good food, quick service and very helpful staff, needed a chicken shop like this in Peckham I enjoyed
U most try the pizza at place one of best in the area

The food is amazing and one of the best.
The place is exceptionally clean and the staff is excellent.

Keep up the great work guys
Delicious pizza, dough was tasty and worth munching on alone. Interesting flavours. We tried hot Pineapple and truffle fungi.
Delicious fresh pizza with flavourful toppings. A good list of dipping sauces to go with it too, would recommend!
Such delicious pizzas.. absolutely perfect crisp! The nduja with a fresh pesto basil swirl was my favourite. And the honey on top - yum!! Already looking forward to my next one
The proper slices pizza was 🔥🔥🔥. Nice and crispy with no flop!

If you wanna talk about proper pizza, come to these guys. The taste, amazing. The service, delightful. The quality, out of this world! Your mouth will feel leaving satisfied and your tummy will leave feeling so happy. Can’t wait for next time lads!

Delicious and generous pizzas at Basil Leaf Pizza! We ordered the large 15-inch pizzas and they were absolutely tasty, with very generous portions.
We got our order to go, and the service was quick and efficient. A great spot if you’re looking for a satisfying, flavorful pizza.
Super tasty pizza, amazing dough, the soppings and the cheese, I have destroyed the pizza by myself, well recommended 5 star service

Really nice pizza, crust is thin as I love.sadly could not find porcini pizza on the menu, but ones I have ordered made a good dinner. On a note, tiramisu came frozen so tasted a bit like an ice-cream.
Such a great pizza place the food never disappoints. Delivery is excellent with really friendly staff and always arrives super fresh. We definitely recommend
Quick great value thin base (almost new haven esque) pizza, always great, and very quick delivery

name: Veggie Crust
address: 356 Old Kent Rd, London SE1 5AA, UK

reviews.text: I prefer fireway but they have Ben & Jerry’s ice cream.  You know America gonna love this pizza!
Staff nicely understand the customer and listen very  carefully . Good customer service. I will come back again best pizza🍕 shop in town 😋
I swear to pizza God this is the best pizza shop. Hot melting cheese superbly based with fresh proper toppings and the deals are amazing seriously good pizza
Amazing food would definitely order again, visiting from Manchester and it was one of the best pizza I have ever had, good quality
I always order online and they are quick to answer and when I come to the shop the pizza is ready the time frame they told me.

name: La Venice Wood Fired Pizzeria
address: 242 Old Kent Rd, London SE1 5UB, UK

reviews.text: Amazing and delicious pizza. Delivery was faster than expected. Would recommend anyone in the area to try it!

Amazing deals however the pizza doesn’t taste the best. I bought tandoori pizza however the chicken did not look or taste like tandoori. The pizza looks good but doesn’t taste the best that’s all. Also the chips looked very raw and pale. There is no salt on the fries and was very oily. I was very disappointed as I was trying to search for some good takeaways in the area.

My pizza was due for delivery between 1015 and 10:35 pm. I gave it until 10:40 pm rang the pizzeria. When I rang them, the man asked for my address again?  He then told me “they will be with you in 15 minutes”. Meaning my Pizza will be here at 11 pm.
He was so blasé. He was like “relax madame relax, we will call you when we arrive.
No apologies or explanation whatsoever. Very poor customer service. Infact, I was made to feel like I was bothering him, or that I was asking for something extra. I just hope when this Pizza eventually arrives, that it was worth it.
I definitely won’t be using the Venice Wood fired pizzeria again. It was literally like they just didn’t even care. So in a nutshell, ignore the delivery times they give you (as it seems they’re only a suggestion) and just be prepared for the wait.
Pizza arrived 11pm. A very nice, polite fella.
The food, clearly had been in transit longer than anticipated & so wasn’t the best. Even so, the pizza was very slap dash & not worth the £17.05 for a 13” fungi pizza & onion rings (yep, I only ordered the onion rings to buff up my order for the delivery).
Best pizza in the area, quick, top tier service, and very friendly. Made my pizza to go in 5 minutes while waiting for my uber. Great value
Food is phenomenal best pizza ive eaten. Tastes so much better than all of the main chains. Would recommend all day long

name: Tamashi Sushi and Bento
address: Bermondsey Trading Estate, The Hut, Rotherhithe New Rd, London SE16 3LL, UK

reviews.text: Ordered from here countless times, every single time has been superb. Owner is so friendly and kind. The best sushi in SE. The value especially when you pick up in person is exceptional. Would recommend to anyone

2 months ago I had a bad experience with this restaurant but the owner was super kind and I decided to give them another chance.
They did way better and I appreciate the effort they put into the order.
Their customer service is great and good communication.
The packages were perfectly sealed and nothing spilled.
I think there could still be some room for improvement in the combination of flavours.

All the other reviews about authenticity... Trust a gal from the region instead! This was all around 🤮 and shocking. Ordered 2 boxes of sushi, mostly uramaki and some nigiri and was shocked by the flavour. Wasabi was watery!!! Come on folks get the ratio of water to wasabi powder right at least :( The most outrageous was the avocado in the sushi that was so unripe it could have been a cucumber. Actually crunchy.

The crunch theme is continued on the uramaki where a plausibly edible sushi is brazenly graced with an onslaught of crunch bits (see photos) which based on my 2-year stint as a chef at an omakase restaurant, is an atrocity.

Finally my cat rejected the salmon sashimi on the nigiri, when she would fight me for it when I get a takeaway such as from wasabi. 'nuff said...

Too good to go portions are SMALL and the picture shows 2 orders of too good to go, not one.

UPDATE:  I've attached an image of the restaurant's response to this review whereby they claim I lied (about what??) and explained that I could be sued for it...bring it on...is this even standard business practice? Odd... Also I've just seen that most 5* reviews are posted by profiles with just one or two reviews.

This was one of the worst orders ive ever had. A simple salmon teriyaki looked like vomit. The salmon texture was like jelly, looked grey and tasted off and the rice was soaked like teriyaki congee. None of it was edible. I really should have read the reviews before ordering.

Please improve your food quality. Its unbelievably poor.

Ordered ramen on Uber Eats and it was just bad. The soup had 0 flavour. The katsu chicken was added to the soup so it arrived completely sodden. Who on earth put broccoli, cucumber and whole spinach leaved in ramen?! Definitely would not recommend. Sorry.

I ordered a take away for the first time and I was very pleased with my order👌🏽

I didn't have to wait to long and my food arrived hot as I always expect🔥

Taste wise very on point as I love me a good burger 🍔

Oreo Milkshake 10/10 🥰

Note:
Will definitely be ordering from here again might have to dine in next time, if they have that option.
As we all know the food tatse 10 times better when u order in-house 😋

Ordered two absolutely juicy burgers and they were sooooooooo delicious! This place was recommended to me by my friends and they were so correct in bringing me in!! Got home delivery they didn’t take too long definitely going to be back for another helping!!! The only downside is that it was a bit on the costly side, we ordered an Ultimate duo for 2 and 2 garlic aioli £34… Mmmmm…

I think imma go back today!!!
Ordered using Deliveroo on the weekend and came within 20 minutes. Piping hot crispy rosemary fries & juicy smash burgers, all packaged neatly. What a treat! Would recommend!

We ordered Bronsons for takeaway and honestly, it was incredible. The burgers were still hot, juicy, and packed with flavour by the time we got home – no soggy buns or sad chips here! Everything was perfectly packaged, and the quality really stood out. You can tell they care about what they do. Easily one of the best takeaway burgers we’ve had – will definitely be ordering again soon!
I got the Daredevil Burger and Vanilla Milkshake which was absolutely amazing! The Rosemary fries were good too. This felt like an amazing burger after so long, would definitely recommend!

name: My Burger
address: 260 Old Kent Rd, London SE1 5UB, UK

reviews.text:
I hadn't noticed there was a change of ownership until I had arrived at the shop. It's be rebranded but they still list themselves as my burger on delivery platforms.

They told me that they still do the My Burger menu they've just changed owners and added more to the menu, so I thought I'd order.

Hygiene is poor, I've seen the guy prepare with no gloves and casually touching different surfaces (not to mention scratch his face). Secondly the food is precooked and left in the fridge. Lastly it tasted awful, to the point I threw the food away after 2 bites. They use cheap chicken strips from the pound shop and charge premium pricing for a burger that doesn't meet the expected quality. Just to point out they had hardly any of the burger/wraps available expect for the chicken options.

This place isn't what it was during COVID up until 2022. Not worth your time and money. If you want a halal McDonald's style meal, just go to Hungry Cow in East London which is worth the 20 min drive.

I wouldn't recommend or return to this establishment.

I love this place. Food is amazing. Very friendly service. Did tried quite a few deferent burgers. I would definitely recommend this place. You can try any one of them from the menu and I am sure you will love it. Wish you all the very.

Desparate imitation of McD.
The problem that food is not better, which what you need to achieve when competiting with big guys in imitation game.
Fries are very cheap and low quality and burger doesn't look like picture (ordered cajun and chicken is very different).
For 1.50 extra I went large, but only got little bit more fries and same small can. Not worth going large at all. 1.50 for few fries pieces.

Also trades as Mac Halal Burger.
Ordered through Ubereats. Food came quick but as soon as I unpacked the food I knew something was wrong.

I ordered two Double flame burgers which consists of the usual sauces and diced onions and pickles. Bit what was missing was a pattie and the turkey rasher.
For an £8.50 meal I essentially received a large double cheeseburger meal. The Chip scoop was bigger than the burger!

Furthermore my brother found hair in his fries. As if someone just had a haircut at the barbers and didn't have a shower and went straight to work.

I called up and spoke to a member of the team. Firstly he didn't know the menu and then had the audacity to tell me to order again. What? And pay again? Sorry fella you must take me for a mug.

I was a usual at My Burger. But having received such a poor service I'll be taking my hard earned cash elsewhere!

I would not recommend this eatery.

Having had food from here in the past (2 times to be precise), I was looking forward to their strips and nuggets, but what i was served was one of the worst chicken strips and nuggets i have ever eaten. They looked as if it was refried and tasted burnt. It was truly inedibe. As well as this, with their prices increased, I will not be returning to this place.

Not worth it! Visited your store today at 12 lunch time, the shop was empty i was the only customer but my food took 22mins for the 1st meal. Considering i ordered 5wings meal twice, first meal took 22mins and the second meal came out 7mins after considering it was the same exact meals. Only to be served raw chicken wings!
Will not be re visiting again.

The flavour of the wings was basic too much coating, the crinkle chips had more taste (peri seasoning) then the wings!
Got Good deals on uber eats. The chicken wings are great, tasty and crispy. Burger was small but good value. Chicken bites and jumbo tenders portions were quite small won’t get them again If no deals

The girl behind the till was very helpful in
explaining the menu and suggesting what me and the missus should get and making sure we don’t have any allergies to anything. I also noticed she was constantly doing something like checking up on all the customers if there was anything else she could do for them, and regularly cleaning the toilets, which she did twice during our meal which was very nice to see as we come quite picky with certain restaurant as their not all clean, but we undoubtedly felt very comfortable here. The food was great and service was even better! Will be returning

Popped in to try the Smack tenders for the first time. The customer service was excellent, but unfortunately the chicken tenders were extremely greasy. By the time I got to my car, which was about a 15 second walk, the bottom of the bag felt oily.

When I opened the box, I found three good looking tenders sitting in a pool of oil. It looked like they had come straight from the fryer into the box, with no attempt to drain or shake off the excess oil.

It is a shame because the flavour was good and the service was great. I would have given a five star review if not for the oil.

The food here is nice and we’ve always enjoyed it, however it’s no longer a family-friendly place. There is a TV that repeatedly plays an advert promoting Krept & Konan’s partnership with Smacks, and the advert includes swear words. They could have easily chosen a different part of the song or even a different song altogether.
It’s sad because this partnership is something positive for them, but the way it’s presented has turned it into a negative experience for families. I have two young girls aged 5 and 7 who previously enjoyed eating here, but we can no longer sit in because of the language being played. It’s disappointing, as we really liked this place.

name: KHF Peckham
address: 35 Peckham High St, London SE15 5EB, UK

reviews.text: i grabbed some food from khf peckham and was really happy with how tasty everything was. the chicken was tender and well seasoned, and the portions were great for the price. i’d definitely stop by again when i’m in the area.

I normally order food from here online but today I visited in person. The place was nice and clean with the option to eat inside or just order food for takeout. I really liked the customer service I received as the gentleman who served me was friendly and polite throughout. Great team atmosphere and very reasonably priced compared to other places I've visited locally.A++
KHF Peckham has a laid-back vibe, and the BBQ wings are decent, but not exceptional. This branch closes at early, so for a better experience and later hours, KHF Stepney is the way to go.

Food is 10/10 the best chicken shop in south east in my opinion better than south London Morley’s.

The boss man always looks after me when I’m in Peckham.
Best I always come here. Workers are nice and friendly and it's just good, cheap food
ordered through Deliveroo. genuinely amazing. food was hot and fresh.we ordered red-hot burger and wings. both were amazing. definitely gonna order again
Wasn't open when I wanted to order and never re opened for me to enjoy so disappointed 😞
Waiting for order, order was cancelled, no reason given.

Had Saturday afternoon lunch, 4 adults and 2 children. Food was great and the service was even better. Always nice when staff offer to rearrange furniture to accommodate buggies and high chairs. Bar was immaculate and well stocked. Pub grub food was top notch. Nice atmosphere in the pub made for a very enjoyable afternoon. Cheers guys.

We had such a wonderful time at the Victoria Inn. The room was super spacious and very clean. The hotel itself is absolutely beautiful and full of charm. The attached pub was especially great. The food, from breakfast to dinner, was exquisite, and both the wines and beers were delicious. Thank you, Del, for your warm and incredibly friendly manner; we felt completely at ease. Thank you, Del, for your generous hospitality. We would love to come back again :)

We stayed at The Victoria Inn while visiting the 58th Street. The staff were incredibly accommodating and helpful from the moment we arrived. The room was simple but just what was needed. The bed was comfy and it was good to have a pod coffee machine in the room and even better that this included decaf coffee. We went down to the bar for a drink in the evening and the pub had a great atmosphere and good choice of drinks on tap. Breakfast was very good. A good selection and very tasty when it arrived. A special mention needs to be given to Carl who worked incredibly hard and was very friendly.

Stopped here recently for a couple of days as my son lives in Peckham and couldn't fault the staff, room or location.
Check in was super smooth...I got there a bit too early to check in but was hoping to leave my bag. The lovely lady on reception checked with house-keeping and my room was ready so was able to get to my room then. The room was perfect for me not huge but big enough with really nice decor and lovely bathroom. Decent coffee machine & bottles of water in room which was a nice touch. Quiet room, didn't hear any noise/traffic despite in being in a relatively busy area.
The team working there were always friendly and chatty when I saw them. I didnt eat in the pub below but did have a few drinks one night..very cosy and friendly atmosphere.
Few mins walk to Peckham Rye Train station and convenient bus links and I felt safe walking to & from them on my own at night.
Will definitely stay here again when visiting. 💚

Had a great 4 day stay at the Victoria Inn in Peckham for a visit with a dozen friends! Del was a lovely host- looking after a smooth check in and taking great care throughout our whole stay. Food in the restaurant was good and bar staff was also excellent. Lots of food options, stores and Pubs within walking distance. Rooms were clean and comfortable.

It’s convenient because there’s a parking lot inside. It costs £12 per day.
The car park has an attendant, making it safe to park.

Fantastic place in south London for events and pop ups.
There is various different units offering different services from west African food, vintage antiques markets yoga and more. I passed by here on my journeys during the winter so it was very quiet however judging by its location and things to offer I can see this place becoming very busy during the London summer.

I was there for the Independent Ceramics Market, and not only was the market fantastic, Copeland Park itself is a great space with a ton going on!! Wish I lived closer so I could check out more events

Rooftop film club is a magic summer experience. Comfortable seats, easy food & drinks order, great sound & image quality. Great atmosphere, superb location, kind staff, delicious simple food (e.g. mozzarela garlic bread).  Totally recommend!

A real place of hope, creativity and authenticity. It’s like stepping into Diagon Alley and discovering magical small businesses, charming places to eat, drink, connect with like-minded people!
A place to relax, to discover, to meet and have fun! Highly recommend 🌟

name: M.Manze - Peckham
address: 105 Peckham High St, London SE15 5RS, UK

reviews.text: There simply needs to be more of these places making headlines in the London area. Just simple, delicious, food served by friendly people. You can’t ask for anything more and sure, it’s not the most amazing pie and mash that I have ever had, but the atmosphere and history of the place speaks for itself and the price is right on. I would happily recommend M.Manze to anyone wishing to have an authentic and real experience with great British scran.

A True London Classic – Manze’s Never Disappoints!

Manze’s in Peckham is a gem of traditional London heritage. I popped in for pie and mash, and left feeling like I’d stepped back into a golden era of honest, comforting food. The pie was perfectly baked, packed with rich, savory filling, and the mash was smooth and creamy—just how it should be. But the real star? That legendary liquor. Fresh, herby, and utterly nostalgic.

The staff were warm and welcoming, and the old-school atmosphere adds to the whole experience. It’s rare to find a place that holds onto its roots while still serving up quality with every plate.

If you want a real taste of London, this is the place. Can’t wait to return!

Manze's is still good. I've been going here with my dad for years and that won't change. The Pie n mash is amazing, mash is nice and smooth and the pie is just as great and for a great value for money. I'll always love the old school feel with the place.

I can not recommend the place enough.
Simply the best pie and mash I’ve ever eaten. Nobody does it better.
Incredibly friendly pie, mash and liquor shop. The pies are lovely and beefy, the mash is smooth and creamy and the liquor is savory and full of parsley. Try the locally made saspirilla too!.

name: Morley's Peckham
address: 10 Peckham High St, London SE15 5DT, UK

reviews.text:
I'd say the best Morley's I've tried so far. Chicken is just brilliant, staff here is always friendly, do food so quickly.

Maybe even it's one of the best chicken shops in London I had
To be honest this Morleys isn't too bad, but I don't unserdtand is that they ALWAYS drown the chicken fillet burger in mayo, you can barely enjoy the burger, it's comletely ridiculous.
Took forever to give me my food.

This morleys once had 5 stars from me.
Now it's just gone down hill just got bbq wings and chips.
Chips needed longer and the chicken was really dry. Quality of the chicken is poor clearly very cheap.
Think I'll stop buying from here disappointed.
The workers I used to see don't see no more. Under new management maybe.
Decent food for its price. It tasted nice, too, except for the chips, it wasnt seasoned with salt at all. It seemed to be run by one person. The atmosphere needs more work, maybe.
They are total crazy

Definitely recommend this place for everyone! The place is so cozy, with diverse and lovely furniture, like a different fantasy when you come. The flat white is also very great. If I had chance to visit here again, I will definitely visit this place again.

This place is awesome. Its so quirky and has a rooftop bar and cafe which is open during the week. The views over central London are amazing. We went because they put in arts performances at the weekends. Been to 2 so far, the first being a double piano recital which was awesome. It's actually a disused multi storey carpark that's been turned into an arts centre. It's a surreal experience sitting on chairs arranged on a concrete floor but it works. Worth checking out. It is funded by private doners so not commercial. Going to 2 more performances later in the year. London symphony orchestra and Rachmaninoff.

I will say that this is a very interesting building with small businesses inside like shops, bars, and takeaways and has a big rootop bar with an amazing view of London. The facilities inside are very run down, and there are hardly any directions with multiple entrances and no parking.

Loved the food from The Grub Club. Definitely a highlight of the place. A place to gather and chill and hang out with pretty much most of what you'd need if you have good company. Music, a bar, a few places to eat,  karaoke. The karaoke room is very small but still a decent place to enjoy when in the company of friends.

Thoroughly enjoyed the visit here. I was there visiting a friend who had a jewellery making workshop. Got some lovely food from the bar aswell. Full of stalls from crafting materials to home made preserves. It's a great place to spend a rainy Sunday.

Orders vegetables fried rice . Big portion Great price 😋Good quality rice with Lots vegetables including mushroom, cabbage, broccoli, coriander... 5 vege a day simply done here !
The reason I like this place is their friendly service, welcoming atmosphere, feeling like home :)

I love the food. Well priced, good
Portion size, really tasty. They’re lovely as well. Top marks all round.

So glad we found this place again (he’s recently moved location). This place is worthy of more than five stars. The best steam buns in London by a mile. The squid is a huge portion and the prices are more than affordable for London. The owner I think works alone, so he’s often busy but seemingly very hard working - (always a good sign you’ve made a good food choice). It’s well worth the visit, you’ll not be disappointed!
Excellent food, great value for money, and decent portions. I’ve visited several times and each time the food is great.

Best Chinese food in London! Real hidden gem - the place is nothing fancy, but the food is amazing,well priced and the guy who runs it is so friendly. All the dishes are good but I like the spring rolls and noodles with blackbean sauce. The portions are very generous with lots of fresh veg and ingredients, which makes it quite healthy, unlike most other Chinese takeouts where there is only noodles and beansprouts. In summary, Peckham Steamer is great. Shame they didn't do delivery, but worth the travel to get.

I went into beer rebellion today on my way to another bar, and thank god I choose this place instead. The lovely Italian lady behind the bar (I think Mia) brightened my day and even gave me some great recommendations for the area ! The rest of the staff were also there having a drink and they all seem to love their jobs and each other. Can’t wait to go back ! Love you BR

Genuinely one of the most welcoming bars you’re going to find in Peckham. The staff are amazing and truly friendly. From the first day I met the staff the treated me so well that I’ve been coming back here so often.

Perfect place to do work and they bar has events from time to time.
Super friendly place, great selection of IPAs / modern beers. Never had any food there hence a neutral 3.

Very lovely place to have a variety of Beers, and different drinks. My favourite is number 7.
Close to Queen Road Peckham Station, and different bus routes. I definitely recommend the place.
I liked it, nothing fancy but it was warm and I could have stayed all day.. girl at the bar is very nice and friendly

I don't often post negative reviews and especially in this case it was a tough decision to make because historically the place has been great and the fish was always good, but on this occasion the fried chicken was unedible. It tasted like expired meat. Whatever the reason is, please sort it out because it's taking away from what used to be a great place

I went to this place expecting a good meal. What I have just seen is shocking. I have ordered a chicken doner and specifically requested for him to cut the doner in front of me. He mixed the pre-ready meal box and he mixed it with the fresh chicken doner. The meat is not cooked well, I ordered a portion of chips and I requested for it to be extra-cooked. He didn’t cook it properly and it turned out to be soggy. The chicken doner also smelled.

Service is rubbish, when he was preparing it for takeaway, he didn’t put any tissue, nor a fork or knife.

Never go to this place, absolutely rubbish. Explains why it is empty.

Have had kebabs , chips n chicken fillet burgers from here and all were really tasty .
Delivery was fast and prices reasonable for the quality of the food .

READ THE REVIEWS ABOUT THE SERVICE BEFORE ORDERING. The manager is one of the rudest people I’ve ever come across. TRASH FOOD.  My order came in 20 mins of me ordering and she admitted on the phone that she had just given me the last batch and she isn’t cooking anymore as she “doesn’t cook wings past this time”. She actually admitted that she COOKED this and deemed it good enough to sell!!!
Upon me telling her that she got my order wrong she said “NO, I didn’t”. She said she’ll issue a refund for the wings if she can pick the wings up later which I suspect is to SELL TO ANOTHER INVDIVIDUAL.
Whilst confirming I was a refund and will be leaving a review of my service today she hung up!!! She DIDN’T EVEN APOLOGISE.

Just look at the disgusting wings and terrible - BROKEN, box that the wings came in!!!
